es.text: Le recogeremos en su alojamiento o en un lugar conveniente para comenzar la aventura del día.

es.title: Visita a la cueva de Jameos del Agua
es.text: Jameos del Agua es una cueva que forma parte de un túnel de lava. Alberga un lago salado que alberga raras especies de cangrejos albinos y una Sala de Conciertos subterránea transformada por César Manrique. También cuenta con un restaurante con un impresionante jardín y una laguna azul.

es.title: Próxima visita: Cueva de los Verdes
es.text: La Cueva de los Verdes es una formación de tubos de lava provocada por la erupción de un volcán. Se extiende a lo largo de más de 6 km, pero sólo 1 km está abierto al público. Aquí podrá descubrir la historia de esta cueva y disfrutar de un alucinante espectáculo de luz y sonido. Una experiencia inolvidable para descubrir los secretos de Lanzarote.

es.title: Mirador la Ermita de las Nieves y paso por el Valle de las 1000 Palmeras
es.text: El Mirador la Ermita de las Nieves es un impresionante mirador estratégicamente situado en lo alto de una colina de Haría. Ofrece vistas panorámicas del paisaje circundante y un ambiente tranquilo y apacible. Los visitantes pueden tomarse un momento para relajarse, disfrutar de la serenidad del entorno y empaparse de la energía única de Lanzarote antes de que les llevemos a través del famoso Valle de las Mil Palmeras.

es.title: Entrega en el alojamiento o punto de recogida
es.text: Tras una emocionante exploración de las cuevas y lugares pintorescos, le dejaremos en su alojamiento o en el punto de recogida designado.

en: In which language is the excursion?
We  have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French, and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days
Where / when and how can i pay the balance?
Customers have 2 options , you can either pay in full at the time of booking or you can pay at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using credit card or cash.
Do we pick up at private BnB’s?
Not exactly, however we pick at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
How long will I be in the bus.
Lanzarote is a tiny island. The most time you will be on the bus is only when going from North to the south, which takes approximately 50 minutes.
How far are the pick up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pick-up points are in hotels or the next-door resort. Pick-up starts at 08:30 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indications if your hotel doesn’t have pick-up.
How long is the excursion?
This is a half-day tour that takes around 5 hours from the time of pick-up to the time of drop-off, bringing you back around 17:00 o’clock.
Do I have free time?
Yes, at every stop, we give you at least 15 minutes to enjoy and explore the attractions without any rush.
What sort of clothes do I need?

You can dress as you please, but we recommend comfortable clothing and trainers. Hats and sunglasses are recommended for the summer season, and a jumper is recommended for winter time as it can be windy in the morning.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?

No, this tour goes to the Green cave of Cueva de los Verdes, which involves a 40-minute walk inside the lava tube. You can consider our Grand Tour or our César Manrique Tour for options suitable for reduced mobility.
Do we stop for food, and is it included in the price?
No, this is a half-day tour, and we don’t have time to stop for food. You can consider our Lanzarote Highlights Tour for an option that includes food.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course! You can bring some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How big and long are the caves?

Cueva de los Verdes is a wide connection of lava tunnels. It takes a 40-minute hike to complete, and it’s not claustrophobic. The ceiling is 10 meters wide. You can check the photos section to get a better idea.
Can I swim at the lagoon in Jameos del Agua?
No, swimming is strictly forbidden. The natural lake is home to rare albino crabs, and the blue lagoon at the King’s Garden is there for artistic purposes and display.
Does this tour go to the volcanoes?

No, this tour concentrates on the northern side of Lanzarote, and the fire mountains of Timanfaya National Park are located on the southern coast. You can consider our Grand Tour or the Lanzarote Highlights for an experience that includes the volcanoes.
Are there too many steps to go up to the viewpoint?
No, there are no more than 10 steps to go up. Our drivers drop off at the most approximate parking, which is 2 minutes away.
es: ¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Tenemos visitas en inglés, español, alemán y francés, y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?

Los clientes tienen 2 opciones , puede pagar en su totalidad en el momento de la reserva o puede pagar en el momento de la recogida, a nuestros guías, el pago puede hacerse con tarjeta de crédito o en efectivo.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo recogemos en su parada de autobús más cercana o en su hotel, envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta su parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaré en el autobús?
Lanzarote es una isla diminuta. Sólo pasará más tiempo en el autobús cuando vaya del norte al sur, lo que le llevará aproximadamente 50 minutos.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado. La recogida comienza a las 08:30 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicaciones GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
Se trata de una excursión de medio día que dura unas 5 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y que le llevará de vuelta sobre las 17:00 horas.
¿Tengo tiempo libre?
Sí, en cada parada le damos al menos 15 minutos para disfrutar y explorar las atracciones sin prisas.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?

Puedes vestir como quieras, pero te recomendamos ropa cómoda y zapatillas deportivas. Se recomiendan sombreros y gafas de sol para el verano, y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?

No, esta excursión va a la Cueva de los Verdes, que implica un paseo de 40 minutos por el interior del tubo de lava. Puede considerar nuestro Grand Tour o nuestro Tour César Manrique para opciones adecuadas para movilidad reducida.
¿Paramos para comer y está incluido en el precio?
No, es una excursión de medio día y no tenemos tiempo para parar a comer. Puede considerar nuestro Lanzarote Highlights Tour para una opción que incluye comida.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto. Puedes llevar algo de picar y beber, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en todas las paradas que hacemos.
¿Qué tamaño y longitud tienen las cuevas?

La Cueva de los Verdes es una amplia conexión de túneles de lava. La caminata dura 40 minutos y no es claustrofóbica. El techo mide 10 metros de ancho. Puede consultar la sección de fotos para hacerse una mejor idea.
¿Puedo bañarme en la laguna de Jameos del Agua?
No, está terminantemente prohibido nadar. El lago natural alberga raros cangrejos albinos, y la laguna azul del Jardín del Rey tiene fines artísticos y expositivos.
¿Este tour va a los volcanes?

No, esta excursión se concentra en la zona norte de Lanzarote, y las montañas de fuego del Parque Nacional de Timanfaya se encuentran en la costa sur. Puede considerar nuestro Gran Recorrido o los Destacados de Lanzarote para una experiencia que incluya los volcanes.
¿Hay demasiados escalones para subir al mirador?
No, no hay más de 10 escalones para subir. Nuestros conductores le dejan en el aparcamiento más aproximado, que está a 2 minutos.

es.title: Excursión Corta Volcanes Sur Lanzarote - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct
es.description: Descubre los ardientes paisajes de Timanfaya en nuestra Excursión Corta Volcanes Sur Lanzarote. Explora volcanes y disfruta de paseos en camello.

overview.en:
Embark on an unforgettable journey with our "Short South Tour Volcano" at Timanfaya National Park in Lanzarote, a premier destination for visitors intrigued by the power and beauty of nature's most formidable creations: volcanoes. This half-day morning tour promises not just a visit but an immersive exploration of one of the most spectacular volcanic landscapes in the world.

Your adventure begins at the iconic Timanfaya National Park, often referred to as the Fire Mountains, where you'll be swept off your feet by the dramatic vistas of the sprawling volcanic fields. Here, nature's force is palpable, and the park's unique "Volcano Tour & Experiments" will provide you with hands-on demonstrations of geothermal power. Witness geysers shoot steam into the air heated solely by the earth's heat and perform experiments that illustrate the intense temperatures just beneath the surface, making this one of the most thrilling volcanic experiences available.

As you traverse the Lava Field, the ground beneath you tells the story of centuries-old eruptions that shaped this alien landscape. The optional camel ride through this rugged terrain offers a unique perspective and a touch of adventure to your volcanic exploration. It’s an experience that allows you to feel connected to the history of these majestic natural structures, offering a peaceful yet profound appreciation for the forces that shaped our earth.

Our "Short South Tour Volcano" also takes you to the less-visited yet equally mesmerizing Camel Park. This serene spot offers a rare opportunity to see how local fauna has adapted to the harsh volcanic environment. It’s a perfect place to reflect on the day’s adventures and enjoy a moment of tranquility amidst the raw beauty of Lanzarote’s volcanic fields.

Suitable for all ages and particularly engaging for families with children, this tour doesn’t simply showcase Lanzarote's volcanic beauty—it plunges you into the heart of it. With expert guides leading the way and providing insightful commentary, you’ll gain a deeper understanding of volcanic activity, not just on Lanzarote but as a global phenomenon.

For those passionate about geology, or simply looking for an excursion that combines education with spectacular natural beauty, the "Short South Tour Volcano" is an essential addition to your Lanzarote itinerary. Join us for a morning of discovery and leave with memories and knowledge that will last a lifetime.

Secure your spot today on this extraordinary volcanic tour and transform the way you see the natural world. Visit our website at excursionsticketsdirect.com to book your tour and for more information on other exciting tours and experiences we offer across Lanzarote.
overview.es:
Embárcate en un viaje inolvidable con nuestra Excursión Corta Volcanes Sur Lanzarote, en el Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, en Lanzarote, un destino de primer orden para los visitantes intrigados por el poder y la belleza de las creaciones más formidables de la naturaleza: los volcanes. Esta excursión de medio día por la mañana promete no sólo una visita, sino una exploración inmersiva de uno de los paisajes volcánicos más espectaculares del mundo.

Tu aventura comienza en el emblemático Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, a menudo conocido como las Montañas del Fuego, donde te sorprenderán las espectaculares vistas de los extensos campos volcánicos. Aquí, la fuerza de la naturaleza es palpable, y el exclusivo "Recorrido y Experimentos Volcánicos" del parque te proporcionará demostraciones prácticas de la energía geotérmica. Sé testigo de cómo los géiseres lanzan vapor al aire calentado únicamente por el calor de la tierra y realiza experimentos que ilustran las intensas temperaturas que se alcanzan justo bajo la superficie, haciendo de ésta una de las experiencias volcánicas más emocionantes que existen.

Mientras atraviesas el Campo de Lava, el suelo bajo tus pies cuenta la historia de erupciones centenarias que dieron forma a este paisaje extraterrestre. El paseo opcional en camello por este terreno escarpado ofrece una perspectiva única y un toque de aventura a tu exploración volcánica. Es una experiencia que te permite sentirte conectado a la historia de estas majestuosas estructuras naturales, ofreciendo una apreciación pacífica pero profunda de las fuerzas que dieron forma a nuestra tierra.

Nuestra "Vuelta Corta al Sur del Volcán" también te lleva al menos visitado pero igualmente fascinante Parque de los Camellos. Este sereno paraje ofrece una rara oportunidad de ver cómo la fauna local se ha adaptado al duro entorno volcánico. Es un lugar perfecto para reflexionar sobre las aventuras del día y disfrutar de un momento de tranquilidad en medio de la cruda belleza de los campos volcánicos de Lanzarote.

Adecuada para todas las edades y especialmente atractiva para familias con niños, esta excursión no se limita a mostrar la belleza volcánica de Lanzarote, sino que te sumerge en su corazón. Con guías expertos que te guiarán y proporcionarán comentarios perspicaces, comprenderás mejor la actividad volcánica, no sólo en Lanzarote, sino como fenómeno global.

Para los apasionados de la geología, o simplemente para quienes buscan una excursión que combine la educación con una espectacular belleza natural, la "Excursión Volcán Sur Corto" es un complemento esencial de tu itinerario por Lanzarote. Únete a nosotros en una mañana de descubrimientos y sal con recuerdos y conocimientos que durarán toda la vida.

Asegura hoy mismo tu plaza en esta extraordinaria excursión volcánica y transforma tu forma de ver el mundo natural. Visita nuestro sitio web en excursionsticketsdirect.com para reservar tu excursión y para obtener más información sobre otras emocionantes excursiones y experiencias que ofrecemos en Lanzarote.

en.text: We will pick you up from your hotel or a nearby pick-up point to start the excursion.

en.title: Timanfaya National Park (Volcano Tour & Experiments):
en.text: Timanfaya Park is home to the fire mountains and is located in the southern part of Lanzarote. Experience geothermal experiments and visit Restaurant El Diablo, where food is grilled using the heat of the volcano. Get a glimpse into the heart of the volcano and feel the strength of Mother Nature. Enjoy the breathtaking lunar crater tour as our drivers take you through the rugged landscape where lava used to flow.

en.title: Lava Field / Camel Park:
en.text: Make a stop at the Camel Park where you can enjoy a camel ride and take photos in the old lava fields for an additional €12. It's a truly unforgettable experience. If you don't want a camel ride, you can visit a local museum that explains the history of the park.

es.text: El Parque de Timanfaya alberga las montañas de fuego y está situado en el sur de Lanzarote. Experimente la geotermia y visite el Restaurante El Diablo, donde la comida se asa utilizando el calor del volcán. Adéntrese en el corazón del volcán y sienta la fuerza de la Madre Naturaleza. Disfrute de la impresionante excursión por el cráter lunar mientras nuestros conductores le llevan por el escarpado paisaje por el que antes fluía la lava.

es.title: Campo de lava / Parque del Camello:
es.text: Haga una parada en el Camel Park, donde podrá disfrutar de un paseo en camello y tomar fotos en los antiguos campos de lava por un suplemento de 12 euros. Es una experiencia realmente inolvidable. Si no quiere dar un paseo en camello, puede visitar un museo local que explica la historia del parque.

en: Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, Costa Teguise, Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. The pick-up points are hotels or nearby resorts. Pick-up starts at 08:30 in each resort. Provide us with your hotel information, and we will send you the exact pick-up time and GPS indications if your hotel doesn't have pick-up.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we do pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you with GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts around 5 hours, from the time of pick-up to the time of drop-off, bringing you back around 14:00.
Is the camel ride included?
No, the camel rides are an additional €10 per person, which is paid in cash to the organizers of the rides.
In which language is the excursion?
We only organise Tour in English and Spanish on the short trips.
Where, when, and how can I pay the balance?
You have two options for payment. You can either pay in full at the time of booking or pay the balance at the time of collection to our guides. Payment can be made using a credit card or in cash.
Do I have free time?
Yes, at every stop, we provide at least 15 minutes of free time for you to enjoy and explore the attractions without feeling rushed.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can wear comfortable clothing and trainers. In the summer season, we recommend hats and sunglasses, and in the winter, it's advisable to bring a jumper as it can be windy in the morning.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person can get on and off the bus and has an assistant, it is possible. Our tour guides are also very helpful.
Is there a stop for food?

No, on this short trip, we only stop for a 10minute coffee break if there is extra time (not guaranteed). If you want a meal, consider the South Tour option, where you can enjoy a buffet of local tapas for as little as €13 with drinks included.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Are the volcanoes active and dangerous?
Timanfaya is an active volcano, but it last erupted 200 to 300 years ago. The insides are now filled with potable water, making it unlikely to erupt again for the foreseeable future.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, Costa Teguise, Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida son hoteles o complejos turísticos cercanos. La recogida comienza a las 08:30 en cada estación. Facilítenos los datos de su hotel y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida y las indicaciones del GPS si su hotel no dispone de servicio de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 5 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 14:00.
¿Está incluido el paseo en camello?
No, los paseos en camello cuestan 10 euros más por persona, que se pagan en efectivo a los organizadores de los paseos.
¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Sólo organizamos excursiones en inglés y español en los viajes cortos.
¿Dónde, cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?

Tiene dos opciones de pago. Puede pagar el importe total en el momento de la reserva o abonar el resto en el momento de la recogida a nuestros guías. Se puede pagar con tarjeta de crédito o en efectivo.
¿Tengo tiempo libre?
Sí, en cada parada le ofrecemos al menos 15 minutos de tiempo libre para que disfrute y explore las atracciones sin prisas.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes llevar ropa cómoda y zapatillas de deporte. En verano, recomendamos sombreros y gafas de sol, y en invierno, es aconsejable llevar un jersey, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona pueda subir y bajar del autobús y tenga un ayudante, es posible. Nuestros guías turísticos también son muy serviciales.
¿Hay alguna parada para comer?

No, en este corto viaje, sólo paramos para tomar un café de 10 minutos si hay tiempo extra (no garantizado). Si le apetece comer, considere la opción Tour Sur, donde podrá disfrutar de un bufé de tapas locales por tan sólo 13 euros con bebidas incluidas.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puedes llevar aperitivos y bebidas, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Están los volcanes activos y son peligrosos?

Timanfaya es un volcán activo, pero entró en erupción por última vez hace entre 200 y 300 años. Las entrañas están ahora llenas de agua potable, por lo que es improbable que vuelva a entrar en erupción en un futuro próximo.

This tour is a treasure trove for those eager to discover the untouched natural beauty of the Canary Islands. Reserve your spot today at excursionsticketsdirect.com and prepare for a voyage unlike any other.

Discover La Graciosa’s Breathtaking Natural Reserve Your adventure begins with a scenic 35-minute ferry ride from Lanzarote to the enchanting La Graciosa, the archipelago's hidden gem. As you disembark in the quaint village, you’ll have the freedom to explore its serene streets and traditional architecture, offering a glimpse into a lifestyle that has remained unchanged for decades.

Luxurious Sailing on Our State-of-the-Art Catamaran Step aboard our luxurious catamaran, where comfort meets elegance. As we set sail to the secluded Playa Frances Beach, the highlight of your excursion awaits. Our all-inclusive cruise offers not just a journey across crystal-clear waters, but an invitation to immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and entertainment.

All-Inclusive Experience Indulge in an unlimited selection of beverages at our all-inclusive bar, featuring refreshing cocktails and other premium drinks to enhance your sunny escapade. Savor the taste of the Canary Islands with our freshly prepared tapas and local delicacies, cooked on board for your culinary delight.

Dive into the azure waters for an unforgettable snorkeling experience, explore coastal beauty by kayak, or simply bask on the sun-soaked decks of our catamaran. Every moment promises panoramic views and exhilarating experiences.

Perfect for Everyone Whether you're planning a family outing, a romantic getaway, or a solo retreat, the La Graciosa Catamaran Cruise caters to all preferences. It’s an ideal choice for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of daily life and immerse themselves in nature’s wonders.

Book Your Unforgettable Journey Don’t miss the opportunity to be part of this unique maritime adventure. Availability is limited, so we encourage early bookings to guarantee your place on this exclusive tour. Visit our website at excursionsticketsdirect.com to secure your tickets for an unforgettable journey through the heart of the Canary Islands.

en: How long are we on the coach?
The ride to the north is approximately 45 minutes for the customers staying in Playa Blanca, but it goes very quickly as you enjoy Lanzarote’s picturesque volcanic landscape.
How long is the ferry to La Graciosa?
The ferry to La Graciosa takes around 35-40 minutes to reach as we slow down to let you enjoy the views of the North side of Lanzarote.
Is the ferry from Lanzarote to La Graciosa included?
Yes, return Ferry Tickets to La Graciosa are included in the price.
Are Water Activities included?
Yes, Water Activities are included in the price.
What Water Activities are offered?
There are slides on the catamaran, mats, and inflatables on the sea, and kayaking. Bring your own snorkels as we aren’t allowed to offer you any due to Covid-19 restrictions.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for a total of 4 hours from start to finish.
Are there any shades on the boat?
This is a special Catamaran with an inside bar and Chillout area with comfortable seats.
Are there any toilets on board?
Yes, this Catamaran has two separate toilets.
Is there any music on board?
Yes, we have Chillout music on board. Sometimes we even get people up dancing.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
Yes, when the boat has docked and water activities are activated, the slides will be opened, and you may also jump into the sea. Alternatively, there’s a ramp from where you can walk into the sea.
What sort of clothes do I need?
We recommend comfortable clothing, hats, sunglasses, beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim, and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
What food is included?

We serve a local traditional Paella made with rice and vegetables. Seafood and meat are cooked separately and added on top if customers desire. We also give the option of a simple pasta with tomato sauce.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment in the notes at the time of booking.
Are drinks included?
Yes, drinks are included for all you can drink, and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer, and non-alcoholic beverages. There’s also a welcome Mojito served after you board the boat.
How much free time do I have at La Graciosa?
We give you approximately 40 minutes of leisure time in La Graciosa. This is enough time to explore the village Caleta del Sebo and even visit its old church.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food, but we also have snacks and freshly cooked lunch served on board.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts around 7 hours from the time of pick-up to the time of drop-off, bringing you back around 16:00.
How long are you on the bus?
The excursion is on and off the bus. The most time spent on the bus is 40 minutes.
Is swimming allowed?
Yes, you have plenty of time to go to the beach, dive in, and relax by the golden sand and catch a bit of sun.
How long is the ferry to La Graciosa?
The ferry takes around 30-35 minutes to reach La Graciosa and back.
Are there any restaurants and bars at La Graciosa?
Yes, there are a few beach bars and restaurants.
es: ¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hacia el norte es de aproximadamente 45 minutos para los clientes alojados en Playa Blanca, pero se pasa muy rápido mientras se disfruta del pintoresco paisaje volcánico de Lanzarote.
¿Cuánto dura el trayecto en ferry hasta La Graciosa?
El ferry a La Graciosa tarda unos 35-40 minutos en llegar, ya que reducimos la velocidad para que pueda disfrutar de las vistas de la cara norte de Lanzarote.
¿Está incluido el ferry de Lanzarote a La Graciosa?
Sí, los billetes de ferry de ida y vuelta a La Graciosa están incluidos en el precio.
¿Están incluidas las actividades acuáticas?
Sí, las actividades acuáticas están incluidas en el precio.
¿Qué actividades acuáticas se ofrecen?
Hay toboganes en el catamarán, colchonetas e hinchables en el mar, y kayak. Traiga sus propios tubos, ya que no podemos ofrecérselos debido a las restricciones de Covid-19.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo un total de 4 horas de principio a fin.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Se trata de un catamarán especial con bar interior y zona Chillout con cómodos asientos.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
Sí, este catamarán tiene dos aseos separados.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música Chillout a bordo. A veces incluso ponemos a la gente a bailar.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?

Sí, cuando el barco haya atracado y se activen las actividades acuáticas, se abrirán los toboganes y también podrá saltar al mar. Alternativamente, hay una rampa desde la que se puede caminar hasta el mar.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañador si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante, puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?

Servimos una paella tradicional local hecha con arroz y verduras. El marisco y la carne se cocinan por separado y se añaden por encima si el cliente lo desea. También damos la opción de una simple pasta con salsa de tomate.
¿Necesita algún régimen alimenticio?
Póngase en contacto con nuestro servicio de atención al cliente o deje un comentario en las notas en el momento de hacer la reserva.

Sí, las bebidas están incluidas para todo lo que puedas beber, y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas sin alcohol. También se sirve un mojito de bienvenida después de subir al barco.

Le damos aproximadamente 40 minutos de tiempo libre en La Graciosa. Es tiempo suficiente para explorar el pueblo de Caleta del Sebo e incluso visitar su antigua iglesia.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede traer comida, pero también tenemos aperitivos y almuerzo recién cocinado servido a bordo.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay aseos en todas las paradas que hacemos.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 7 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el autobús?
La excursión se realiza dentro y fuera del autobús. El tiempo máximo de viaje en autobús es de 40 minutos.
¿Está permitido nadar?
Sí, tienes tiempo de sobra para ir a la playa, zambullirte y relajarte junto a la arena dorada y tomar un poco el sol.
¿Cuánto dura el trayecto en ferry hasta La Graciosa?
El ferry tarda unos 30-35 minutos en llegar a La Graciosa y volver.
¿Hay restaurantes y bares en La Graciosa?
Sí, hay algunos chiringuitos y restaurantes.

Embark on a majestic journey with our Papagayo All-inclusive Catamaran Cruise, setting sail from the vibrant Puerto del Carmen. This cruise is not just a trip; it's an entrance into the enchanting world of Lanzarote's coastal splendors. Join us to discover the serene beauty of the Papagayo beaches – a gem on Lanzarote's southern shores.

As the catamaran glides over the crystal-clear waters, you'll be treated to stunning panoramic views of Lanzarote's coastline, an area celebrated for its pristine beauty and tranquil atmosphere. Papagayo beaches, known for their exquisite golden sands and sheltered coves, offer a perfect backdrop for a day of relaxation and adventure.

From the moment you step aboard, you'll be enveloped in luxury. Our all-inclusive service means everything is taken care of. Enjoy an unlimited supply of freshly made Mojitos, or choose from a selection of other beverages, including soft drinks, cocktails, and premium spirits. Indulge in a delicious buffet featuring local and international cuisine, thoughtfully prepared to cater to all tastes.

The cruise isn't just about relaxation. We bring excitement and adventure directly to you! Engage in an array of watersports – whether it's snorkeling among the vibrant marine life or paddling through the waters in a kayak. Each activity is designed to provide fun and safety for all age groups, making this an ideal choice for families, couples, or solo explorers.

Keep your cameras ready as we cruise along the stunning coast. The region is famed not only for its beauty but also as a habitat for diverse marine wildlife. Sightings of playful dolphins and majestic whales add a magical touch to the cruise, turning it into a truly memorable experience.

Our skilled and friendly crew are experts in hospitality and navigation, ensuring your safety and comfort throughout the day. Their knowledge of the local waters will enrich your experience, providing insights into the area's history and ecological significance.

This Papagayo catamaran cruise is more than just a trip to the beach; it's a full-day expedition that offers both the tranquility of sun-soaked relaxation and the thrill of aquatic adventures. Whether you're basking in the sun on our spacious decks, diving into the cool ocean, or exploring the coves and beaches of Papagayo, every moment is crafted to delight and inspire.

Join us on the Papagayo All-inclusive Catamaran Cruise for a journey where luxury meets adventure. Book your spot today and transform an ordinary day into an extraordinary experience. Don't miss out on the most sought-after catamaran experience in Lanzarote, where the wonders of nature and the comforts of luxury blend seamlessly.

es.title: I Love La Graciosa Catamaran - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Discover the Pristine Beauty of La Graciosa on our Exclusive Catamaran Cruise

Embark on an unforgettable journey to one of the most serene destinations in the Canary Islands with our "I Love La Graciosa Catamaran Cruise." This unique excursion offers a perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and cultural exploration, making it an ideal choice for families, couples, and nature enthusiasts alike.

Experience the Untouched Charm of La Graciosa La Graciosa Island is a hidden gem in the Atlantic, boasting stunning landscapes and a tranquil atmosphere that can only be accessed by boat. As part of the Chinijo Archipelago, La Graciosa is renowned for its unspoiled natural beauty and its status as a protected natural reserve. Our tour begins with a smooth ferry ride from Lanzarote to La Graciosa, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the ocean and the unique volcanic landscapes.

Luxurious Catamaran Adventure Upon arriving at La Graciosa, you’ll step aboard our state-of-the-art catamaran to set sail along the island’s spectacular coast. Our luxury catamaran is equipped with all the amenities to ensure your comfort and enjoyment, including an all-inclusive bar and sumptuous tapas freshly prepared onboard. As we cruise, the white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters of La Graciosa will unfold before you, offering perfect photo opportunities and moments of serene bliss.

Engage in Exciting Water Activities For those seeking a bit of adventure, our cruise includes options for kayaking and snorkeling. Dive into the refreshing waters, or paddle your way along the coast to discover hidden coves and secluded beaches. The marine life around La Graciosa is vibrant and diverse, providing an excellent backdrop for underwater exploration.

Relax and Unwind in Paradise If relaxation is what you seek, there’s no better place than the deck of our catamaran or the soft sands of La Graciosa’s beaches. Take a moment to bask in the sun, read a book, or simply soak in the breathtaking surroundings. Our friendly crew is dedicated to your comfort and will ensure that your experience is as relaxing as it is memorable.

en: How long are we on the coach?
The ride to the north is approximately 45 minutes for the customers staying in Playa Blanca, but it goes very quickly as you enjoy Lanzarote’s picturesque volcanic landscape.
How long is the ferry to La Graciosa?
The ferry to La Graciosa takes around 35-40 minutes to reach as we slow down to let you enjoy the views of the North side of Lanzarote.
Is the ferry from Lanzarote to La Graciosa included?
Yes, return Ferry Tickets to La Graciosa are included in the price.
Are Water Activities included?
Yes, Water Activities are included in the price.
What Water Activities are offered?
There are slides on the catamaran, mats, and inflatables on the sea, and kayaking. Bring your own snorkels as we aren’t allowed to offer you any due to Covid-19 restrictions.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for a total of 4 hours from start to finish.
Are there any shades on the boat?
This is a special Catamaran with an inside bar and Chillout area with comfortable seats.
Are there any toilets on board?
Yes, this Catamaran has two separate toilets.
Is there any music on board?
Yes, we have Chillout music on board. Sometimes we even get people up dancing.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
Yes, when the boat has docked and water activities are activated, the slides will be opened, and you may also jump into the sea. Alternatively, there’s a ramp from where you can walk into the sea.
What sort of clothes do I need?
We recommend comfortable clothing, hats, sunglasses, beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim, and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
What food is included?

We serve a local traditional Paella made with rice and vegetables. Seafood and meat are cooked separately and added on top if customers desire. We also give the option of a simple pasta with tomato sauce.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment in the notes at the time of booking.
Are drinks included?
Yes, drinks are included for all you can drink, and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer, and non-alcoholic beverages. There’s also a welcome Mojito served after you board the boat.
How much free time do I have at La Graciosa?
We give you approximately 40 minutes of leisure time in La Graciosa. This is enough time to explore the village Caleta del Sebo and even visit its old church.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food, but we also have snacks and freshly cooked lunch served on board.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts around 7 hours from the time of pick-up to the time of drop-off, bringing you back around 16:00.
How long are you on the bus?
The excursion is on and off the bus. The most time spent on the bus is 40 minutes.
Is swimming allowed?
Yes, you have plenty of time to go to the beach, dive in, and relax by the golden sand and catch a bit of sun.
How long is the ferry to La Graciosa?
The ferry takes around 30-35 minutes to reach La Graciosa and back.
Are there any restaurants and bars at La Graciosa?
Yes, there are a few beach bars and restaurants.
es: ¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hacia el norte es de aproximadamente 45 minutos para los clientes alojados en Playa Blanca, pero se pasa muy rápido mientras se disfruta del pintoresco paisaje volcánico de Lanzarote.
¿Cuánto dura el trayecto en ferry hasta La Graciosa?
El ferry a La Graciosa tarda unos 35-40 minutos en llegar, ya que reducimos la velocidad para que pueda disfrutar de las vistas de la cara norte de Lanzarote.
¿Está incluido el ferry de Lanzarote a La Graciosa?
Sí, los billetes de ferry de ida y vuelta a La Graciosa están incluidos en el precio.
¿Están incluidas las actividades acuáticas?
Sí, las actividades acuáticas están incluidas en el precio.
¿Qué actividades acuáticas se ofrecen?
Hay toboganes en el catamarán, colchonetas e hinchables en el mar, y kayak. Traiga sus propios tubos, ya que no podemos ofrecérselos debido a las restricciones de Covid-19.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo un total de 4 horas de principio a fin.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Se trata de un catamarán especial con bar interior y zona Chillout con cómodos asientos.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
Sí, este catamarán tiene dos aseos separados.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música Chillout a bordo. A veces incluso ponemos a la gente a bailar.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?

Sí, cuando el barco haya atracado y se activen las actividades acuáticas, se abrirán los toboganes y también podrá saltar al mar. Alternativamente, hay una rampa desde la que se puede caminar hasta el mar.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañador si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante, puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?

Servimos una paella tradicional local hecha con arroz y verduras. El marisco y la carne se cocinan por separado y se añaden por encima si el cliente lo desea. También damos la opción de una simple pasta con salsa de tomate.
¿Necesita algún régimen alimenticio?
Póngase en contacto con nuestro servicio de atención al cliente o deje un comentario en las notas en el momento de hacer la reserva.
¿Están incluidas las bebidas?
Sí, las bebidas están incluidas para todo lo que puedas beber, y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas sin alcohol. También se sirve un mojito de bienvenida después de subir al barco.
¿Cuánto tiempo libre tengo en La Graciosa?
Le damos aproximadamente 40 minutos de tiempo libre en La Graciosa. Es tiempo suficiente para explorar el pueblo de Caleta del Sebo e incluso visitar su antigua iglesia.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede traer comida, pero también tenemos aperitivos y almuerzo recién cocinado servido a bordo.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay aseos en todas las paradas que hacemos.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 7 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el autobús?
La excursión se realiza dentro y fuera del autobús. El tiempo máximo de viaje en autobús es de 40 minutos.
¿Está permitido nadar?
Sí, tienes tiempo de sobra para ir a la playa, zambullirte y relajarte junto a la arena dorada y tomar un poco el sol.
¿Cuánto dura el trayecto en ferry hasta La Graciosa?
El ferry tarda unos 30-35 minutos en llegar a La Graciosa y volver.
¿Hay restaurantes y bares en La Graciosa?
Sí, hay algunos chiringuitos y restaurantes.

overview.en:
Discover the Magic of Lobos Island and the Dolphins of Lanzarote on Our Exclusive Cruise
Embark on an enchanting journey with Excursions Tickets Direct, where the pristine waters of Lanzarote serve as your gateway to the mystical Lobos Island and the captivating world of dolphins. Our "Lobos Island & Dolphins Cruise" promises an adventure filled with breathtaking scenery, wildlife encounters, and peaceful moments in nature's embrace, perfect for families, wildlife aficionados, and anyone looking to escape into the beauty of the Canarian archipelago.

Why Choose Our Lobos Island & Dolphins Cruise?
As soon as you step aboard our state-of-the-art Biosfera boat, you'll be transported into a world where the azure waves whisper tales of the ocean's wonders. Our vessel, equipped with the latest amenities and staffed by our expert crew, ensures a comfortable and safe journey along the picturesque coasts of Lanzarote and Fuerteventura.

The Dolphins of Lanzarote: A Spectacular Sight
One of the highlights of your cruise will be the thrilling opportunity to witness dolphins in their natural habitat. Known for their playful nature and intelligence, dolphins near Lanzarote glide gracefully through the water, often coming close to our boat, offering perfect photo opportunities and unforgettable moments. The waters around Lanzarote are a renowned habitat for diverse marine life, making every cruise a unique experience where sightings of dolphins—and occasionally whales—are a cherished spectacle.

Lobos Island: A Pristine Paradise
After meeting our friendly dolphin companions, we'll navigate towards the serene Lobos Island. This tiny, unspoiled island lies just a stone's throw from Fuerteventura and is a protected nature reserve, famed for its crystal-clear waters, rich marine life, and tranquil landscapes. Upon arrival, you'll have ample time to explore this idyllic locale. Whether you choose to sunbathe on its sandy shores, snorkel in the inviting waters teeming with colorful fish, or simply enjoy a leisurely walk along its rugged pathways, Lobos Island offers a perfect retreat into nature.

Engage in a Variety of Activities Beyond dolphin watching and exploring Lobos Island, our cruise offers a range of activities designed to enhance your experience. Opt for a guided snorkeling tour to discover the underwater marvels of the island, or engage in a light-hearted beach volleyball game with fellow travelers. For those who seek relaxation, find a quiet spot on the deck to soak in the panoramic views and gentle sea breezes.

Ideal for Every Adventurer
Our "Lobos Island & Dolphins Cruise" is meticulously crafted to cater to both the adventurous spirit and the soul seeking tranquility. It's an ideal choice for families with children, couples on a romantic getaway, or nature enthusiasts eager to witness the rich biodiversity of the Canary Islands.

Join Us for a Memorable Day
Book your spot on our exclusive "Lobos Island & Dolphins Cruise" and immerse yourself in the extraordinary natural beauty of Lobos Island and the exhilarating sight of dolphins frolicking in the wild. This cruise is not just a trip; it's an opportunity to create lasting memories, connect with nature, and discover the hidden gems of Lanzarote.

For more information and to secure your reservation, visit our website at Excursions Tickets Direct or contact our friendly customer service team. We are excited to welcome you aboard and share this incredible adventure with you!
overview.es: Embárquese en una aventura inolvidable a bordo de nuestro barco Biosfera totalmente equipado mientras buscamos y nos encontramos con delfines y ballenas a lo largo de las impresionantes costas de Lanzarote. Nuestro viaje nos lleva al paraíso virgen de la isla de Lobos, enclavada entre Fuerteventura y Lanzarote. Aquí dispondrá de mucho tiempo libre para relajarse y explorar esta pequeña isla, sumergiéndose en su belleza natural. Un día de aventuras ideal para los amantes de la naturaleza y la vida salvaje y las familias con niños.

en: Where and what time will i get picked up?

We have Tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen and Costa
Teguise, we can also pick up in Arrecife,  Playa Honda and Yaiza.
Pick up points are in  hotels or the next door resort.
Pick up starts at 08:30 in every resort, tell us where you're staying and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn't have pick up.
How far are the pick up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnB's?
Not exactly, however we do pick at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your  exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English,  Spanish,  German and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where / when and how can i pay the balance?
Customers have 2 options , you can either pay in full at the time of booking or you can pay at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using credit card or cash.
How long are we on the coach?
The journey to Puerto del Carmen is approximately 1520 Minutes depending where you're staying.
Can i go straight to the harbour?
Yes, you can go straight to the harbour with a booking and ticket.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for approximately 3 hours.
Are there any shades on the boat?
Yes, all seats on board are under shade.
Are there any toilets on board?
No, there are no toilets on board , we recommend customers to go to the toilet before boarding or wait 45 minutes untill we reach Lobos Island.
Is there any music on board?
Yes , we have Chilout music on board.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
No, this is strictly forbidden for your own safety.
What sort of clothes do i need?
We recommend comfortable clothing , hats, sunglasses,  beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant they can join us.
What food is included ?
We offer a picnic with a selection of sandwiches beverages and dessert.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment on notes at the time of booking.
Am i allowed to bring food ?
Yes , you can bring food but we will offer picnic lunch on this tour .
How long is the Excursion?
The tour lasts around 6 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off, bringing you back around 16:00 o'clock.
How much time do we have at Lobos Island?
We give 2 hours of leisure time at Lobos Island , enough time to walk 20 minutes to the Lagoons in the north to have a swim , have ypur lunch and relax before walking back to the harbour.
Are there any shops, bars or restaurants in Lobos Island?
Yes, theres one restaurant in Lobos Island,  which is by the beach,  ideal to visit for a drink and relax by the sea although there are no shops as the island is a protected reserve.
Is swimming allowed?
Yes , certainly,  Lobos offers crystalclear lagoons where can take a refreshing bath.
Are we guaranteed to see dolphins or whales?
We have a very experienced sailors always looking out with their binoculars to spot any movement in the sea and we guarantee 80% of chance to see dolphins and whales.

Sí, todos los asientos a bordo están a la sombra.

No, no hay aseos a bordo, recomendamos a los clientes ir al aseo antes de embarcar o esperar 45 minutos hasta llegar a la Isla de Lobos.

Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante puede unirse a nosotros.

Sí, puede traer comida, pero en esta excursión le ofreceremos un almuerzo tipo picnic.

La excursión dura unas 6 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00 horas.

overview.en:
Discover the enchanting world of marine wildlife with our "Lanzarote Dolphins & Whales Watching" tour. This unique adventure offers you the extraordinary opportunity to witness the grace and beauty of dolphins and whales in their natural habitat around the pristine waters of Lanzarote.

Begin your journey aboard the vibrant yellow Biosfera Express, a vessel tailor-made for marine observation. As you set sail from the coast, our knowledgeable guides will share fascinating insights about the types of dolphins and whales that grace these waters, including the playful Bottlenose Dolphins and the awe-inspiring Blue Whales.

The tour is perfectly timed to coincide with the magical sunset hours, ensuring you experience the serene beauty of Lanzarote's coastline bathed in golden hues. The Biosfera Express features state-of-the-art facilities and spacious viewing decks, allowing for unparalleled views of the marine life as well as the stunning volcanic landscapes of Lanzarote.

Safety and comfort are our top priorities. The vessel is equipped with all necessary safety gear, and our crew is trained to provide first-aid assistance, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience for all ages. Complimentary refreshments are available on board, allowing you to stay hydrated and refreshed as you scan the horizon for these magnificent creatures.

Booking your tour in advance is highly recommended as spots fill up quickly due to the popularity of this once-in-a-lifetime experience. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, a family looking for an educational trip, or a photographer eager to capture the majestic beauty of dolphins and whales, this tour promises not to disappoint.

For those interested in further exploration, the tour also provides brief stops at select points along the coast, where you can learn more about the rich biodiversity of Lanzarote and its marine ecosystems.

Join us on the "Lanzarote Dolphins & Whales Watching" tour and create unforgettable memories as you explore the vibrant and bustling life beneath the waves. Witness firsthand the playful antics of dolphins and the majestic presence of whales, making this more than just a tour—it's an immersive experience into the world of marine wildlife.

Disfrute de las impresionantes vistas de la puesta de sol mientras vigila a estas majestuosas criaturas. Reserve con antelación y asegure sus plazas.

en.text: Get a convenient pick-up and journey 20 minutes to the Puerto del Carmen Harbour.

en.title: Embark on our boat as we begin our exciting quest to spot whales and dolphins
en.text: Sit back, relax, and delight in the breathtaking views of Lanzarote’s coast while our experienced sailors guide you on a captivating sightseeing expedition in search of dolphins and whales.

en.title: Lanzarote’s Dolphins & Whales
en.text:
Lanzarote Dolphins are known for their playful nature and graceful movements. They offer a mesmerizing sight. These friendly dolphins are accustomed to spotting our vibrant yellow Biosfera boat. They never fail to greet us and joyfully glide alongside us as the sun sets.
Lanzarote is also home to magnificent whales that grace its waters. These majestic creatures captivate with their immense size and gentle presence.
Don’t miss the chance to witness these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.

en.title: Enjoy breathtaking sunset views with a glass of champagne
en.text: Head back to the coast and stop to give you time to indulge in some pastries and a glass of champagne that you can sip while you soak in the sunset and serene atmosphere.

en.title: Head back to the harbor and get the coach to your collection point
en.text: As the sun sets, we conclude our journey by heading back to the harbor, where you take the coach to get dropped off at the collection point.

es.title: Recogida en el alojamiento o en el punto de recogida más cercano
es.text: Consiga que le recojan cómodamente y viaje 20 minutos hasta el puerto de Puerto del Carmen.

es.title: Embarque en nuestro barco para comenzar nuestra emocionante búsqueda de ballenas y delfines.
es.text: Siéntese, relájese y deléitese con las impresionantes vistas de la costa de Lanzarote mientras nuestros experimentados marineros le guían en una cautivadora expedición turística en busca de delfines y ballenas.

es.title: Delfines y ballenas de Lanzarote
es.text:
Los delfines de Lanzarote son conocidos por su naturaleza juguetona y sus gráciles movimientos. Ofrecen un espectáculo fascinante. Estos simpáticos delfines están acostumbrados a ver nuestro barco Biosfera de color amarillo vibrante. Nunca dejan de saludarnos y se deslizan alegremente a nuestro lado mientras se pone el sol.
Lanzarote también alberga magníficas ballenas que engalanan sus aguas. Estas majestuosas criaturas cautivan por su inmenso tamaño y amable presencia.
No pierda la oportunidad de contemplar a estas magníficas criaturas en su hábitat natural.

es.title: Disfrute de las impresionantes vistas de la puesta de sol con una copa de champán
es.text: Vuelva a la costa y deténgase para que le dé tiempo a deleitarse con unos pasteles y una copa de champán que podrá sorber mientras se empapa de la puesta de sol y de la serena atmósfera.

es.title: Vuelva al puerto y coja el autocar hasta su punto de recogida
es.text: Al ponerse el sol, concluiremos nuestro viaje regresando al puerto, donde tomaremos el autocar para que nos deje en el punto de recogida.

en: Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pickup points are in hotels or the nextdoor resort.
Pickup starts at 16:30 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pickup.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where/when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay the balance on the day after collection. We accept credit card and cash payments.
How long are we on the coach?
The journey to Puerto del Carmen is approximately 1520 minutes, depending on where you’re staying.
Can I go straight to the harbor?
Yes, you can go straight to the harbor with a booking and ticket.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for approximately 2.5 hours from start to finish.
Are there any shades on the boat?
Yes, all seats on board are under shade.
Are there any toilets on board?
No, there are no toilets on board. We recommend customers to go to the toilet before boarding or wait 45 minutes until we reach Lobos Island.
Is there any music on board?
Yes, we have chillout music on board.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
No, this is strictly forbidden for your own safety.
What sort of clothes do I need?
We recommend comfortable clothing, trainers, hats, sunglasses, beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim, and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
What food is included?
We offer pastries and champagne.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food, but we will offer a picnic lunch on this tour.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts around 4 hours from the time of pickup to the time of dropoff, bringing you back around 16:00.
Is swimming allowed?
No, we do not allow swimming on this excursion.
Are we guaranteed to see dolphins or whales?

We have very high chances as we have a team of very experienced sailors always looking out with their binoculars to spot any movement in the sea, and we guarantee an 80% chance to see dolphins and whales.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 16:30 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde, cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden pagar el saldo al día siguiente de la recogida. Aceptamos pagos con tarjeta de crédito y en efectivo.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hasta Puerto del Carmen es de aproximadamente 15-20 minutos, dependiendo de dónde se aloje.
¿Puedo ir directamente al puerto?
Sí, puede ir directamente al puerto con reserva y billete.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo aproximadamente 2,5 horas de principio a fin.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Sí, todos los asientos a bordo están a la sombra.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
No, no hay aseos a bordo. Recomendamos a los clientes que vayan al baño antes de embarcar o que esperen 45 minutos hasta que lleguemos a la isla de Lobos.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música chillout a bordo.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?
No, está estrictamente prohibido por su propia seguridad.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, zapatillas de deporte, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañador si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante, puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?
Ofrecemos bollería y champán.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede traer comida, pero en esta excursión le ofreceremos un almuerzo tipo picnic.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 4 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00.
¿Está permitido nadar?
No, no se permite nadar en esta excursión.
¿Está garantizado que veremos delfines o ballenas?

Tenemos muchas posibilidades, ya que contamos con un equipo de marineros muy experimentados que siempre están atentos con sus prismáticos para detectar cualquier movimiento en el mar, y garantizamos un 80% de posibilidades de ver delfines y ballenas.

overview.en:
Experience the magic of Lanzarote on our exclusive "Sunset & Dolphins Cruise" from Excursions Tickets Direct. As you sail along the stunning coast aboard the vibrant yellow Biosfera Express, a catamaran engineered specifically for optimal marine life viewing, prepare for an evening filled with wonder and natural beauty. This tour is not just a boat ride; it's an adventure that combines the serenity of sunset views with the thrilling possibility of encountering dolphins in their natural habitat.

Our cruise begins with a warm welcome aboard by our friendly and knowledgeable crew, who are passionate about marine life and eager to share their insights with you. As the catamaran sets sail, the coastline of Lanzarote unfolds in a spectacular display of cliffs, caves, and azure waters. The highlight of the trip is undoubtedly the chance to see dolphins frolicking in the ocean. These playful creatures are often seen jumping above the water surface or riding the bow wave of the catamaran, providing perfect photo opportunities and unforgettable memories.

The "Sunset & Dolphins Cruise" is designed to offer more than just sightseeing. It's a chance to learn about the rich marine ecosystem of Lanzarote, thanks to our expert guides who explain the behaviors and habitats of dolphins and other marine species encountered during the cruise. As the sun begins to set, the sky turns a palette of fiery colors, setting the perfect backdrop for the evening. Enjoy the tranquil atmosphere as you sip on a complimentary beverage, bask in the golden glow of the sunset, and keep an eye out for the dolphins that may grace us with their presence.

This tour is ideal for families, couples, and wildlife enthusiasts who are looking to experience a unique side of Lanzarote. The Biosfera Express is equipped with all the amenities to ensure a comfortable and safe journey, including spacious viewing decks, seating areas, and refreshment facilities. With a commitment to sustainability and respect for wildlife, our "Sunset & Dolphins Cruise" offers an eco-friendly way to explore and appreciate the ocean's wonders.

Don't miss this opportunity to witness one of nature's most enchanting spectacles on our sunset catamaran cruise. Book your tickets now through Excursions Tickets Direct to secure your spot on this popular tour. Advance booking is highly recommended as spaces fill quickly. Join us and create lasting memories of Lanzarote's picturesque sunset and the delightful dolphins that call these waters home.

en.title: Pick-up from accommodation or nearest pick-up point
en.text: Get a convenient pick-up and journey 20 minutes to the Puerto del Carmen Harbour.

en.title: Embark on our boat as we begin our exciting quest to spot whales and dolphins
en.text: Sit back, relax, and delight in the breathtaking views of Lanzarote’s coast while our experienced sailors guide you on a captivating sightseeing expedition in search of dolphins and whales.

en.title: Lanzarote’s Dolphins & Whales
en.text:
Lanzarote Dolphins are known for their playful nature and graceful movements. They offer a mesmerizing sight. These friendly dolphins are accustomed to spotting our vibrant yellow Biosfera boat. They never fail to greet us and joyfully glide alongside us as the sun sets.
Lanzarote is also home to magnificent whales that grace its waters. These majestic creatures captivate with their immense size and gentle presence.
Don’t miss the chance to witness these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.

en.title: Enjoy breathtaking sunset views with a glass of champagne
en.text: Head back to the coast and stop to give you time to indulge in some pastries and a glass of champagne that you can sip while you soak in the sunset and serene atmosphere.

en.title: Head back to the harbor and get the coach to your collection point
en.text: As the sun sets, we conclude our journey by heading back to the harbor, where you take the coach to get dropped off at the collection point.

es.title: Recogida en el alojamiento o en el punto de recogida más cercano
es.text: Consiga que le recojan cómodamente y viaje 20 minutos hasta el puerto de Puerto del Carmen.

es.title: Embarque en nuestro barco para comenzar nuestra emocionante búsqueda de ballenas y delfines.
es.text: Siéntese, relájese y deléitese con las impresionantes vistas de la costa de Lanzarote mientras nuestros experimentados marineros le guían en una cautivadora expedición turística en busca de delfines y ballenas.

es.title: Delfines y ballenas de Lanzarote
es.text:
Los delfines de Lanzarote son conocidos por su naturaleza juguetona y sus gráciles movimientos. Ofrecen un espectáculo fascinante. Estos simpáticos delfines están acostumbrados a ver nuestro barco Biosfera de color amarillo vibrante. Nunca dejan de saludarnos y se deslizan alegremente a nuestro lado mientras se pone el sol.
Lanzarote también alberga magníficas ballenas que engalanan sus aguas. Estas majestuosas criaturas cautivan por su inmenso tamaño y amable presencia.
No pierda la oportunidad de contemplar a estas magníficas criaturas en su hábitat natural.

es.title: Disfrute de las impresionantes vistas de la puesta de sol con una copa de champán
es.text: Vuelva a la costa y deténgase para que le dé tiempo a deleitarse con unos pasteles y una copa de champán que podrá sorber mientras se empapa de la puesta de sol y de la serena atmósfera.

es.title: Vuelva al puerto y coja el autocar hasta su punto de recogida
es.text: Al ponerse el sol, concluiremos nuestro viaje regresando al puerto, donde tomaremos el autocar para que nos deje en el punto de recogida.

en: Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pickup points are in hotels or the nextdoor resort.
Pickup starts at 16:30 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pickup.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where/when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay the balance on the day after collection. We accept credit card and cash payments.
How long are we on the coach?
The journey to Puerto del Carmen is approximately 1520 minutes, depending on where you’re staying.
Can I go straight to the harbor?
Yes, you can go straight to the harbor with a booking and ticket.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for approximately 2.5 hours from start to finish.
Are there any shades on the boat?
Yes, all seats on board are under shade.
Are there any toilets on board?
No, there are no toilets on board. We recommend customers to go to the toilet before boarding or wait 45 minutes until we reach Lobos Island.
Is there any music on board?
Yes, we have chillout music on board.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
No, this is strictly forbidden for your own safety.
What sort of clothes do I need?
We recommend comfortable clothing, trainers, hats, sunglasses, beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim, and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
What food is included?
We offer pastries and champagne.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food, but we will offer a picnic lunch on this tour.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts around 4 hours from the time of pickup to the time of dropoff, bringing you back around 16:00.
Is swimming allowed?
No, we do not allow swimming on this excursion.
Are we guaranteed to see dolphins or whales?

We have very high chances as we have a team of very experienced sailors always looking out with their binoculars to spot any movement in the sea, and we guarantee an 80% chance to see dolphins and whales.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 16:30 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde, cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden pagar el saldo al día siguiente de la recogida. Aceptamos pagos con tarjeta de crédito y en efectivo.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hasta Puerto del Carmen es de aproximadamente 15-20 minutos, dependiendo de dónde se aloje.
¿Puedo ir directamente al puerto?
Sí, puede ir directamente al puerto con reserva y billete.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo aproximadamente 2,5 horas de principio a fin.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Sí, todos los asientos a bordo están a la sombra.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
No, no hay aseos a bordo. Recomendamos a los clientes que vayan al baño antes de embarcar o que esperen 45 minutos hasta que lleguemos a la isla de Lobos.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música chillout a bordo.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?
No, está estrictamente prohibido por su propia seguridad.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, zapatillas de deporte, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañador si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante, puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?
Ofrecemos bollería y champán.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede traer comida, pero en esta excursión le ofreceremos un almuerzo tipo picnic.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 4 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00.
¿Está permitido nadar?
No, no se permite nadar en esta excursión.
¿Está garantizado que veremos delfines o ballenas?

Tenemos muchas posibilidades, ya que contamos con un equipo de marineros muy experimentados que siempre están atentos con sus prismáticos para detectar cualquier movimiento en el mar, y garantizamos un 80% de posibilidades de ver delfines y ballenas.

overview.en:
Welcome Aboard the Katfish Premium Boat Cruises – Your Ultimate Fishing Adventure in Lanzarote

Experience the thrill of deep-sea fishing with Katfish Premium Boat Cruises, the top choice for fishing enthusiasts looking to explore the abundant waters of Lanzarote. Our four-hour excursions are designed to transport you from the luxurious Millionaires Marina to the stunning vistas of Papagato Bay, offering a unique blend of relaxation and adventure.

Exceptional Fishing Experience

Our tours are tailored for both novice and experienced anglers. The waters around Lanzarote are teeming with a variety of fish species, making it an ideal spot for fishing. Whether you're looking to battle it out with a fierce marlin or simply relax while catching some local snapper, our expert crew will provide all the guidance and equipment you need for a successful outing. "Pesca en barco en Lanzarote" is not just an activity; it's an adventure that you'll cherish for a lifetime.

Unparalleled Comfort and Style

The Katfish is a state-of-the-art vessel equipped with the latest fishing technology and comforts designed to enhance your cruising experience. Relax in the plush seating and enjoy panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, or sunbathe on the deck as we navigate the clear blue waters. With a small group setting, you'll receive personalized attention that ensures a memorable day out on the water.

Dolphin Sightings and Water Sports

Beyond fishing, our cruise offers the chance to encounter majestic dolphins in their natural habitat. These playful creatures are a common sight in the waters around Papagato Bay and provide spectacular photo opportunities. For the more adventurous, we also offer an array of watersports activities. Dive into the crystal-clear waters for snorkeling, or feel the adrenaline rush with some high-speed jet skiing.

Gourmet Barbecue Lunch

After working up an appetite, enjoy a freshly prepared barbecue lunch on board. Our menu features local delicacies and fresh catch cooked to perfection, accompanied by a selection of beverages from our all-inclusive bar. It’s the perfect way to relax and refuel as you soak in the breathtaking scenery and ocean breeze.

Why Choose Katfish Premium Boat Cruises?

  • Expert guides and crew with extensive local knowledge
  • State-of-the-art fishing equipment included
  • Small group sizes ensuring a personalized experience
  • A chance to see dolphins and other marine life
  • Inclusive of all activities with no hidden fees
  • Fresh, locally sourced food and drinks


Embark on your fishing journey with Katfish Premium Boat Cruises, where the crystal waters of Lanzarote await. Book your adventure today and create memories that will last a lifetime. Visit us at ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com to secure your spot on this exclusive tour.

es.title: Parascending - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with our exclusive Parascending experience in Lanzarote. Offered by ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com, this tour is the ultimate way to experience the thrill of flight and enjoy unparalleled views of Lanzarote's stunning coastal landscapes, particularly the picturesque Puerto del Carmen area.

Parascending is an exhilarating aerial sport where you're towed behind a boat while attached to a specially designed canopy wing that resembles a parachute. As the boat speeds off, you gently lift off from the launch pad and ascend into the sky, experiencing the freedom of flight. Our Lanzarote Parascending adventure guarantees not just excitement but safety, with experienced instructors and state-of-the-art equipment ensuring a joyful and secure flight every time.

Why choose Lanzarote for parascending? Lanzarote's unique landscape, characterized by volcanic mountains and crystal-clear blue waters, makes it an ideal backdrop for aerial activities. The gentle breezes and favorable weather conditions almost year-round provide perfect settings for parascending. From your unique vantage point in the sky, you will witness breathtaking panoramas of the island and the vast Atlantic that surrounds it.

Our tour departs daily from the heart of Puerto del Carmen, a vibrant location known for its beautiful beaches and lively atmosphere. Before takeoff, our skilled team will provide you with a comprehensive briefing, covering safety procedures and what to expect during your flight. Whether you are a first-timer or a seasoned enthusiast, our parascending experience is designed to cater to all skill levels.

The flight duration is approximately 10 minutes, but the memories will last a lifetime. As you soar up to 400 feet above the surface, feel the exhilaration as the wind rushes past you and the scenic beauty of Lanzarote unfolds beneath. After your flight, you can relax on the boat and watch others as they glide through the air, or simply enjoy the sun on your face and the gentle motion of the waves.

Booking your Parascending adventure in Lanzarote with ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com is easy and convenient. Visit our website to select your preferred date and time, and secure your spot with just a few clicks. We pride ourselves on providing excellent customer service and an unforgettable experience that has made us a top choice for visitors seeking unique and thrilling activities in Lanzarote.
overview.es: Experimente la emoción del parascending en Lanzarote, donde la aventura se une a las impresionantes vistas de la impresionante costa de Puerto del Carmen.
