journey, unveiling the mesmerizing coastlines of Lanzarote from a breathtaking vantage point.

en.title: Conclude the adventure with our return to the harbor
en.text: After your exhilarating parascending experience, take a moment to unwind and savor the leisurely boat ride back to the harbor. This tranquil journey will mark the conclusion of your thrilling adventure. Before you depart, don’t forget to visit our shop and peruse the collection of memorable photos available, allowing you to take a piece of this incredible experience with you.

es.title: Reciba unas breves instrucciones y suba a bordo de nuestra moderna lancha rápida
es.text: A su llegada a nuestro centro, le daremos unas instrucciones de seguridad concisas, le proporcionaremos un chaleco salvavidas y le guiaremos hasta nuestra lancha rápida de última generación, equipada específicamente para las aventuras de parascending.

es.title: Disfrute de una estimulante experiencia de Parascending
es.text:
Una vez que salgamos del puerto, nuestros expertos instructores le ayudarán a ponerse el equipo y despegar para un vuelo emocionante. Embárquese en un cautivador viaje aéreo
que desvela las fascinantes costas de Lanzarote desde un punto de vista impresionante.

es.title: Concluye la aventura con nuestro regreso al puerto
es.text: Después de su estimulante experiencia en parapente, tómese un momento para relajarse y saborear el tranquilo paseo en barco de vuelta al puerto. Este tranquilo viaje marcará el final de su emocionante aventura. Antes de partir, no olvide visitar nuestra tienda y echar un vistazo a la colección de fotos memorables disponibles, que le permitirán llevarse consigo un pedazo de esta increíble experiencia.

en: How can I get to the starting point?
We can book you a taxi service that will drop you off at the starting point.
How much does a taxi cost?

This depends on where you’re staying:
Customers staying in Playa Blanca can do the activity in Playa Blanca, and the taxi service cost is approximately 5€.
Customers staying in Puerto del Carmen can do the activity in Puerto del Carmen, and the taxi costs are approximately 58€.
Customers staying in Costa Teguise have to go to Puerto del Carmen, taxi costs are approximately 20-30€.
NOTE that the maximum amount of people a taxi can hold is 8 passengers.
Are there any public bus services?

Yes, there are public bus services:
From Costa Teguise, there is a direct line, the bus number 03 takes you to Puerto del Carmen, and it takes roughly 40 minutes to 1 hour. The bus from Costa Teguise costs around 3€ per person, please consult us at the time of booking, and we will forward you all the information needed with the ticket confirmation.
Is the starting point, walking distance from Playa Blanca Center?
Yes, it is only 10 minutes walk if you are staying in the center of Playa Blanca. We recommend those of you that stay at the far ends to get a taxi.
Is the starting point, walking distance from the Old Town of Puerto del Carmen?
Yes, the activity speed boats leave from the port or from the harbor.
How and when do I pay the balance?
The balance can be paid in cash or using a credit card on the Excursion before the start of the activity.
In which language is the activity?
We have instructors that speak English, Spanish, German & French.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can go as you please, we recommend swimming costumes and towels in case you get wet.
Do I land on the sea?
No, our instructors will pull you back down to the speed boat.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring your food if you wish.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilets in the harbor.
Do we provide wetsuits?
Wetsuits are not required for this activity.
Is it hard to do this activity?
Not at all, you just relax and let our instructors do all the job for you.
Is parascending dangerous?
No,  this is a very safe activity although we don’t recommend it to people that suffer from vertigo or are scared of heights.
What is the minimum age to do Parascending?
The minimum age to do Parascending is 8 years old and an adult has to go with the kids.
How many people can go on the same flight?
The maximum capacity is of 3 people but the total weight has to be under 150kg.
Can passenger come on board to watch?
Yes, anyone is welcome on board, we charge an extra 20€ per person with a maximum of 2 passengers.
es: ¿Cómo puedo llegar al punto de partida?
Podemos reservarle un servicio de taxi que le dejará en el punto de partida.
¿Cuánto cuesta un taxi?

Depende de dónde te alojes:
Los clientes alojados en Playa Blanca pueden realizar la actividad en Playa Blanca, y el coste del servicio de taxi es de aproximadamente 5€.
Los clientes alojados en Puerto del Carmen pueden realizar la actividad en Puerto del Carmen, y el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 58€.
Los clientes alojados en Costa Teguise tienen que ir a Puerto del Carmen, el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 20-30€.
TENGA EN CUENTA que el número máximo de personas que puede llevar un taxi es de 8 pasajeros.
¿Hay servicios públicos de autobús?

Sí, hay servicios públicos de autobús:
Desde Costa Teguise, hay una línea directa, el autobús número 03 te lleva a Puerto del Carmen, y tarda aproximadamente entre 40 minutos y 1 hora. El autobús desde Costa Teguise cuesta alrededor de 3€ por persona, por favor consúltenos en el momento de la reserva, y le enviaremos toda la información necesaria con la confirmación del billete.
¿El punto de partida está a poca distancia del centro de Playa Blanca?
Sí, está a sólo 10 minutos a pie si se aloja en el centro de Playa Blanca. Recomendamos a los que se alojen en los extremos que tomen un taxi.
¿El punto de partida está a poca distancia del casco antiguo de Puerto del Carmen?
Sí, las lanchas rápidas de la actividad salen del puerto o de la dársena.
¿Cómo y cuándo pago el saldo?
El saldo puede pagarse en efectivo o con tarjeta de crédito en la excursión antes del inicio de la actividad.
¿En qué lengua se desarrolla la actividad?
Tenemos instructores que hablan inglés, español, alemán y francés.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, te recomendamos bañador y toalla por si te mojas.
¿Aterrizo en el mar?
No, nuestros instructores te llevarán de vuelta a la lancha motora.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede traer su comida si lo desea.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay aseos en el puerto.
¿Proporcionamos trajes de neopreno?
No se requieren trajes de neopreno para esta actividad.
¿Es difícil realizar esta actividad?
En absoluto, relájate y deja que nuestros instructores hagan todo el trabajo por ti.
¿Es peligroso el parascending?
No, se trata de una actividad muy segura aunque no la recomendamos a personas que sufran de vértigo o tengan miedo a las alturas.
¿Cuál es la edad mínima para hacer Parascending?
La edad mínima para hacer Parascending es de 8 años y un adulto tiene que ir con los niños.
¿Cuántas personas pueden ir en el mismo vuelo?
La capacidad máxima es de 3 personas, pero el peso total debe ser inferior a 150 kg.
¿Pueden subir pasajeros a bordo para observar?
Sí, cualquier persona es bienvenida a bordo, cobramos un suplemento de 20 € por persona con un máximo de 2 pasajeros.

en.description: Experience Lanzarote’s best boat cruise and watersports adventure. Enjoy Papagayo beaches, thrilling rides, and more!

es.title: Crucero en barco + deportes acuáticos - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Discover the ultimate Lanzarote boat cruise and watersports adventure with our exclusive 4-hour luxury Catamaran Cruise. Perfect for families, adventure seekers, and nature enthusiasts, this all-inclusive experience promises unforgettable memories filled with excitement and natural beauty.

Set sail from the picturesque Marina Rubicón, and feel the gentle breeze as you cruise along Lanzarote's stunning coastline. Your journey takes you to the pristine Papagayo beaches, renowned for their crystal-clear waters and golden sands. These idyllic spots are perfect for relaxation and soaking up the sun.

The adventure truly begins as you dive into a range of thrilling watersports activities. Whether you’re a seasoned water sports enthusiast or trying something new, there’s something for everyone:

  1. Kayaking: Paddle through the turquoise waters, exploring hidden coves and enjoying the serene surroundings.
  2. Snorkeling: Dive into the vibrant underwater world and encounter a variety of marine life. The clear waters around Papagayo beaches provide excellent visibility for a mesmerizing snorkeling experience.
  3. Stand-Up Paddle Boarding: Test your balance and glide over the calm waters, taking in the breathtaking coastal views from a unique perspective.
  4. Banana Boat Rides: Hold on tight as you bounce across the waves on this exhilarating ride. It's a thrilling experience that guarantees laughter and fun for all ages.
  5. Crazy Donut Rides: Brace yourself for high-speed spins and splashes as you ride the Crazy Donut. It’s an adrenaline-pumping adventure that will leave you wanting more.


Throughout the cruise, our friendly and professional crew will ensure your safety and comfort. They are passionate about sharing their knowledge of the area and making your experience truly memorable. Enjoy the luxury of our well-equipped catamaran, complete with shaded areas, sunbathing spots, and all the amenities you need for a comfortable and enjoyable trip.

Indulge in a delicious on-board meal and refreshing drinks, all included in the tour. Savor local specialties and international favorites while you relax and take in the stunning ocean views.

Why Choose Our Boat Cruise + Watersports?

  • Unique Experience: Combine a relaxing boat cruise with a variety of exciting watersports for a truly unique adventure.
  • Pristine Locations: Explore the famous Papagayo beaches, known for their natural beauty and clear waters.
  • Family-Friendly: Activities are suitable for all ages, making it a perfect outing for families.
  • Professional Crew: Our experienced crew ensures a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone.
  • All-Inclusive: Enjoy meals, drinks, and a range of watersports activities without any hidden costs.


Booking your adventure is simple. Visit our website at ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com and secure your spot on this unforgettable tour. Whether you're looking to relax, explore, or get your adrenaline pumping, our Boat Cruise + Watersports tour offers something for everyone.

Experience the best of Lanzarote from the water and create memories that will last a lifetime. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to see the island's most beautiful beaches and engage in thrilling watersports. Book now and embark on an adventure you'll never forget!
overview.es: Únase a nosotros para un emocionante crucero en barco en nuestro pequeño grupo de 4 horas todo incluido, de lujo Catarman Cruise con emocionantes Watersports.Take participar en emocionantes actividades acuáticas como kayak, snorkel, Crazy Donut, banana paseos en barco, y stand-up paddle boarding. Perfecto para familias y amantes de la naturaleza y los deportes acuáticos que buscan recuerdos inolvidables.

en: Local traditional tapa
You can drink and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer and non alcoholic beverages
es: Tapa tradicional local
Usted puede beber y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas no alcohólicas

en.title: Transfers from accommodation to Boat
en.text: Get a courtesy Pick-up from your accommodation door and journey 20 minutes to the Marina Puerto Calero where our luxury catamaran sets off from.

en.title: Sail to the Papagayo beaches
en.text: Get onboard, grab a complimentary drink and sit back and enjoy the views of the beautiful coastline of Lanzarote as we sail down to the famous Papagayo beaches.

en.title: Immerse yourself in range of Water Activities
en.text: Upon reaching Papagayo Bay, we anchor and present an array of water activities. Opt for kayaking, paddle boarding, or snorkeling to explore the clear waters and vibrant marine life of Lanzarote’s underwater world.

en.title: Partake on thrilling Banana Boat & Crazy Donut rides
en.text: Don’t miss out on the most thrilling experiences of the trip, Indulge in excitement with our exhilarating banana boat and crazy donut rides.

en.title: Lunch Break
en.text: After the exhilarating activities, treat yourself to a delightful variety of fresh tapas for lunch, accompanied by complimentary wines and soft drinks. Relax and rejuvenate under the sun before we begin our journey back to the marina.

en.title: Journey back to the Marina & get dropped off at your accommodation
en.text: Savor a tranquil moment, soaking in the picturesque views during our sail back to the port. Upon arrival, our transfer vans will be ready to take you to your accommodation, completing your memorable journey with us.

es.title: Traslados del alojamiento al barco
es.text: Recogida de cortesía en la puerta de su alojamiento y viaje 20 minutos hasta el puerto deportivo de Puerto Calero, desde donde zarpa nuestro catamarán de lujo.

es.title: Navegue hasta las playas de Papagayo
es.text: Suba a bordo, tome una bebida gratuita y siéntese a disfrutar de las vistas de la hermosa costa de Lanzarote mientras navegamos hacia las famosas playas de Papagayo.

es.title: Sumérjase en diversas actividades acuáticas
es.text: Al llegar a la bahía de Papagayo, anclamos y presentamos una serie de actividades acuáticas. Opte por el kayak, el paddle boarding o el snorkel para explorar las aguas cristalinas y la vibrante vida marina del mundo submarino de Lanzarote.

es.title: Participe en las emocionantes atracciones Banana Boat y Crazy Donut
es.text: No se pierda las experiencias más emocionantes del viaje, déjese llevar por la emoción con nuestros estimulantes paseos en banana boat y crazy donut rides.

es.title: Pausa para el almuerzo
es.text: Después de las emocionantes actividades, deléitese con una deliciosa variedad de tapas frescas para almorzar, acompañadas de vinos y refrescos de cortesía. Relájese y rejuvenezca bajo el sol antes de emprender el viaje de regreso al puerto deportivo.

es.title: Regreso al puerto deportivo y traslado a su alojamiento
es.text: Saboree un momento de tranquilidad, empapándose de las pintorescas vistas durante nuestra navegación de regreso al puerto. A su llegada, nuestras furgonetas de traslado estarán listas para llevarle a su alojamiento, completando así su memorable viaje con nosotros.

en: Where and what time will i get picked up?

Pick up points are in  hotels or the next door resort. Pick up starts at 09:30 in every resort, tell us where you’re staying and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick up.
How far are the pick up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnB’s?
Not exactly, however we do pick at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English,  Spanish,  German and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where / when and how can i pay the balance ?
Balance is paid at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using credit card or cash.
How long are we on the coach?
The journey to Puerto Calero is approximately 1520 Minutes depending shere you’re staying.
Can i go straight to the harbour?
Yes, you can go straight to the harbour with a booking and ticket, we will send you GPS location of the meeting point with the booking confirmation.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for approximately 4 hours.
Are Water Activities included?
Yes, all Water Activities are included in the price.
What Water Activities are offered?
This boat trip offers Kayaks, Standup paddle, snorkeling equipment, Banana boat and Crazy donut.
Are there any age restrictions to go on any of the activities?
Yes, the minimum age to get on the banana boat and Crazy Donut rides is 8 years old.
Are there any shades on the boat?
Yes, there’s plenty of shades.
Are there any toilets on board?
Yes, there’s toilets on board this Catamaran.
Is there any music on board?
Yes , we have Chilout music on board.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
Yes , when the boat has docked and water activities are activated customers are allowed to jump in from the back of the boat.
What sort of clothes do i need?
We recommend comfortable clothing , hats, sunglasses, beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour ?
Yes as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant they can join us.
What food is included ?
We serve a variety of local traditional tapas.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment on notes at the time of booking.
Are drinks included ?
Yes, drinks are included for all you can drink and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer and non alcoholic beverages.
Am i allowed to bring food ?
Yes , you can bring food but you also have snacks and fresh cooked lunch served on board.
How long is the Excursion?
The tour lasts around 5 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off.
Can I go to the beach?
No, it is not recommended, but you can consult with guides if its safe to kayak.
What is the capacity of this boat?
The maximum capacity for this boat is 12 people.
Can I hire the boat out privately?
Yes, this boat can be hired to accommodate small groups of maximum 12 people, please head over to our private tours and boat hires section to get more information.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado. La recogida comienza a las 09:30 en todos los complejos, dinos dónde te alojas y te enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si tu hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo recogemos en su parada de autobús más cercana o en su hotel, envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta su parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma está la Excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
El saldo se paga en el momento de la recogida, a nuestros guías, el pago puede hacerse con tarjeta de crédito o en efectivo.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El viaje a Puerto Calero es de aproximadamente 1520 minutos dependiendo de donde se aloje.
¿Puedo ir directamente al puerto?
Sí, puede ir directamente al puerto con una reserva y un billete, le enviaremos la ubicación GPS del punto de encuentro con la confirmación de la reserva.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo aproximadamente 4 horas.
¿Están incluidas las actividades acuáticas?
Sí, todas las actividades acuáticas están incluidas en el precio.
¿Qué actividades acuáticas se ofrecen?
Esta excursión en barco ofrece Kayaks, Standup paddle, equipo de snorkel, Banana boat y Crazy donut.
¿Hay restricciones de edad para participar en alguna de las actividades?
Sí, la edad mínima para subir a las atracciones banana boat y Crazy Donut es de 8 años.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Sí, hay muchos matices.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
Sí, hay aseos a bordo de este catamarán.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música Chilout a bordo.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?
Sí, cuando el barco ha atracado y las actividades acuáticas están activadas, los clientes pueden saltar desde la parte trasera del barco.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañadores si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede alguien con movilidad reducida hacer este recorrido?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?
Servimos una gran variedad de tapas tradicionales locales.
¿Necesita algún régimen alimenticio?
Póngase en contacto con nuestro servicio de atención al cliente o deje un comentario en notas en el momento de hacer la reserva.
¿Están incluidas las bebidas?
Sí, las bebidas están incluidas para todo lo que puedas beber y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas no alcohólicas.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede llevar comida, pero también tiene aperitivos y comida recién hecha servida a bordo.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 5 horas, desde la recogida hasta el regreso.
¿Puedo ir a la playa?
No, no es recomendable, pero puede consultar con los guías si es seguro navegar en kayak.
¿Cuál es la capacidad de este barco?
La capacidad máxima de este barco es de 12 personas.
¿Puedo alquilar el barco de forma privada?
Sí, este barco puede alquilarse para grupos pequeños de un máximo de 12 personas. Visite nuestra sección de excursiones privadas y alquiler de barcos para obtener más información.

es.title: Surf - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Are you looking for an unforgettable surfing adventure in Lanzarote? Look no further! At ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com, we offer the ultimate surfing experience that combines relaxation, fitness, and the thrill of riding the waves. Whether you're a beginner or looking to improve your skills, our surfing tour is perfect for everyone.

Why Choose Our Surfing Tour in Lanzarote?

Lanzarote is a top destination for surfing enthusiasts from around the world. With its stunning beaches, perfect waves, and beautiful weather, it's the ideal place to learn and enjoy surfing. Our tour ensures you get the most out of your time in Lanzarote by offering a comprehensive package that caters to all your surfing needs.

What to Expect on Your Surfing Tour:

  1. 20-Minute Stretch & Yoga Session: Start your day with a rejuvenating 20-minute stretch and yoga session. This session is designed to prepare your body and mind for an exhilarating day on the waves. Stretching and yoga are essential for enhancing flexibility, balance, and focus, which are crucial for a successful surfing experience. Our experienced instructors will guide you through a series of poses and stretches that are specifically tailored for surfers.
  2. Surf Lesson: After the yoga session, it's time to hit the beach for your surf lesson. Our certified surf instructors are passionate about surfing and dedicated to providing a safe and enjoyable learning experience. They will teach you the basics of surfing, including paddling techniques, how to catch a wave, and the proper stance. For those with some experience, our instructors will offer advanced tips and tricks to help you improve your skills.


Why Surfing in Lanzarote is Unique:

Lanzarote's coastline offers a variety of surf spots suitable for all levels, from beginners to advanced surfers. The consistent swell and favorable wind conditions create the perfect environment for surfing year-round. Additionally, the island's volcanic landscape and crystal-clear waters provide a breathtaking backdrop for your surfing adventure.

Our Commitment to Safety and Enjoyment:

At ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com, your safety and enjoyment are our top priorities. We provide high-quality surfboards and wetsuits to ensure your comfort and safety in the water. Our instructors are not only skilled surfers but also certified in water safety and first aid. They will be with you every step of the way, offering guidance, support, and encouragement.

Join Us for an Unforgettable Surfing Experience:

Book your surfing tour with us today and discover why Lanzarote is a paradise for surfers. Whether you're looking to learn a new skill, meet fellow surf enthusiasts, or simply enjoy the thrill of riding the waves, our tour offers something for everyone. Don't miss out on this opportunity to create lasting memories and experience the best of surfing in Lanzarote.

Book Now and Ride the Waves:

Ready to embark on your surfing adventure? Visit our website at ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com to book your tour now. Our friendly team is here to answer any questions you may have and help you plan the perfect surfing experience. Join us for a day of fun, excitement, and relaxation on the beautiful beaches of Lanzarote. We can't wait to see you on the waves!

en.title: Get picked up outside your hotel
en.text: Experience the ultimate convenience as we pick you up right outside your accommodation. From there, we'll whisk you away to the famous surfer's paradise, Famara Beach, where our expert instructors will be ready and waiting with all the essential equipment.

en.title: Join a 20-minute stretch & Yoga session
en.text: Before hitting the waves, start your surf lesson with a rejuvenating yoga and stretching session to warm up your body and prepare for an exciting day of surfing.

en.title: Time to dive into the Surf lesson
en.text: Allow our experienced instructors to guide you in mastering surfboard handling and practicing on the beach before taking on the waves. Enjoy a dedicated two-hour private lesson to boost your confidence and catch those thrilling waves.

en.title: Free time to ride solo
en.text: Join our surfing groups to put your newly acquired skills to the test, perfect your technique, and ride the exhilarating waves like a pro.

en.title: Relax at the beach before heading back
en.text: After your thrilling surf adventure, take some time to savor a light snack, rehydrate, and recharge your energy before we return to drop you off.

es.title: Que te recojan en la puerta del hotel
es.text: Disfrute de la máxima comodidad mientras le recogemos en la puerta de su alojamiento. Desde allí, le llevaremos al famoso paraíso de los surfistas, la playa de Famara, donde nuestros expertos instructores le estarán esperando con todo el equipo necesario.

es.title: Participe en una sesión de Yoga y estiramientos de 20 minutos
es.text: Antes de lanzarse a las olas, comience su clase de surf con una rejuvenecedora sesión de yoga y estiramientos para calentar el cuerpo y prepararse para un emocionante día de surf.

es.title: Es hora de sumergirse en la lección de surf
es.text: Deje que nuestros experimentados instructores le guíen para dominar el manejo de la tabla de surf y practicar en la playa antes de lanzarse a las olas. Disfrute de una clase privada de dos horas para aumentar su confianza y coger esas emocionantes olas.

es.title: Tiempo libre para viajar en solitario
es.text: Únase a nuestros grupos de surf para poner a prueba sus recién adquiridas habilidades, perfeccionar su técnica y cabalgar las estimulantes olas como un profesional.

es.title: Relájese en la playa antes de regresar
es.text: Después de su emocionante aventura de surf, tómese su tiempo para saborear un ligero tentempié, rehidratarse y recargar energías antes de que volvamos a dejarle.

en: Where and what time will i get picked up?

Pick up points are in  hotels or the next door resort.
Pick up starts at 09:00 in every resort, tell us where you're staying and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn't have pick up.
How far are the pick up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnB's?
Not exactly, however we do pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English,  Spanish,  German and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where / when and how can i pay the balance ?
Balance is paid at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using credit card or cash.
Do I have to be a strong swimmer?
No, you only need to know how to swim.
Is surfing hard?
No, surfing is easy and the balancing comes with practice.
Are there any sharks?
No, there are no sharks in Lanzarote.
How long is the lesson?
Lessons last approximately 2 hours.
Is there an advanced lesson?
Yes, there lessons for advanced surfers.
Can I bring any food?
Yes, certainly you are allowed to bring whatever you need.
Does it last all day?
No, lesson finishes at 14:00 and we drop you off latest by 16:00.
Can I keep surfing after the lesson?
Yes, you are allowed to keep the equipment until we leave.
Can I drive to the beach?
Yes, let us know if you don't require pickup and we will send you the exact location where the activity will be held.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 09:00 en cada complejo turístico, díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de servicio de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?
No exactamente, sin embargo le recogemos en su parada de autobús u hotel más cercano, envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta su parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma está la Excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
El saldo se paga en el momento de la recogida, a nuestros guías, el pago puede hacerse con tarjeta de crédito o en efectivo.
¿Tengo que ser un buen nadador?
No, sólo necesitas saber nadar.
¿Es difícil surfear?
No, surfear es fácil y el equilibrio se consigue con la práctica.
¿Hay tiburones?
No, no hay tiburones en Lanzarote.
¿Cuánto dura la clase?
Las clases duran aproximadamente 2 horas.
¿Hay alguna lección avanzada?
Sí, hay clases para surfistas avanzados.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto que puede traer lo que necesite.
¿Dura todo el día?
No, la clase termina a las 14:00 y te dejamos como muy tarde a las 16:00.
¿Puedo seguir surfeando después de la clase?
Sí, puedes quedarte con el equipo hasta que nos vayamos.
¿Puedo ir a la playa en coche?
Sí, indícanos si no necesitas que te recojamos y te enviaremos el lugar exacto donde se celebrará la actividad.

es.title: Crucero Chillout Playa Blanca - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Discover the Ultimate Chillout Experience on Our Playa Blanca Cruise



Join us for a delightful small-group boat excursion that promises an unforgettable day on the crystal-clear waters of Lanzarote. Our Chillout Cruise Playa Blanca offers an exclusive 4-hour adventure, featuring an all-inclusive bar and a delicious barbecue, perfect for families, friends, and adventure seekers.

Set Sail to Papagayo Bay



Embark on our luxurious Chillout Cruise from Playa Blanca and sail to the stunning Papagayo Bay, known for its pristine beaches and tranquil waters. This hidden gem of Lanzarote provides the perfect backdrop for a day of relaxation and fun. As we anchor in the bay, you’ll be greeted by breathtaking views and the opportunity to dive into a variety of exciting water activities.

Thrilling Water Sports Await



Our Chillout Cruise Playa Blanca isn’t just about relaxation; it’s also about adventure. Choose from a selection of exhilarating watersports designed to cater to all levels of experience and excitement:

  • Snorkeling: Explore the vibrant underwater world teeming with marine life. The crystal-clear waters of Papagayo Bay offer excellent visibility, making it an ideal spot for snorkeling enthusiasts.
  • Kayaking: Grab a kayak and paddle around the serene bay. Whether you're a seasoned kayaker or a beginner, this activity is a fantastic way to enjoy the natural beauty of the area.
  • Paddleboarding: Test your balance and enjoy the calm waters with paddleboarding, a fun and engaging activity suitable for all ages.


Indulge in a Fresh Barbecue Lunch



No Chillout Cruise is complete without a sumptuous meal. Our onboard chef will prepare a mouth-watering barbecue lunch featuring fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Savor a variety of grilled meats, seafood, and vegetarian options, all while enjoying the serene surroundings of Papagayo Bay. Pair your meal with drinks from our all-inclusive bar, offering a selection of refreshing beverages, including soft drinks, beer, and wine.

All-Inclusive Comfort and Convenience



From the moment you step on board, our friendly and professional crew will ensure you have everything you need for a memorable day at sea. The Chillout Cruise Playa Blanca includes:

  • All-Inclusive Bar: Enjoy unlimited drinks throughout the cruise, ensuring you stay refreshed and hydrated.
  • Comfortable Seating: Relax on our spacious deck with comfortable seating areas, perfect for soaking up the sun or enjoying the shade.
  • Professional Crew: Our experienced crew is dedicated to providing exceptional service, ensuring your safety and comfort at all times.


Ideal for Families and Groups



The Chillout Cruise Playa Blanca is perfect for families, groups of friends, and couples looking to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The combination of relaxation and adventure makes it an ideal choice for creating lasting memories together.

Private Tours Available



For those seeking an even more personalized experience, we offer private tours with the option to hire the boat and a private skipper. This exclusive service allows you to customize your itinerary and enjoy a tailor-made adventure at your own pace. Visit our private tours section to request a quote and plan your perfect day on the water.

Book Your Chillout Cruise Today



Don’t miss out on the ultimate Chillout Cruise experience in Playa Blanca. Book your tour today and get ready to embark on a journey filled with relaxation, adventure, and unforgettable moments in the beautiful waters of Lanzarote.

en.title: Board rhe Chillout Cruise & sail to the Papagayo Bay
en.text: Embark on the Chillout Cruise from Playa Blanca Port and relish an open bar experience as you luxuriate in the scenic beauty of the southern coast. Sail leisurely to the renowned Papagayo Bay and look out for majestic Dolphins & Whales while savoring every moment of tranquility and picturesque views.

en.title: Choose between a selection of exciting Watersports
en.text: Upon reaching our destination and securing the dock, immerse yourself in a range of water activities. Seize the opportunity to navigate the pristine waters of Papagayo Bay with a kayak or paddleboard. Dlve into the underwater wonders through invigorating snorkeling sessions, unveiling the rich marine life beneath. Alternatively, unwind on the boat with a refreshing drink, and perhaps indulge in a bit of fishing at your leisure.

en.title: Indulge in a fresh barbecue lunch
en.text: While you're immersed in the fun, our dedicated team will be busy preparing a delectable barbecue on board. Indulge in a selection of meats, crisp salads, and enticing vegan dishes for a satisfying lunch that will recharge you after your thrilling water activities.

en.title: Sit back & bask in the sun as we sail back to the port
en.text: Following a delightful lunch, recline and rejuvenate under the sun's warmth as we smoothly sail back to the port, allowing you to recharge your energy in serene comfort.

es.title: Embarque en el Crucero Chillout y navegue hasta la Bahía de Papagayo
es.text: Embárquese en el Crucero Chillout desde el Puerto de Playa Blanca y disfrute de una experiencia de barra libre mientras se deleita con la belleza paisajística de la costa sur. Navegue tranquilamente hasta la famosa Bahía de Papagayo y observe los majestuosos delfines y ballenas mientras saborea cada momento de tranquilidad y vistas pintorescas.

es.title: Elija entre una selección de emocionantes deportes acuáticos
es.text: Al llegar a nuestro destino y asegurar el muelle, sumérjase en una serie de actividades acuáticas. Aproveche la oportunidad de navegar por las prístinas aguas de la bahía de Papagayo con un kayak o una tabla de paddle surf. Sumérjase en las maravillas submarinas mediante estimulantes sesiones de snorkel, que le descubrirán la rica vida marina que hay debajo. Si lo prefiere, relájese en el barco con una bebida refrescante y disfrute de un poco de pesca.

es.title: Disfrute de una barbacoa recién hecha
es.text: Mientras te sumerges en la diversión, nuestro entregado equipo se ocupará de preparar una deliciosa barbacoa a bordo. Deléitese con una selección de carnes, crujientes ensaladas y tentadores platos veganos para un almuerzo satisfactorio que le repondrá fuerzas después de sus emocionantes actividades acuáticas.

es.title: Siéntese y tome el sol mientras navegamos de vuelta al puerto
es.text: Tras un delicioso almuerzo, relájese y rejuvenezca bajo el calor del sol mientras navegamos suavemente de vuelta al puerto, permitiéndole recargar su energía con serena comodidad.

Special Catamaran Cruise: A Luxurious Adventure in Lanzarote



Embark on an Unforgettable Catamaran Cruise



Discover the ultimate way to explore Lanzarote's stunning coastline with our Special Catamaran Cruise. This 4-hour all-inclusive adventure offers luxury, excitement, and unforgettable memories. Set sail to the pristine Papagayo beaches, renowned for their crystal-clear waters and golden sands. This tour is perfect for families, water sports enthusiasts, and nature lovers alike.

Explore the Papagayo Beaches



Your journey begins with a scenic sail to the famous Papagayo beaches. As we glide across the turquoise waters, take in the breathtaking views of Lanzarote's rugged coastline. Upon arrival, you'll have ample time to relax on the beach, soak up the sun, and swim in the tranquil waters. The beauty of Papagayo will leave you mesmerized and rejuvenated.

Thrilling Water Activities



For those seeking adventure, our catamaran cruise offers a range of exciting water activities. Dive into the azure waters for a snorkeling experience like no other, where you can observe the vibrant marine life up close. Feel the thrill of kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding, perfect for exploring the serene waters at your own pace. For an adrenaline rush, hop on our Banana Boat and Crazy Donut rides. These thrilling experiences are sure to be a highlight of your trip.

Delicious Lunch Break



After an action-packed morning, enjoy a delicious lunch on board the catamaran. Our all-inclusive package ensures you are well taken care of, with a variety of delectable dishes to satisfy your appetite. Savor fresh, local ingredients prepared to perfection as you relax and take in the stunning surroundings. The lunch break is a perfect opportunity to refuel and prepare for more fun on the water.

Luxurious Catamaran Experience



Our luxury catamaran is equipped with all the amenities to ensure your comfort and enjoyment. With spacious decks, comfortable seating, and a friendly crew, you'll feel pampered from the moment you step on board. The catamaran is designed to provide a smooth and enjoyable sailing experience, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the beauty of Lanzarote.

Perfect for All Ages



Whether you're traveling with family, friends, or on a solo adventure, our Special Catamaran Cruise is suitable for all ages. Kids will love the exciting water activities, while adults can relax and unwind in the serene surroundings. The combination of adventure and relaxation makes this cruise an ideal choice for anyone looking to create lasting memories in Lanzarote.

Book Your Special Catamaran Cruise Today



Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to explore Lanzarote's coastline in style. Book your Special Catamaran Cruise today and experience the perfect blend of luxury, adventure, and natural beauty. With our all-inclusive package, you can relax and enjoy every moment, knowing that everything is taken care of. Visit our website, excursionsticketsdirect.com , to secure your spot on this unforgettable adventure.

overview.en: Are you ready to experience the ultimate blend of luxury, adventure, and natural beauty? Embark on our "I Love Papagayo Catamaran Cruise" for an unforgettable journey along the stunning coastlines of Lanzarote. Perfectly crafted for families, couples, and adventure seekers, this 4-hour all-inclusive luxury catamaran cruise promises a day of relaxation, excitement, and breathtaking views. Discover the Beauty of Papagayo Beaches Our journey begins as you board our luxurious catamaran, where comfort meets elegance. With plenty of space to lounge and relax, you’ll immediately feel the sense of calm that comes from being on the open sea. As we set sail, enjoy the spectacular views of the Atlantic Ocean and the unique volcanic landscape that Lanzarote is famous for. The gentle breeze and the soothing sounds of the waves set the perfect ambiance for a day out on the water. Our destination? The enchanting Papagayo Beaches, a series of golden sand coves with crystal-clear turquoise waters. These beaches are renowned for their natural beauty and pristine conditions, making them some of the most beautiful in the Canary Islands. As we anchor in this paradise, you’ll have the chance to soak up the sun on the catamaran's spacious deck or take a refreshing dip in the inviting waters. Dive into Fun with Thrilling Water Activities But that’s not all! Our Papagayo Catamaran Cruise is not just about relaxation – it’s also about adventure. Dive into the clear waters for an exhilarating snorkeling experience. Discover the vibrant marine life that thrives in these waters, from colorful fish to curious sea creatures. Whether you're a seasoned snorkeler or a first-timer, our friendly crew is on hand to ensure you have a safe and enjoyable experience. If you’re up for more excitement, try your hand at kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding. Glide across the calm waters and explore the coastline from a different perspective. Feel the thrill of paddling in paradise, surrounded by stunning scenery. For those looking for a bit of adrenaline, our Crazy Donut and banana boat rides are a must! Hold on tight as you’re towed behind the catamaran on an inflatable donut or banana, bouncing over the waves in an exhilarating ride that’s sure to get your heart racing. These activities are perfect for families and groups of friends looking to share laughs and create unforgettable memories. Relax and Unwind as We Sail Back to Harbor After a day of fun and adventure, it's time to unwind as we set sail back to the harbor. Lounge on the deck, feel the sun on your skin, and enjoy the soothing rhythm of the ocean. Take in the stunning views one last time as the sun begins to dip towards the horizon, casting a golden glow over the water. Onboard, our friendly crew will be serving delicious refreshments, including a selection of local snacks and drinks. It’s the perfect way to end a day filled with adventure and relaxation. Why Choose the I Love Papagayo Catamaran Cruise? Choosing our Papagayo Catamaran Cruise means choosing an unforgettable experience. Our luxurious catamaran, experienced crew, and carefully planned itinerary ensure that every moment of your cruise is perfect. Whether you’re looking to relax, explore, or seek adventure, our cruise offers something for everyone. Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to explore the beautiful Papagayo Beaches and create memories that will last a lifetime. Book your spot today and get ready for an amazing day out at sea! Book Your Papagayo Catamaran Cruise Today! Ready to experience the best of Lanzarote? Join us on the "I Love Papagayo Catamaran Cruise" and discover the stunning beauty of Papagayo Beaches. With thrilling water activities, luxurious amenities, and breathtaking views, this is the ultimate way to explore the Canary Islands. Book now and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

en: Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pickup points are in hotels or the nextdoor resort.
Pickup starts at 09:30 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick up.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly. However, we pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where/when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay the balance after collection time, payment can be done using a credit card or cash.
How long are we on the coach?
The journey to Puerto del Carmen is approximately 1520 minutes depending on where you’re staying.
Can I go straight to the harbor?
Yes, you can go straight to the harbor with a booking and ticket.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for approximately 4 hours.
Are Water Activities included?
Yes, Water Activities are included in the price.
What Water Activities are offered?
There are slides on the catamaran, mats and inflatables on the sea, and Kayaking. Bring your own snorkels as we aren’t allowed to offer you any due to Covid19 restrictions.
Are there any shades on the boat?
Yes, there are plenty of shades that get opened up and closed.
Are there any toilets on board?
Yes, there are toilets on board this Catamaran.
Is there any music on board?
Yes, we have Chillout music on board. Sometimes we even get people up dancing.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
Yes, when the boat has docked and water activities are activated, the slides will be opened, and you may also jump into the sea. Alternatively, there’s a ramp from where you can walk into the sea.
What sort of clothes do I need?
We recommend comfortable clothing, hats, sunglasses, beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim, and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
What food is included?

We serve a local traditional Paella made with rice and vegetables. Seafood and meat are cooked separately and added on top if customers desire. We also give the option of a simple pasta with tomato sauce.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment on notes at the time of booking.
Are drinks included?
Yes, drinks are included for all you can drink, and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer, and nonalcoholic beverages. There’s also a welcome Mojito served after you board the boat.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food, but you also have snacks and freshly cooked lunch served on board.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts around 6 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off, bringing you back around 16:00 o’clock.
Is swimming allowed?
Yes, you have plenty of time to go in for a dive.
Can I go to the beach?
No, it’s not recommended due to strong current but you can consult with guides if it’s safe to kayak.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 09:30 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente. No obstante, le recogeremos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde, cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden abonar el saldo una vez transcurrido el plazo de cobro; el pago puede realizarse con tarjeta de crédito o en efectivo.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hasta Puerto del Carmen es de aproximadamente 15-20 minutos, dependiendo de dónde se aloje.
¿Puedo ir directamente al puerto?
Sí, puede ir directamente al puerto con reserva y billete.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo aproximadamente 4 horas.
¿Están incluidas las actividades acuáticas?
Sí, las actividades acuáticas están incluidas en el precio.
¿Qué actividades acuáticas se ofrecen?
Hay toboganes en el catamarán, colchonetas e hinchables en el mar, y kayak. Traiga sus propios tubos, ya que no podemos ofrecérselos debido a las restricciones de Covid19.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Sí, hay muchas persianas que se abren y se cierran.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
Sí, hay aseos a bordo de este catamarán.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música Chillout a bordo. A veces incluso ponemos a la gente a bailar.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?

Sí, cuando el barco haya atracado y se activen las actividades acuáticas, se abrirán los toboganes y también podrá saltar al mar. Alternativamente, hay una rampa desde la que se puede caminar hasta el mar.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañador si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante, puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?

Servimos una paella tradicional local hecha con arroz y verduras. El marisco y la carne se cocinan por separado y se añaden por encima si el cliente lo desea. También damos la opción de una simple pasta con salsa de tomate.
¿Necesita algún régimen alimenticio?
Póngase en contacto con nuestro servicio de atención al cliente o deje un comentario en notas en el momento de hacer la reserva.
¿Están incluidas las bebidas?
Sí, las bebidas están incluidas para todo lo que puedas beber, y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas sin alcohol. También se sirve un mojito de bienvenida después de subir al barco.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede llevar comida, pero también tiene aperitivos y almuerzo recién cocinado servido a bordo.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 6 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00 horas.
¿Está permitido nadar?
Sí, tienes tiempo de sobra para sumergirte.
¿Puedo ir a la playa?
No, no es recomendable debido a la fuerte corriente, pero puedes consultar con los guías si es seguro navegar en kayak.

overview.en:
Sunset Dolphin & Whale Watching Cruise – Lanzarote

There's nothing quite like watching the Atlantic turn gold as dolphins leap alongside your boat. Our Sunset Dolphin & Whale Watching Cruise takes you out onto Lanzarote's open waters at the most magical time of day, when the light softens and marine life comes alive along the coastline.

You'll cruise aboard the striking yellow Biosfera Express, purpose-built for wildlife spotting, with wide open decks that give every passenger an unobstructed view. Our experienced crew keeps a close eye on the water throughout the crossing, and with a bit of luck you'll spot Bottlenose Dolphins riding the bow waves or, further out, the occasional Blue Whale gliding through the depths.

Timing is everything on this trip. As the sun begins to dip towards the horizon, the volcanic cliffs of Lanzarote glow amber and rose, creating a backdrop that's every bit as memorable as the wildlife itself. It's the kind of golden-hour scene that photographers dream about and families never forget.

Comfort is built into every part of the experience. The vessel carries full safety equipment and a crew trained in first aid, so you can relax and focus on the horizon rather than worry about the details. A drink and snack are included on board, keeping everyone refreshed as the cruise unfolds.

Along the way, we'll make a couple of short stops near the coastline so you can take in Lanzarote's marine environment up close and hear a little more about the ecosystem that supports such a rich variety of species here.

Because this sunset departure is one of our most requested trips, we'd always recommend booking ahead rather than leaving it to chance. It suits pretty much everyone — couples after a romantic evening on the water, families wanting something a bit different, or anyone hoping to bring home that perfect sunset-and-dolphins photo.

Step aboard, watch the sky change colour, and let Lanzarote's wildlife do the rest. This isn't just a boat trip — it's the kind of evening you'll still be talking about long after you've left the island.
overview.es:
Crucero al Atardecer para Avistamiento de Delfines y Ballenas – Lanzarote

No hay nada como ver el Atlántico teñirse de dorado mientras los delfines saltan junto a tu barco. Nuestro Crucero al Atardecer para Avistamiento de Delfines y Ballenas te lleva a mar abierto en Lanzarote en el momento más mágico del día, cuando la luz se suaviza y la vida marina cobra vida a lo largo de la costa.

Navegarás a bordo del llamativo Biosfera Express de color amarillo, diseñado especialmente para la observación de fauna marina, con amplias cubiertas abiertas que ofrecen a cada pasajero una vista sin obstáculos. Nuestra experimentada tripulación vigila el agua durante toda la travesía y, con un poco de suerte, podrás ver Delfines Mulares surcando las olas de proa o, más lejos, alguna Ballena Azul deslizándose por las profundidades.

El momento del día lo es todo en esta excursión. A medida que el sol comienza a descender hacia el horizonte, los acantilados volcánicos de Lanzarote se iluminan con tonos ámbar y rosados, creando un telón de fondo tan memorable como la propia fauna marina. Es ese tipo de escena de hora dorada con la que sueñan los fotógrafos y que las familias nunca olvidan.

La comodidad forma parte de cada momento de la experiencia. La embarcación cuenta con todo el equipo de seguridad necesario y una tripulación formada en primeros auxilios, para que puedas relajarte y centrarte en el horizonte sin preocuparte por los detalles. A bordo se incluye una bebida y un aperitivo, para que todos vayan refrescados mientras avanza el crucero.

Durante el trayecto, haremos un par de paradas breves cerca de la costa para que puedas apreciar de cerca el entorno marino de Lanzarote y conocer un poco más sobre el ecosistema que sustenta una variedad tan rica de especies en la isla.

Como esta salida al atardecer es una de nuestras excursiones más solicitadas, siempre recomendamos reservar con antelación en lugar de dejarlo al azar. Es perfecta prácticamente para todo el mundo: parejas que buscan una velada romántica en el agua, familias que quieren algo diferente, o cualquiera que espere llevarse a casa esa foto perfecta de atardecer y delfines.

Sube a bordo, observa cómo cambia el cielo de color y deja que la fauna de Lanzarote haga el resto. Esto no es solo una excursión en barco: es el tipo de tarde de la que seguirás hablando mucho después de haber dejado la isla.

en.title: Lanzarote’s Dolphins & Whales
en.text:
Lanzarote Dolphins are known for their playful nature and graceful movements. They offer a mesmerizing sight. These friendly dolphins are accustomed to spotting our vibrant yellow Biosfera boat. They never fail to greet us and joyfully glide alongside us as the sun sets.
Lanzarote is also home to magnificent whales that grace its waters. These majestic creatures captivate with their immense size and gentle presence.
Don’t miss the chance to witness these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.

Los delfines y las ballenas de Lanzarote
es.text:
Los delfines de Lanzarote son conocidos por su carácter juguetón y sus movimientos elegantes. Ofrecen un espectáculo fascinante. Estos simpáticos delfines están acostumbrados a ver nuestra embarcación «Biosfera», de un amarillo intenso. Nunca dejan de saludarnos y se deslizan alegremente a nuestro lado mientras se pone el sol.
Lanzarote también alberga magníficas ballenas que adornan sus aguas. Estas majestuosas criaturas cautivan por su inmenso tamaño y su presencia apacible.
No te pierdas la oportunidad de contemplar a estas magníficas criaturas en su hábitat natural.

overview.en:
Buggy Tour Costa Teguise – Ultimate Off-Road Adventure

Experience the thrill of an off-road adventure with our Buggy Tour Costa Teguise, one of Lanzarote's most exhilarating tours. Explore the untamed beauty of the island’s northern region as you drive powerful Maverick Can-Am 4x4 buggies across volcanic landscapes, sand dunes, and rugged hills. This is the perfect tour for adrenaline seekers, nature lovers, and families looking to create unforgettable memories in one of the world’s most unique terrains.

Your adventure begins in Costa Teguise, a vibrant coastal town known for its crystal-clear waters and volcanic scenery. After a quick safety briefing, you’ll get behind the wheel of a top-of-the-line automatic buggy. Our vehicles are designed for comfort and safety, ensuring you can focus on the fun while navigating through Lanzarote’s striking landscapes.

Choose between a 2-hour or 2-hour tour, both offering a mix of exciting off-road paths and scenic routes. Our expert guides will lead you on a journey through hidden gems and off-the-beaten-path spots that few visitors get to see. With their extensive knowledge of Lanzarote’s history, geology, and culture, you’ll not only enjoy a heart-pumping ride but also gain fascinating insights into the island’s volcanic origins.

As you drive through volcanic fields and along dirt tracks, you’ll witness panoramic views of Lanzarote’s most famous natural landmarks. From the iconic volcanic craters to breathtaking coastal cliffs, there are plenty of opportunities to stop, take photos, and soak in the incredible views. Don’t forget your camera, as this tour offers some of the most Instagram-worthy spots on the island.

Safety is our top priority. All drivers must hold a valid driver’s license, and our professional guides ensure that every participant is well-prepared and comfortable before hitting the trails. Whether you’re an experienced off-roader or a first-timer, you’ll feel confident driving our state-of-the-art buggies, equipped with everything you need for a smooth and enjoyable ride.

Ideal for couples, groups of friends, or families, the Buggy Tour Costa Teguise is suitable for all ages. This is a fantastic way to explore Lanzarote’s natural beauty from a whole new perspective, and it’s an experience that will leave you with lasting memories.

What to bring:

  • Valid driver’s license (required for drivers)
  • Comfortable clothing and sturdy shoes
  • Sunglasses and sunscreen to protect from the sun
  • Camera or smartphone for amazing photos

Book your Buggy Tour Costa Teguise today and prepare for an unforgettable off-road adventure! Our tours are popular, so we recommend booking in advance to secure your spot.

Key Highlights:

  • Drive high-performance Maverick Can-Am 4x4 buggies
  • Explore volcanic landscapes, sand dunes, and rugged hills
  • Guided by experienced local experts
  • Choose from 2 or 3-hour routes
  • Perfect for thrill-seekers and families

Discover Lanzarote like never before with this action-packed buggy tour, combining adventure, nature, and local culture for a truly unique experience.
overview.es:
Excursión en buggy por Costa Teguise: la aventura todoterreno definitiva

Vive la emoción de una aventura todoterreno con nuestro Buggy Tour Costa Teguise, una de las excursiones más emocionantes de Lanzarote. Explora la belleza salvaje del norte de la isla mientras conduces potentes buggies Maverick Can-Am 4x4 por paisajes volcánicos, dunas de arena y colinas escarpadas. Esta es la excursión perfecta para los amantes de la adrenalina, los amantes de la naturaleza y las familias que buscan crear recuerdos inolvidables en uno de los terrenos más singulares del mundo.

Tu aventura comienza en Costa Teguise, una animada localidad costera conocida por sus aguas cristalinas y sus paisajes volcánicos. Tras una breve sesión informativa sobre seguridad, te pondrás al volante de un buggy automático de gama alta. Nuestros vehículos están diseñados para ofrecer comodidad y seguridad, lo que te permitirá centrarte en la diversión mientras recorres los impresionantes paisajes de Lanzarote.

Una excursión de dos horas que ofrece una combinación de emocionantes senderos todoterreno y rutas panorámicas. Nuestros guías expertos te llevarán a descubrir joyas ocultas y rincones fuera de los circuitos habituales que pocos visitantes llegan a ver. Gracias a sus amplios conocimientos sobre la historia, la geología y la cultura de Lanzarote, no solo disfrutarás de un recorrido lleno de emociones, sino que también obtendrás información fascinante sobre los orígenes volcánicos de la isla.

Mientras conduces por campos volcánicos y por caminos de tierra, podrás contemplar vistas panorámicas de los parajes naturales más famosos de Lanzarote. Desde los emblemáticos cráteres volcánicos hasta los impresionantes acantilados costeros, tendrás muchas oportunidades para parar, hacer fotos y disfrutar de las increíbles vistas. No te olvides de la cámara, ya que esta excursión te llevará a algunos de los lugares más «instagrameables» de la isla.

La seguridad es nuestra máxima prioridad. Todos los conductores deben estar en posesión de un permiso de conducir válido, y nuestros guías profesionales se aseguran de que cada participante esté bien preparado y se sienta cómodo antes de lanzarse a las pistas. Tanto si eres un experto en conducción todoterreno como si es tu primera vez, te sentirás seguro al volante de nuestros buggies de última generación, equipados con todo lo necesario para un recorrido fluido y agradable.

Ideal para parejas, grupos de amigos o familias, el Buggy Tour Costa Teguise es apto para todas las edades. Es una forma fantástica de descubrir la belleza natural de Lanzarote desde una perspectiva totalmente nueva, y una experiencia que te dejará recuerdos imborrables.

Qué hay que llevar:

  • Valid driver’s license (required for drivers)
  • Comfortable clothing and sturdy shoes
  • Sunglasses and sunscreen to protect from the sun
  • Camera or smartphone for amazing photos

¡Reserva hoy mismo tu excursión en buggy por Costa Teguise y prepárate para una aventura todoterreno inolvidable! Nuestras visitas guiadas tienen mucha demanda, por lo que te recomendamos que reserves con antelación para asegurarte una plaza.

Aspectos más destacados:

  • Conduce los buggies 4x4 Maverick de Can-Am de alto rendimiento
  • Explora paisajes volcánicos, dunas de arena y colinas escarpadas
  • De la mano de expertos locales con amplia experiencia
  • Elige entre rutas de 2 o 3 horas
  • Perfect for thrill-seekers and families

Descubre Lanzarote como nunca antes con esta excursión en buggy llena de acción, que combina aventura, naturaleza y cultura local para ofrecerte una experiencia verdaderamente única.

en: Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have Tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pickup points are in hotels or the nextdoor resort. Pickup starts at 08:30 for the morning routes and at 12:30 for the afternoon routes in every resort, tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick up.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Point tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we pick at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location, and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
How and when do I pay the balance?
The balance can be paid in cash or using a credit card on the Excursion before the start of the tour.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Do I have free time?
Yes, we have a couple of coffee breaks and stops in picturesque spots.
Is there a stop for food & is it included?
No, there are no stops at any restaurants on this route.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course, take some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
What sort of clothes do I need?

You can go as you please, comfortable clothing, trainers, and a scarf to cover the mouth and nose from dust is what we recommend. Hats and sunglasses for the Summer season and a jumper for Winter time as it can be windy.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
Do we go to the Volcanoes?
No, it’s illegal to visit the national park on buggies, but we pass by the outskirts, and you can admire the views.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilet stops at the Marina and at Lanzarote Karting.
How long is the transfer on the coach?
Depending on where you are staying, the longest being a 30minute drive for those customers that are staying in Costa Teguise.
Is the Excursion offroad?
Yes, 70% of the Excursion is off road.
Do we provide glasses?
No, but all the buggies have a protective glass screen in front.
Are the buggies easy to drive?
These specific buggies are very easy to drive; they are automatic buggies, so you don’t have to worry about changing gears while going up hills; it’s simply accelerating and braking.
Is it allowed to swap drivers?
Yes, it is allowed as long as the passenger has a full driver’s license and has registered and signed the insurance documents prior to the start of the activity.
How fast do we go?

The speed of the Excursion varies by groups; there is usually a faster group, and the slower group stays behind. In which case, our guide takes the first position to lead the slower group while the faster group goes in front led by another guide and waits for the rest of the group to arrive at the stop points.

overview.en:
Buggy Tour Costa Teguise – Ultimate Off-Road Adventure

Experience the thrill of an off-road adventure with our Buggy Tour Costa Teguise, one of Lanzarote's most exhilarating tours. Explore the untamed beauty of the island’s northern region as you drive powerful Maverick Can-Am 4x4 buggies across volcanic landscapes, sand dunes, and rugged hills. This is the perfect tour for adrenaline seekers, nature lovers, and families looking to create unforgettable memories in one of the world’s most unique terrains.

Your adventure begins in Costa Teguise, a vibrant coastal town known for its crystal-clear waters and volcanic scenery. After a quick safety briefing, you’ll get behind the wheel of a top-of-the-line automatic buggy. Our vehicles are designed for comfort and safety, ensuring you can focus on the fun while navigating through Lanzarote’s striking landscapes.

Choose between a 2-hour or 3-hour tour, both offering a mix of exciting off-road paths and scenic routes. Our expert guides will lead you on a journey through hidden gems and off-the-beaten-path spots that few visitors get to see. With their extensive knowledge of Lanzarote’s history, geology, and culture, you’ll not only enjoy a heart-pumping ride but also gain fascinating insights into the island’s volcanic origins.

As you drive through volcanic fields and along dirt tracks, you’ll witness panoramic views of Lanzarote’s most famous natural landmarks. From the iconic volcanic craters to breathtaking coastal cliffs, there are plenty of opportunities to stop, take photos, and soak in the incredible views. Don’t forget your camera, as this tour offers some of the most Instagram-worthy spots on the island.

Safety is our top priority. All drivers must hold a valid driver’s license, and our professional guides ensure that every participant is well-prepared and comfortable before hitting the trails. Whether you’re an experienced off-roader or a first-timer, you’ll feel confident driving our state-of-the-art buggies, equipped with everything you need for a smooth and enjoyable ride.

Ideal for couples, groups of friends, or families, the Buggy Tour Costa Teguise is suitable for all ages. This is a fantastic way to explore Lanzarote’s natural beauty from a whole new perspective, and it’s an experience that will leave you with lasting memories.

What to bring:

  • Valid driver’s license (required for drivers)
  • Comfortable clothing and sturdy shoes
  • Sunglasses and sunscreen to protect from the sun
  • Camera or smartphone for amazing photos

Book your Buggy Tour Costa Teguise today and prepare for an unforgettable off-road adventure! Our tours are popular, so we recommend booking in advance to secure your spot.

Key Highlights:

  • Drive high-performance Maverick Can-Am 4x4 buggies
  • Explore volcanic landscapes, sand dunes, and rugged hills
  • Guided by experienced local experts
  • Choose from 2 or 3-hour routes
  • Perfect for thrill-seekers and families

Discover Lanzarote like never before with this action-packed buggy tour, combining adventure, nature, and local culture for a truly unique experience.

es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos Tours que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado. La recogida comienza a las 08:30 para las rutas de la mañana y a las 12:30 para las rutas de la tarde en todos los complejos turísticos, dinos dónde te alojas y te enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si tu hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en su parada de autobús más cercana o en su hotel, envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta su parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿Cómo y cuándo pago el saldo?
El saldo puede pagarse en efectivo o con tarjeta de crédito en la excursión antes del inicio de la misma.
¿En qué idioma está la Excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Tengo tiempo libre?
Sí, hacemos un par de pausas para tomar café y paradas en lugares pintorescos.
¿Hay una parada para la comida y está incluida?
No, no hay paradas en ningún restaurante en esta ruta.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto, llévate algo de picar y beber, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?

Puedes ir como quieras, ropa cómoda, zapatillas de deporte y un pañuelo para taparte la boca y la nariz del polvo es lo que te recomendamos. Sombreros y gafas de sol para el verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante, puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Vamos a los volcanes?
No, es ilegal visitar el parque nacional en buggies, pero pasamos por las afueras y se pueden admirar las vistas.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay paradas de aseo en el Puerto Deportivo y en Lanzarote Karting.
¿Cuánto dura el traslado en autocar?
Dependiendo de donde se aloje, siendo el más largo 30 minutos en coche para aquellos clientes que se alojen en Costa Teguise.
¿El Excursion es todoterreno?
Sí, el 70% de la Excursión es todoterreno.
¿Proporcionamos gafas?
No, pero todos los buggies tienen una pantalla protectora de cristal delante.
¿Son fáciles de conducir los buggies?
Estos buggies específicos son muy fáciles de conducir; son buggies automáticos, por lo que no hay que preocuparse de cambiar de marcha al subir cuestas; simplemente hay que acelerar y frenar.
¿Está permitido intercambiar los controladores?
Sí, está permitido siempre que el pasajero tenga el carné de conducir en regla y se haya inscrito y firmado los documentos del seguro antes del inicio de la actividad.
¿A qué velocidad vamos?

La velocidad de la Excursión varía según los grupos; suele haber un grupo más rápido y el más lento se queda atrás. En ese caso, nuestro guía toma la primera posición para dirigir al grupo más lento mientras que el grupo más rápido va delante dirigido por otro guía y espera a que el resto del grupo llegue a los puntos de parada.

overview.en:
Unleash Your Family’s Spirit of Adventure with the Family Buggy Tour + Volcano Trek!

Looking for an unforgettable way to explore Lanzarote's most captivating landscapes? The Family Buggy Tour + Volcano Trek offers an exhilarating mix of off-road fun and breathtaking volcanic scenery. This family-friendly adventure is the perfect combination of excitement and natural beauty, designed to provide memories that will last a lifetime.

Thrilling Buggy Ride Through Lanzarote’s Rugged Terrain

Start your journey behind the wheel of a powerful buggy, perfect for families looking for adventure. As you take the wheel, you’ll drive through the scenic outskirts of the famous Timanfaya National Park, home to the legendary Fire Mountains. These ancient volcanic landscapes are the backdrop to an action-packed off-road drive. Feel the adrenaline as you speed through dirt trails and get close to Lanzarote’s rugged, untouched nature.

The buggy is designed to accommodate families, seating up to four people, making it the ideal way for parents and kids to share the adventure together. Suitable for all ages, this activity combines the thrill of driving with the safety and comfort of a family-friendly experience.

Volcanic Wonders Await – Explore the Cuervo Volcano

After your thrilling buggy ride, the adventure continues with a trek inside one of Lanzarote's most fascinating natural landmarks, the Cuervo Volcano. This awe-inspiring volcano offers a rare opportunity to walk inside its crater, a geological wonder formed by volcanic eruptions centuries ago.

Wander through the dramatic lunar-like landscape, taking in the sights and sounds of this ancient natural phenomenon. The Cuervo Volcano’s crater is not just a magnificent sight but also a haven for wildlife, making this trek both educational and awe-inspiring. Be sure to bring your camera to capture the surreal scenery that will leave you speechless.

Discover Hidden Canyons and Volcanic Caves

The adventure doesn’t stop there. As you journey deeper into Lanzarote’s volcanic heartland, you'll uncover hidden gems like majestic canyons and volcanic caves. These natural formations are some of Lanzarote’s best-kept secrets, offering a surreal landscape that feels like you’ve stepped onto another planet.

Your knowledgeable guide will provide fascinating insights into the island's volcanic history and unique ecosystem, making this tour not only thrilling but also educational for both adults and children alike.

Why Choose the Family Buggy Tour + Volcano Trek?

  • Family-Friendly Adventure: Perfect for families with children of all ages. Enjoy a safe and thrilling ride through Lanzarote’s striking landscapes.
  • Explore Iconic Landmarks: Drive around the famous Timanfaya National Park and trek into the incredible Cuervo Volcano crater.
  • Professional Guides: Our expert guides ensure your safety while sharing fascinating facts about Lanzarote's volcanic origins and its ecosystem.
  • Half-Day Excursion: Ideal for families who want to experience Lanzarote's natural wonders without committing to a full-day tour.

Whether you're an adrenaline-seeking family or nature lovers looking to explore Lanzarote's volcanic wonders, the Family Buggy Tour + Volcano Trek is an unforgettable adventure you won’t want to miss. Book today and prepare for a journey that combines the best of outdoor excitement and natural beauty!
overview.es: ¡Viva una emocionante aventura familiar en buggy para cuatro! Conduzca por los alrededores de las Montañas del Fuego del Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, pasando por pintorescos viñedos. Apta para todas las edades, esta excursión de medio día promete un viaje inolvidable para toda la familia.
