es.text: A su llegada, firmará un formulario de seguro y recibirá instrucciones exhaustivas sobre salud y seguridad antes de comenzar la aventura.

es.title: Conoce el impresionante Polaris Slingshot de tres ruedas
es.text:
El Polaris Slingshot es un vehículo único de tres ruedas con un potente motor de 2,0 litros, transmisión manual y capacidad para dos personas. Combina un diseño llamativo con características de seguridad para una experiencia de conducción estimulante.
Antes de emprender su aventura, nuestros experimentados guías le proporcionarán una breve pero completa orientación sobre el manejo de estos Slingshot de accionamiento automático y fácil manejo.

es.title: Comience con la experiencia Lanzarote Slingshot
es.text: Embárcate en una emocionante aventura por el paisaje volcánico de Lanzarote en el superrápido Polaris Slingshot. Siente el sol en la cara y el viento en el pelo mientras aceleras en este descapotable descapotable. Descubra los encantadores viñedos de La Geria, donde el cultivo del vino prospera en el suelo volcánico. Sea testigo de la cautivadora belleza del famoso Lago Verde de El Golfo. Recorra los alrededores de las Montañas del Fuego, en el Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, y sumérjase en el encanto del pintoresco pueblo de La Santa. Esta excursión de 3 horas promete una experiencia inolvidable, combinando velocidad, maravillas naturales y exploración cultural en el extraordinario entorno de Lanzarote.

es.title: Regreso al punto de partida y traslado al punto de recogida
es.text: Después de tu aventura en Lanzarote Slingshot, te dejaremos de forma segura en tu punto de recogida.

en: Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza.
Pickup points are in hotels or the nextdoor resort.
Pickup starts at 08:30 for the morning routes and at 12:30 for the afternoon routes in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pickup.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly. However, we pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you with GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
How and when do I pay the balance?
The balance can be paid in cash or using a credit card on the Excursion day before the start of the tour.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Do I have free time?
Yes, we have a couple of coffee breaks and stops in picturesque spots.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can go as you please, comfortable clothing, trainers. Hats and sunglasses for the summer season and a jumper for winter time as it can be windy.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant, they can join us.
Is there a stop for food, and is it included?
There’s a stop for snacks and coffee, but not a proper meal.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course. Take some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Do we stop at the vineyards?
No, there is no stop at the vineyards.
Do we go to the Volcanoes?
No, we journey along the outskirts of the Volcanoes so you can admire the picturesque landscape.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilet stops at the Marina and at Lanzarote Karting.
How long is the transfer on the coach?
Depending on where you are staying, the longest being a 30minute drive for those customers staying in Costa Teguise.
Do we go offroad?
No, these cars aren’t built for offroad trails. Head over to our Buggy tours to drive offroad.
Are the Slingshots easy to drive?
If you are used to driving, you will be okay. The driving experience is just like driving a normal car.
Is it allowed to swap drivers?
Yes, it is allowed as long as the passenger has a full driver’s license and has registered and signed the insurance documents prior to the start of the activity.
Is swimming allowed?
No, it’s strictly forbidden to swim in the Green Lake.
How fast do we go?

The speed of the Excursion varies by groups. There usually is a faster group, and the slower group stays behind, in which case our guide takes the first position to lead the slower group while the faster group goes in front led by another guide and waits for the rest of the group to arrive at the stop points.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza.
Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 08:30 para las rutas de la mañana y a las 12:30 para las rutas de la tarde en todas las estaciones. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente. No obstante, le recogeremos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.

overview.en:
Can-am Spyder Tours: Unleash the Adventure in Lanzarote’s Stunning Landscape Discover Lanzarote like never before with our Can-Am Spyder Tours, a unique and thrilling way to explore the island’s volcanic wonders. Whether you’re a seasoned adventurer or new to the Can-Am Spyder experience, this three-wheeled motorbike offers unparalleled stability, comfort, and a rush of excitement, ensuring a ride that’s both safe and exhilarating.

Explore Lanzarote’s Natural Beauty

Lanzarote, an island known for its breathtaking volcanic landscape, offers some of the most spectacular views in the Canary Islands, and there’s no better way to see them than on a Can-Am Spyder. Feel the thrill as you cruise along the smooth roads that wind through La Geria, the island's famous wine region. Marvel at the unique vineyards, where grapevines grow in volcanic craters, producing the island’s most exquisite wines. As you journey on your Can-Am Spyder, take in the surreal beauty of Timanfaya National Park, home to the Fire Mountains (Montañas del Fuego), where geothermal forces continue to shape the land. Your tour will take you to the edges of this otherworldly landscape, providing unmatched views of volcanic craters, lava fields, and the rugged coastline that defines Lanzarote’s dramatic terrain.

A Scenic Adventure Like No Other

From the moment you start your engine, you’ll feel the excitement of riding a machine designed for both speed and comfort. The Can-Am Spyder combines the thrill of a motorcycle with the stability of a car, offering a smooth ride that lets you focus on the beauty around you. This tour is perfect for both beginners and experienced riders, with easy handling and a guide to ensure you’re always on the right track. During the tour, you'll stop at some of Lanzarote’s most iconic locations, including the famous Green Lake (Charco de los Clicos) in El Golfo, a stunning emerald green lagoon set against the backdrop of volcanic cliffs and black sand beaches. This striking natural wonder is a must-see, and your Can-Am Spyder provides the perfect means to get there with ease and style.

Why Choose Can-Am Spyder Tours?

  1. Unique Vehicle Experience: The Can-Am Spyder is unlike any other vehicle. Its distinctive design, with two wheels in the front and one in the back, offers exceptional stability and maneuverability, making it ideal for exploring Lanzarote's diverse terrain.
  2. Comfort Meets Thrill: Whether you're a thrill-seeker looking for speed or someone who values comfort, the Can-Am Spyder delivers both. Its ergonomic design ensures a smooth ride, even on longer journeys.
  3. Expert Guides: Our knowledgeable guides will lead the way, sharing fascinating insights about Lanzarote’s history, geology, and culture, making your tour both educational and entertaining.
  4. Stunning Stops Along the Way: From the vineyards of La Geria to the awe-inspiring Timanfaya National Park and the serene Green Lake, each stop on this tour is carefully selected to showcase Lanzarote’s most captivating sights.
  5. Perfect for All Skill Levels: Whether you're new to riding or a seasoned pro, the Can-Am Spyder is easy to handle, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone.

Book Your Can-Am Spyder Tour Today!

If you’re looking for an unforgettable way to explore Lanzarote’s volcanic landscape, look no further than the Can-Am Spyder Tour. With its perfect combination of adventure, comfort, and scenic beauty, this tour promises memories that will last a lifetime. Book now on excursionsticketsdirect.com and secure your spot for a one-of-a-kind journey through one of the world’s most unique destinations.

Recorra los encantadores viñedos de La Geria, maravíllese ante el fascinante Lago Verde de El Golfo y explore los pintorescos alrededores del Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, hogar de las imponentes Montañas del Fuego. es.title: Safari en Submarino - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Discover the mysteries of the deep with our Submarine Safari tour, an extraordinary underwater experience that takes you 30 meters (100 feet) beneath the Atlantic Ocean’s surface. This is not just another boat trip – this is a rare chance to explore the ocean like never before, in the comfort of a sophisticated submarine designed for both adventure and relaxation. Whether you’re a marine enthusiast, a family looking for a unique experience, or simply someone with a curiosity for the unknown, this tour promises an unforgettable journey through the vibrant underwater world.

A Journey 30 Meters Below the Ocean

As you descend deep into the clear blue waters surrounding Lanzarote, prepare to be mesmerized by the wonders of the Atlantic Ocean. Our state-of-the-art submarine, equipped with large viewing windows, provides you with a front-row seat to an ever-changing aquatic show. The further you dive, the more you’ll discover a world teeming with life. From colorful schools of fish to curious marine species, the diversity of sea life in this part of the world is astonishing. During the tour, our expert guides provide informative commentary to enhance your experience, explaining the various species and environments you’ll encounter. You won’t just see the underwater world; you’ll understand it. For added immersion, an on-board TV monitor provides additional insights and information, making it a fun and educational experience for all ages.

Witness Historic Shipwrecks

The Submarine Safari takes you close to several fascinating shipwrecks that now serve as artificial reefs, teeming with marine life. These sunken vessels, once powerful ships, now form part of the thriving underwater ecosystem. Their mysterious, ghostly appearance makes them a highlight of the tour, providing an awe-inspiring backdrop for photography. Imagine the tales these wrecks could tell as you glide silently past them.

Unbeatable Comfort and Safety

Safety is our top priority, and our submarine has been meticulously designed to offer a safe and enjoyable experience for all passengers. The air-conditioned cabin is spacious, offering a relaxing atmosphere as you take in the stunning sights below. Each passenger has a clear view of the underwater landscape through large viewing ports, ensuring no one misses out on the magical scenery. Our submarine docks briefly on the seabed during the tour, giving you an unparalleled view of the ocean floor. This stop also presents a great opportunity to snap a photo or two as a keepsake of your amazing adventure. Plus, thanks to the serene underwater environment, you’ll feel as though you’re floating through another world entirely – an experience unlike anything you’ve ever felt before.

Ideal for Families, Couples, and Explorers

The Submarine Safari tour is perfect for visitors of all ages. Families will love the excitement and educational aspects of the trip, while couples can enjoy the romantic, tranquil atmosphere of the deep sea. Even seasoned explorers will find something new to admire in the intricate ecosystems below the waves. It’s an ideal way to break free from the typical holiday activities and embark on a one-of-a-kind adventure.

Book Your Submarine Safari Today

Ready to experience the ocean like never before? Don’t miss out on the chance to dive into the deep blue and uncover the wonders beneath the surface. Book your Submarine Safari with Excursions Tickets Direct today and prepare for an unforgettable adventure under the sea. Spots fill up quickly, so reserve your seat now!
overview.es: Experimente nuestra sofisticada excursión submarina, sumergiéndose 30 metros bajo el Océano Atlántico para explorar el cautivador mundo submarino, presenciar una gran variedad de vida marina e hipnotizantes restos de naufragios. Los comentarios de nuestros expertos y el monitor de televisión informativo mejoran su viaje, mientras que el atraque del submarino en el fondo del mar ofrece la oportunidad de sacar una foto memorable.

What sort of clothes do I need?
Customers may come as they please. The temperature aboard the submarine is room temperature.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
No, not for this trip. Customers have to climb down ladders to board the submarine.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food and drinks if you desire. Note: food is not allowed on board.
How long is the excursion?
The tour lasts approximately 45 to 50 minutes, and around 3 hours from the time of pickup to dropoff time.
Are we guaranteed to see anything?
Put simply, yes! The area is home to a wide range of fish of all shapes and sizes. Each day is unique, and we cannot guarantee what types we will see, but you will always see a lot!
I get ear infections, is it recommended for me to go on the submarine?

The inside of the submarine is maintained at normal atmospheric conditions, and so it feels no different from being on the surface. Therefore, even at the bottom of the ocean, your ears will NOT be affected.
Can pregnant women go on the submarine?
Yes, it’s perfectly safe for pregnant women to go on our submarine for the same reason as above.
I get claustrophobic and scared to go underwater, what is the experience like?

The inside of the submarine is spacious and light, with a central aisle. Similar to a small airliner, except the seats all face outwards, with large viewing windows in front. Most people who feel a little nervous before diving are fine when onboard, but the final decision has to be yours.
Will I get seasick?
Being on a submarine is very different from being on a boat. There is no rocking motion as the submarine sits below the waves, and so people who get seasick on a boat will not do so on our submarine.
Are photos included in the price, and can I bring my camera?
Yes, you can bring your camera or phone to take a memorable photo on the seabed. Photos taken by our photography staff are available to purchase in digital form or printed for as little as 8€.
es: ¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 16:30 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Tenemos visitas en inglés, español, alemán y francés, y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde, cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes deberán pagar el saldo a su llegada a nuestra oficina en Puerto Calero.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hasta Puerto Calero es de aproximadamente 1520 minutos, dependiendo de dónde se aloje.
¿Puedo ir directamente al puerto deportivo?
Sí, puedes ir directamente al puerto deportivo con una reserva y un billete y 1 hora antes de la inmersión programada para que te hagan una simulación de salud y seguridad.
¿Cuánto dura la inmersión?
La inmersión dura aproximadamente 35 50 minutos.
¿A qué profundidad llega el submarino?
El submarino se sumerge hasta 30 metros de profundidad.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
No, no hay aseos a bordo. Recomendamos a los clientes que vayan al baño antes de embarcar.
¿Se admiten niños en este viaje?
Sí, se admiten niños a partir de 2 años.
¿Pueden subir al submarino bebés menores de 2 años?
Por razones de seguridad, no podemos aceptar pasajeros menores de dos años bajo ninguna circunstancia. Sin embargo, proporcionamos un traslado en autobús para los espectadores.
¿Hay algún comentarista a bordo?
Sí, tenemos un comentarista que te explica todo en tu idioma durante la inmersión.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Los clientes pueden venir cuando quieran. La temperatura a bordo del submarino es la temperatura ambiente.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
No, no para este viaje. Los clientes tienen que bajar escaleras para subir al submarino.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puede traer comida y bebida si lo desea. Nota: no se permite llevar comida a bordo.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
El recorrido dura aproximadamente entre 45 y 50 minutos, y unas 3 horas desde la recogida hasta la bajada.
¿Tenemos garantías de ver algo?
En pocas palabras, ¡sí! La zona alberga una gran variedad de peces de todas las formas y tamaños. Cada día es único, y no podemos garantizar qué tipos veremos, ¡pero siempre verá muchos!
Tengo otitis, ¿es recomendable que suba al submarino?

El interior del submarino se mantiene en condiciones atmosféricas normales, por lo que la sensación no difiere de la de estar en la superficie. Por lo tanto, incluso en el fondo del océano, sus oídos NO se verán afectados.
¿Pueden subir al submarino las mujeres embarazadas?
Sí, es perfectamente seguro para las mujeres embarazadas ir en nuestro submarino por la misma razón anterior.
Me da claustrofobia y miedo sumergirme en el agua, ¿cómo es la experiencia?

El interior del submarino es amplio y luminoso, con un pasillo central. Similar a un pequeño avión de pasajeros, con la diferencia de que todos los asientos están orientados hacia fuera, con grandes ventanillas delante. La mayoría de las personas que se sienten un poco nerviosas antes de bucear están bien cuando están a bordo, pero la decisión final tiene que ser suya.
¿Me marearé?

Estar en un submarino es muy diferente de estar en un barco. No hay movimiento de balanceo porque el submarino se encuentra bajo las olas, por lo que las personas que se marean en un barco no lo harán en nuestro submarino.
¿Las fotos están incluidas en el precio? ¿Puedo llevar mi cámara?

Sí, puede traer su cámara o teléfono para tomar una foto memorable en el fondo del mar. Las fotos tomadas por nuestro equipo de fotógrafos se pueden adquirir en formato digital o impresas por tan sólo 8 euros.

overview.en:
Explore the hidden treasures beneath the waves of Lanzarote with our exclusive Try Dive experience! Whether you’re an absolute beginner or looking to dip your toes into the world of scuba diving, this adventure is perfect for you. With crystal-clear waters and abundant marine life, Lanzarote offers one of the best environments for first-time divers to safely explore the depths of the Atlantic Ocean.

What to Expect from Your Try Dive

Our Try Dive experience is designed to give you a taste of the magic that scuba diving offers, in a safe and relaxed environment. Under the guidance of our fully certified and experienced instructors, you’ll learn the basics of scuba diving, including how to use the equipment, safety protocols, and breathing techniques underwater. This is a one-time opportunity to discover a whole new world, without the need for prior experience or certification. For those who want to take things slow, our Single Try Dive is the ideal choice. You’ll enjoy one dive, reaching depths of 6-8 meters, where you can explore Lanzarote’s vibrant marine life and underwater landscapes. It’s a perfect introduction to scuba diving that will leave you amazed by the underwater beauty and eager for more. If you’re ready to take the plunge a little deeper, opt for the Double Try Dive. This package includes two dives at different locations, allowing you to explore depths of up to 10 meters. Witness a variety of marine ecosystems, with colorful fish, intriguing underwater rock formations, and other fascinating sea creatures. Each location offers its own unique experience, making the Double Try Dive an unforgettable way to explore the underwater wonders of Lanzarote.

Why Choose Try Dive with Us?

  • Beginner-Friendly: No previous experience is needed, and our instructors ensure you feel safe and confident throughout the experience.
  • Top-Quality Equipment: We provide all necessary diving gear, regularly maintained to the highest safety standards.
  • Certified Instructors: Our team consists of professional divers who are passionate about sharing the underwater world with beginners.
  • Spectacular Dive Sites: Lanzarote’s marine life is rich and diverse, with clear waters offering visibility up to 30 meters, perfect for an unforgettable first dive.
  • Tailored Experience: Choose between a Single or Double Try Dive depending on how much time you want to spend underwater.

Unveil the Magic of Lanzarote’s Underwater World

Lanzarote’s underwater environment is a true gem waiting to be explored. As you descend into the depths, you’ll be greeted by colorful schools of fish, vibrant coral formations, and the occasional glimpse of octopuses, rays, or even playful dolphins in the distance. The volcanic formations create unique rock structures and tunnels, adding an extra element of thrill to your dive. Whether you’re admiring the gentle sway of the sea grass or marveling at the fish that dart in and out of rocky crevices, the world beneath the surface is as dynamic as it is beautiful. Each dive location provides a different perspective of Lanzarote’s underwater biodiversity, ensuring that no two dives are the same.

Perfect for Families and Couples

Our Try Dive experience is suitable for individuals, couples, or even families looking to share an adventure. Diving together creates unforgettable memories and brings you closer as you experience the awe-inspiring underwater scenery hand in hand. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking a new challenge, Try Dive is the perfect way to make the most of your time in Lanzarote. Book your Try Dive today and embark on an underwater adventure that will leave you with stories to tell for a lifetime! Whether you choose a single dive or double the fun, the ocean is waiting for you to dive in and explore. Dive with us and discover why Lanzarote is a top destination for first-time scuba divers. Single Try Dive = 1 Inmersion/Person Double Try Dive = 2 Inmersions/Person

en: When and where are the pickups?
We pick up outside every hotel; collection starts approximately at 08:00 AM. Select your hotel and we will send you the exact pickup time.
When and how do I pay the balance?
Balance is paid on the day of the activity at the time of collection; we accept card or cash payments.
What is the minimum age to dive?
Children have to be a minimum of 8 years old to be able to do Try Dive.
How deep do we go?
This depends on how many dives you take; if you do 1 dive, we take you down to approximately 6 meters. On the second dive, we go to a different resort, and we go down to 8 meters.
Will we see anything on the first dive?

Absolutely, bear in mind that Lanzarote is in the middle of the ocean, therefore all the coasts are so abundant in marine life, and also the fact that the island is a protected natural reserve helps a lot.
Are there any sharks?
No, there are no sharks where we dive, and there have never been any shark attacks in the history of all the Canary Islands.
Do we provide wetsuits?
Yes, we provide all the equipment needed for this activity.
Do we use boats to go diving?
No, boats are not needed to dive the coasts of Lanzarote.
Can parent come and watch their children?
Yes, certainly, parents are welcome to come to the beach to accompany their children.
Do I need to be a strong swimmer to dive?
No, diving is not the same as swimming; if you can kick with your legs, it is more than enough.
How long is each dive?
Each Try Dive lasts approximately 45 minutes.
es: ¿Cuándo y dónde son las recogidas?
Recogemos fuera de cada hotel; la recogida comienza aproximadamente a las 08:00 AM. Seleccione su hotel y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida.
¿Cuándo y cómo pago el saldo?
El saldo se paga el día de la actividad en el momento de la recogida; aceptamos pagos con tarjeta o en efectivo.
¿Cuál es la edad mínima para bucear?
Los niños deben tener un mínimo de 8 años para poder hacer Try Dive.
¿Hasta dónde llegamos?
Esto depende del número de inmersiones que realice; si realiza 1 inmersión, le llevaremos hasta aproximadamente 6 metros. En la segunda inmersión, vamos a un complejo diferente, y bajamos a 8 metros.
¿Veremos algo en la primera inmersión?

Por supuesto, tenga en cuenta que Lanzarote está en medio del océano, por lo que todas las costas son muy abundantes en vida marina, y también ayuda mucho el hecho de que la isla sea una reserva natural protegida.
¿Hay tiburones?
No, no hay tiburones donde buceamos, y nunca ha habido ataques de tiburones en la historia de todas las Islas Canarias.
¿Proporcionamos trajes de neopreno?
Sí, proporcionamos todo el equipo necesario para esta actividad.
¿Utilizamos barcos para bucear?
No, no se necesitan embarcaciones para bucear en las costas de Lanzarote.
¿Pueden venir los padres a vigilar a sus hijos?
Sí, por supuesto, los padres pueden venir a la playa a acompañar a sus hijos.
¿Necesito ser un buen nadador para bucear?
No, bucear no es lo mismo que nadar; si puedes dar patadas con las piernas, es más que suficiente.
¿Cuánto dura cada inmersión?
Cada inmersión de prueba dura aproximadamente 45 minutos.

overview.en:
Trekking Volcano Natural Reserve – An Unforgettable Adventure Through Lanzarote's Volcanoes

Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime journey through the awe-inspiring Volcanoes Natural Reserve in Lanzarote. This guided trekking tour offers an immersive experience into the island’s volcanic origins, taking you through otherworldly landscapes and iconic geological formations that define the unique charm of Lanzarote.

Explore the Majestic Timanfaya National Park

Our trek starts in the heart of Timanfaya National Park, a UNESCO-recognized biosphere reserve. Known for its dramatic volcanic terrain, the park showcases the aftermath of volcanic eruptions from the 18th century. As you traverse the park’s winding trails, you'll witness the stark beauty of the Fire Mountains, or "Montañas del Fuego." These striking, rust-colored formations offer a glimpse into the raw power of nature.

Feel the heat rising from the ground beneath your feet, as you walk across solidified lava fields and experience first-hand the remnants of Lanzarote’s fiery past. Your expert guide will share fascinating insights into the region's geological history, explaining how volcanic activity has shaped the island over centuries.

Marvel at the Lunar Landscape

During the trek, you’ll encounter vast expanses of lunar-like terrain that seem almost alien in their appearance. Jagged rock formations, deep craters, and stretches of black volcanic sand create a surreal environment unlike anything else on Earth. The landscape feels otherworldly, offering visitors the opportunity to connect with nature in a way that is both serene and exhilarating.

Along the way, you will also observe unique plant species that have adapted to survive in the harsh volcanic environment. These resilient plants add pops of green to the otherwise barren landscape, showcasing nature’s incredible ability to thrive under challenging conditions.

Discover the Hidden Gems of Lanzarote

This guided trek not only focuses on the natural beauty of the volcanoes but also highlights the cultural significance of the region. As you make your way through the volcanic landscape, you'll learn about the island’s agricultural traditions, including how local farmers have cultivated crops in the fertile volcanic soil. This sustainable relationship between the land and the people of Lanzarote is an essential aspect of the island’s identity.

Our trekking route will also lead you to hidden viewpoints, where you can take in panoramic vistas of the island’s volcanic plains, rugged coastlines, and the sparkling Atlantic Ocean. These breathtaking views offer perfect photo opportunities and moments to reflect on the natural beauty that surrounds you.

Perfect for Nature Lovers and Adventure Seekers

The Trekking Volcano Natural Reserve tour is ideal for nature enthusiasts, photographers, and anyone looking to experience the raw power and beauty of Lanzarote’s volcanic landscapes. Whether you're a seasoned hiker or new to trekking, this tour offers an accessible yet exciting adventure that will leave you with lasting memories.

Our professional guides ensure that the trek is both informative and enjoyable, providing you with a deeper understanding of Lanzarote’s volcanic history while leading you safely through the island’s most remarkable terrains.

Book Your Volcano Trek Today

Don’t miss the chance to explore one of Lanzarote’s most iconic natural wonders. Book your Trekking Volcano Natural Reserve tour today and immerse yourself in the island’s unique volcanic landscapes. Whether you’re traveling solo, with family, or in a group, this unforgettable adventure promises a deep connection to nature and an appreciation for Lanzarote’s geological and cultural heritage.

Receive brief safety instructions and start the hiking adventure to discover the Volcanoes Natural Park, also known as the lunar landscape of Lanzarote, located next to the Fire Mountains of the National Park of Timanfaya. Our experienced guides will lead you through breathtaking trails, allowing you to discover the awe-inspiring volcanic lunar landscape of Lanzarote. We’ll explore the remnants of a volcanic eruption that occurred between 1730 and 1736, delving into the intriguing history behind these captivating lava fields.

Recibe unas breves instrucciones de seguridad y comienza la aventura de senderismo para descubrir el Parque Natural de los Volcanes, también conocido como el paisaje lunar de Lanzarote, situado junto a las Montañas de Fuego del Parque Nacional de Timanfaya. Antes de emprender nuestro viaje, repasemos unas breves instrucciones de seguridad.
Nuestros experimentados guías le conducirán por impresionantes senderos, permitiéndole descubrir el sobrecogedor paisaje lunar volcánico de Lanzarote. Exploraremos los restos de una erupción volcánica que tuvo lugar entre 1730 y 1736, adentrándonos en la intrigante historia que se esconde tras estos cautivadores campos de lava.

es.title: Descanso rápido para recargar energía y disfrutar de unas vistas impresionantes
es.text: Aquí podrá saborear refrescantes bebidas, deleitarse con una barrita energética acompañada de una selección de frutas frescas, y ser testigo de la fuerza bruta de la naturaleza mientras disfrutamos de impresionantes vistas del escarpado terreno, sumergiéndonos en la belleza única de este paraíso volcánico.

es.title: Regreso al punto de partida y entrega en el punto de recogida
es.text: Tras nuestra esclarecedora aventura de senderismo, le dejaremos en el punto de recogida para su mayor comodidad. Nuestros expertos guías velarán por su seguridad durante todo el viaje. Relájese y reflexione sobre las extraordinarias vistas mientras le transportamos al pasado, atesorando los recuerdos de esta experiencia única.

en: Can I drive to the starting point?
Yes, you can drive and meet us at the starting point. Click “no pick-up required,” and we will send you the confirmation with the GPS location of the starting point and time.
Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pick-up points are in hotels or the nearest bus stops.
Pick-up starts at 08:30 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick-up.
How far are the pick-up points?
We normally pick up outside reception unless the hotel doesn’t allow it, in which case we will send you the most approximate hotel with pick-up.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly. However, we pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you with GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where/when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay at collection time, to our guides. Payment can be done using a credit card or cash.
Do I have free time?
Yes, we have plenty of free time. We even stop for a break to recharge energy.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can go as you please. Comfortable clothing and trainers are what we recommend. Hats and sunglasses for the summer season and a jumper for winter time as it can be windy in the morning.
How long is the trekking?
The hike lasts for approximately 2 hours, and we cover 8 km at a moderate pace.
What is the grade of difficulty of this activity?
The hike is of moderate difficulty. We won’t be climbing any big hills.
Is there a stop for food, and is it included?
No, there is no stop for food, but we have a break to get refreshments and we offer water, energy bars, and fruits.
Am I allowed to bring food?

overview.en:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with the Trekking Famara Hills tour, where you’ll discover the captivating beauty of Lanzarote’s unique volcanic landscapes. This guided trekking experience offers breathtaking views, cultural insights, and a journey into the heart of nature, making it a must-do excursion for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.

Start Your Journey in Ye Village and Explore the Majestic Corona Volcano

Your adventure begins in the tranquil and picturesque village of Ye, located in the northern part of Lanzarote. From here, we embark on an invigorating trek towards the stunning Corona Volcano, a geological marvel that dominates the surrounding landscape. As you ascend, you'll be immersed in the island’s volcanic beauty. The climb takes you through a scenic agricultural area, where you’ll pass by vineyards growing on rich volcanic soil, a tradition passed down through generations.

At the summit, you’ll reach the volcano's spectacular crater, offering panoramic views of the dramatic lava fields, known locally as malpaíses. These expansive fields, filled with rugged basaltic rock formations, stretch toward the sparkling emerald sea, creating an awe-inspiring contrast. You’ll have the opportunity to explore the crater itself and witness one of the island’s most remarkable natural wonders.

Witness the Volcanic History and the Hidden Lava Tubes

As we explore the eastern face of the Corona Volcano, you’ll discover the fascinating 7.6 km long volcanic tube, a geological formation that speaks to Lanzarote’s fiery origins. Part of this extensive lava tube is now submerged under the sea, a remnant of ancient eruptions that shaped the island’s coastline during the last Ice Age, when sea levels were dramatically lower. The story of this volcanic activity offers a glimpse into Lanzarote's dynamic past, where fire and water sculpted the land we see today.

Hike Along the Famara Cliff with Panoramic Views

From the Corona Volcano, we continue our trek along the central part of the Famara cliff, one of the island's most iconic natural landmarks. As you descend, the path opens up to sweeping vistas of Lanzarote’s highest peak and the stunning Isla La Graciosa. This idyllic island, sitting just offshore, is a perfect backdrop for photographs, with its pristine beaches and untouched beauty.

The elevated vantage point on the Famara cliff offers unmatched panoramic views, allowing you to take in the vast expanse of Lanzarote’s volcanic landscape, the Atlantic Ocean, and the nearby islands. The natural grandeur of this area is truly mesmerizing and serves as an ideal spot for capturing unforgettable memories.

Refresh and Recharge Amidst Nature’s Splendor

After several kilometers of hiking, we take a well-deserved break in this serene setting. Enjoy a selection of refreshing drinks, fresh fruits, and energy bars as you relax and recharge. The tranquil atmosphere and breathtaking views surrounding you provide the perfect opportunity to reflect on the beauty of Lanzarote’s unique environment.

As you recharge, you’ll be surrounded by the vibrant colors and sounds of nature, from the deep blue ocean to the rugged volcanic rock, creating a sensory experience that will leave a lasting impression. Whether you're capturing photos, taking in the peaceful surroundings, or simply recharging for the trek back, this pause will prepare you for the final leg of your adventure.

Experience the Best of Lanzarote’s Natural Beauty

The Trekking Famara Hills tour is an incredible journey through Lanzarote's volcanic landscape, offering both adventure and relaxation in one of the island's most scenic regions. Whether you're a seasoned hiker or a nature enthusiast, this tour offers the perfect balance of physical activity and natural beauty, leaving you with unforgettable memories of Lanzarote's volcanic origins and stunning coastal views.

Don’t miss the chance to experience the wild beauty of the Famara Hills and the Corona Volcano – book your tour today and embark on an adventure of a lifetime.

en.title: Pick-up from accommodation

en.title: Start at the village of Ye and explore the Corona Volcano

As we ascend to its crater, we’ll be treated to stunning views of the agricultural landscape, primarily vineyards, and the impressive lava flows known as malpaíses. This eruption occurred during the last glacial period when the sea level was more than 90 meters lower than it is today.

en.text: Next, we’ll descend and hike a few kilometers in the central part of the Famara cliff. From a short distance away, we’ll have a magnificent view of the island’s highest point and the pristine Island of La Graciosa in the foreground, truly inspiring and a perfect spot for memorable photos.

As you recharge your energy for the hike back, you’ll be captivated by the vibrant beauty of nature and treated to unforgettable, breathtaking views that will leave a lasting impression.

en.text: After our enlightening hiking adventure, we’ll drop you off at the collection point for your convenience. Our knowledgeable guides ensure your safety throughout the journey. Tras explorar el cráter del volcán, nos dirigiremos a la cara este para observar el tubo volcánico de 7,6 km de longitud, parte del cual se encuentra ahora sumergido. Esta erupción se produjo durante el último periodo glaciar, cuando el nivel del mar era más de 90 metros inferior al actual.

es.text: A continuación, descenderemos y caminaremos unos kilómetros por la parte central del acantilado de Famara. Desde una corta distancia, tendremos una magnífica vista del punto más alto de la isla y la prístina isla de La Graciosa en primer plano, realmente inspiradora y un lugar perfecto para fotos memorables.

es.text: Aquí podrá saborear bebidas refrescantes, deleitarse con una barra energética acompañada de una selección de frutas frescas y sumergirse en un ambiente sereno y tranquilo. Mientras recarga energías para la caminata de vuelta, quedará cautivado por la vibrante belleza de la naturaleza y disfrutará de unas vistas inolvidables e impresionantes que le dejarán una huella imborrable.

Customers can pay at collection time, to our guides. Payment can be done using a credit card or cash.

Yes, we have plenty of free time. We even stop for a break to recharge energy.

You can go as you please. Comfortable clothing and trainers are what we recommend. Hats and sunglasses for the summer season and a jumper for winter time as it can be windy in the morning.

The hike lasts for approximately 2 hours, and we cover 8 km at a moderate pace.

The hike is of moderate difficulty. We won’t be climbing any big hills.

Yes, of course. Take some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.

Friday Night Shark Fishing in Lanzarote

Join a 12-hour night fishing trip from Puerto Calero and head into the Atlantic in search of sharks to fish for.

The trip departs every Friday at 7:00 PM. Please go directly to Puerto Calero harbour. Transport and hotel pick-up are not provided, and no pick-up service can be added to the booking.

The price is €150 per adult. There is no spectator fare or spectator-only booking option.

The trip is expected to return to Puerto Calero at approximately 7:00 AM on Saturday. Shark encounters or catches cannot be guaranteed.

Looking for another experience? Explore all our excursions .

Pesca nocturna de tiburones en Lanzarote

Disfruta de una salida de pesca nocturna de 12 horas desde Puerto Calero. Navegaremos por el Atlántico para buscar tiburones y pescarlos.

La salida es todos los viernes a las 19:00. Los clientes deben acudir directamente al puerto de Puerto Calero. No se incluye recogida ni se puede añadir como servicio extra.

overview.en:
Rancho Texas Animal & Splash Park Entry: The Ultimate Family Adventure

Looking for an action-packed day out in Lanzarote? Rancho Texas Lanzarote Animal & Splash Park is the perfect destination for a family-friendly adventure filled with excitement, fun, and education. Situated in Puerto del Carmen, this all-in-one park combines the wonders of wildlife with the thrill of water attractions, making it an ideal spot for both nature lovers and those seeking a splash of adventure.

Discover Fascinating Wildlife

Step into a world of fascinating creatures from around the globe. Rancho Texas Animal Park offers you the chance to witness incredible animals up close in a safe and beautiful environment. Watch as majestic tigers roam, marvel at the intelligence of dolphins as they perform incredible tricks, and be amazed by the grace and agility of sea lions during their playful shows. For bird enthusiasts, the eagle and birds of prey presentations will leave you in awe as these magnificent creatures soar high above you, demonstrating their power and precision.

The park is home to a variety of species, from exotic reptiles to cuddly mammals, offering something for every animal lover. Families with children will especially enjoy the petting zoo, where little ones can interact with friendly farm animals and learn more about the care of these wonderful creatures.

Fun in the Sun: Splash Park Adventure

If you're looking to cool off after a day of animal exploration, the splash park awaits! With its exhilarating water slides, wave pool, and relaxing lazy river, Rancho Texas Splash Park provides endless entertainment for visitors of all ages. The water park is the perfect complement to the animal exhibits, offering families a fun-filled break to beat the Lanzarote heat.

For adrenaline seekers, the towering water slides will give you that thrill you're after, while those seeking relaxation can unwind by the poolside or take a gentle float down the lazy river. Whether you're racing down a slide or soaking up the sun, the splash park guarantees a memorable time for everyone.

Daily Shows and Interactive Experiences

Rancho Texas takes its animal presentations to the next level by offering captivating, interactive shows throughout the day. Be sure to catch the Dolphin Show, where these incredibly intelligent creatures dazzle with their acrobatic displays and heartwarming tricks. The Sea Lion Show showcases these charming marine mammals' playful nature, while the Eagle and Birds of Prey Show features awe-inspiring aerial feats that will leave you breathless.

The park also offers unique opportunities to meet and interact with some of its residents. Get up close with dolphins, feed the friendly goats at the petting zoo, or learn more about birds of prey in an educational encounter. Each experience is designed to entertain and educate, making Rancho Texas an enriching visit for both children and adults alike.

Perfect for Families, Couples, and Groups

Rancho Texas Animal & Splash Park is more than just an animal park; it’s an adventure for all ages. Families will love the variety of activities, from the thrilling water rides to the interactive animal exhibits. Couples can enjoy a romantic stroll through beautifully landscaped gardens, hand in hand, as they discover exotic wildlife together. Even groups of friends will find the combination of water park excitement and wildlife exploration the ideal way to spend a day under the Lanzarote sun.

Plan Your Visit

Rancho Texas Lanzarote is open year-round, making it a fantastic option no matter when you visit the island. With dining options available within the park, you can refuel during your day of exploration and play. Don’t miss out on the chance to experience one of Lanzarote’s top attractions – book your tickets for Rancho Texas Animal & Splash Park now and get ready for a day full of unforgettable memories.
overview.es:
Entrada al Parque de Animales y Chapoteo Rancho Texas: La Aventura Familiar Definitiva

¿Buscas un día lleno de acción en Lanzarote? Rancho Texas Lanzarote Animal & Splash Park es el destino perfecto para una aventura familiar llena de emoción, diversión y educación. Situado en Puerto del Carmen, este parque todo en uno combina las maravillas de la vida salvaje con la emoción de las atracciones acuáticas, lo que lo convierte en un lugar ideal tanto para los amantes de la naturaleza como para los que buscan un chapuzón de aventura.

Descubre una fauna fascinante

Adéntrate en un mundo de fascinantes criaturas de todo el planeta. El Parque de Animales Rancho Texas te ofrece la oportunidad de presenciar de cerca animales increíbles en un entorno seguro y hermoso. Observa cómo deambulan los majestuosos tigres, maravíllate ante la inteligencia de los delfines mientras realizan increíbles trucos, y sorpréndete ante la gracia y agilidad de los leones marinos durante sus juguetones espectáculos. Para los entusiastas de las aves, las presentaciones de águilas y aves rapaces te dejarán asombrado mientras estas magníficas criaturas se elevan por encima de ti, demostrando su poder y precisión.

El parque alberga una gran variedad de especies, desde reptiles exóticos hasta mimosos mamíferos, ofreciendo algo para cada amante de los animales. Las familias con niños disfrutarán especialmente del zoo de mascotas, donde los pequeños pueden interactuar con simpáticos animales de granja y aprender más sobre el cuidado de estas maravillosas criaturas.

Diversión al sol: Aventura en el Parque Acuático

Si quieres refrescarte tras un día de exploración animal, ¡el parque acuático te espera! Con sus estimulantes toboganes de agua, su piscina de olas y su relajante río perezoso, el Splash Park del Rancho Texas ofrece entretenimiento sin fin a visitantes de todas las edades. El parque acuático es el complemento perfecto de las exposiciones de animales, y ofrece a las familias un descanso lleno de diversión para combatir el calor de Lanzarote.

Para los que buscan adrenalina, los altísimos toboganes acuáticos te proporcionarán la emoción que buscas, mientras que los que buscan relajación pueden descansar junto a la piscina o flotar suavemente por el río lento. Tanto si te lanzas a toda velocidad por un tobogán como si tomas el sol, el parque acuático garantiza un momento memorable para todos.

Espectáculos diarios y experiencias interactivas

Rancho Texas lleva sus presentaciones de animales al siguiente nivel ofreciendo espectáculos cautivadores e interactivos durante todo el día. No dejes de ver el Espectáculo de los Delfines, donde estas criaturas increíblemente inteligentes deslumbran con sus exhibiciones acrobáticas y sus conmovedores trucos. El Espectáculo de Leones Marinos muestra la naturaleza juguetona de estos encantadores mamíferos marinos, mientras que el Espectáculo de Águilas y Aves de Presa presenta asombrosas proezas aéreas que te dejarán sin aliento.

El parque también ofrece oportunidades únicas de conocer e interactuar con algunos de sus residentes. Acércate a los delfines, da de comer a las simpáticas cabras del zoo de mascotas o aprende más sobre las aves rapaces en un encuentro educativo. Cada experiencia está diseñada para entretener y educar, haciendo del Rancho Texas una visita enriquecedora tanto para niños como para adultos.

Perfecto para familias, parejas y grupos

Rancho Texas Animal & Splash Park es más que un parque de animales: es una aventura para todas las edades. A las familias les encantará la variedad de actividades, desde las emocionantes atracciones acuáticas hasta las exposiciones interactivas de animales. Las parejas pueden disfrutar de un romántico paseo por hermosos jardines, cogidos de la mano, mientras descubren juntos fauna exótica. Incluso los grupos de amigos encontrarán que la combinación de la emoción del parque acuático y la exploración de la fauna es la forma ideal de pasar un día bajo el sol de Lanzarote.

Planifica tu visita

Rancho Texas Lanzarote está abierto todo el año, por lo que es una opción fantástica independientemente de cuándo visites la isla. Con opciones para comer dentro del parque, podrás reponer fuerzas durante tu día de exploración y juego. No pierdas la oportunidad de experimentar una de las principales atracciones de Lanzarote: reserva ya tus entradas para el Rancho Texas Animal & Splash Park y prepárate para un día lleno de recuerdos inolvidables.

en: Can I drive to the park?
Yes, certainly, book an open ticket to use any day you desire to go in.
Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have pickups that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. Pickup points are in hotels or the approximate bus stop. Pickup starts at 09:00 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indications if your hotel doesn’t have pickup.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we do pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you with GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
How long are we at Rancho Texas Park?
There’s plenty of time to enjoy at the park; we are there from 10 o’clock until approximately 16:0017:00 o’clock.
How long will I be on the bus?
The bus journey to Rancho Texas takes a maximum of 20 minutes.
In which language are the shows?
The presentations and shows are in English and Spanish.
Where / when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can get on the transfer bus with our eticket and pay the balance at the entrance to the park.
Can we organize a taxi service to Rancho Texas, and how much would it cost?

Yes, we certainly can help customers book a taxi service upon request. The taxi cost depends on where you are staying:
Customers staying in Puerto del Carmen taxi costs are approximately 5€.
Customers staying in Playa Blanca taxi costs are approximately 40-50€.
Customers staying in Costa Teguise taxi costs are 20-30€.
Can we get a taxi back to the hotel?
Yes, certainly, there is a taxi stop right outside the park, and if not, the reception at Rancho Texas can help you call a taxi.
What sort of clothes do I need?

You can go as you please, comfortable clothing and trainers are what we recommend. Hats and sunglasses for the Summer season and a jumper for Winter time as it can be windy in the morning, swimming costumes and towels for those who wish to go on the slides or have a swim.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as they have an assistant and can go on and off the transfer bus, they are welcome.
Is there anywhere to eat at Rancho Texas Park?
Yes, there’s an American diner where customers can order drinks and food.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course, take some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there are toilets at Rancho Texas Park.
Is it allowed to swim with Sealions or Dolphins?
Yes, it is allowed if you have a prebooked interaction. Head over to the activity page and book separately.

Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.

¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en Rancho Texas Park?
Hay tiempo de sobra para disfrutar en el parque; estamos allí desde las 10 hasta aproximadamente las 16:0017:00 horas.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaré en el autobús?
El viaje en autobús a Rancho Texas dura un máximo de 20 minutos.
¿En qué idioma están los espectáculos?
Las presentaciones y espectáculos son en inglés y español.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden subir al autobús de traslado con nuestro billete electrónico y pagar el resto a la entrada del parque.

Sí, podemos ayudar a los clientes que lo soliciten a reservar un servicio de taxi. El coste del taxi depende del lugar donde se aloje:
Los clientes que se alojen en Puerto del Carmen el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 5€.
Los clientes que se alojen en Playa Blanca el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 40-50€.
Los clientes que se alojan en Costa Teguise el coste del taxi es de 20-30€.
¿Podemos volver en taxi al hotel?
Sí, ciertamente, hay una parada de taxis justo fuera del parque, y si no, la recepción del Rancho Texas puede ayudarle a llamar a un taxi.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?

Puedes ir como quieras, lo que te recomendamos es ropa cómoda y zapatillas deportivas. Sombreros y gafas de sol para la temporada de verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana, bañadores y toallas para los que deseen tirarse por los toboganes o darse un chapuzón.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que tengan un asistente y puedan subir y bajar del autobús de traslado, son bienvenidos.
¿Hay algún sitio para comer en Rancho Texas Park?
Sí, hay un restaurante americano donde los clientes pueden pedir bebidas y comida.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto, llévate algo de picar y beber, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en Rancho Texas Park.
¿Está permitido nadar con leones marinos o delfines?
Sí, está permitido si tiene una interacción reservada con antelación. Diríjase a la página de la actividad y reserve por separado.

overview.en:
Rancho Texas Park Interaction with Dolphins - SEO Optimized Description

Discover an unforgettable day of adventure and wonder at Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park, where nature, wildlife, and exhilarating activities come together for a one-of-a-kind experience. Ideal for families, couples, and animal lovers, this park offers a unique opportunity to get up close and personal with some of the world's most fascinating creatures. The highlight of your visit will undoubtedly be the Interaction with Dolphins, where you can share an intimate moment with these intelligent and playful marine mammals.

Imagine stepping into the crystal-clear waters, feeling the excitement as a dolphin gracefully swims by your side. This once-in-a-lifetime experience allows you to learn about the behavior, communication, and conservation efforts surrounding these magnificent creatures, all while under the guidance of expert trainers who ensure both the dolphins' welfare and your safety. Not only will you interact with these incredible animals, but you’ll also leave with a newfound respect for marine life and the efforts being made to protect them.

But Rancho Texas Park is much more than just dolphin encounters. The park features a wide variety of captivating animal shows and activities that will leave you in awe. Watch as sea lions perform stunning tricks, be mesmerized by eagle and birds of prey demonstrations, and don’t miss the opportunity to see other fascinating creatures, including tigers, armadillos, and exotic birds.

As you explore the beautifully landscaped park, take in the natural surroundings, from lush tropical plants to tranquil water features, all while enjoying the sightings of different species in their well-maintained habitats. You’ll find the park to be a perfect blend of fun, education, and relaxation.

For those looking for even more excitement, the splash park offers an exhilarating adventure. Slide down fast-paced water slides, cool off in the splash zones, and unwind in the sun while kids play in the water playground. Rancho Texas Park's splash area is a refreshing way to round off your day of exploration.

The park also offers several dining options with restaurants and cafes that cater to all tastes, from local cuisine to international favorites. Enjoy a relaxed meal with views of the park’s scenic surroundings, or grab a quick snack between activities.

Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park is more than just a day out—it's an immersive experience where education, adventure, and conservation meet. Whether you're interacting with dolphins, enjoying animal shows, or splashing around in the water park, Rancho Texas offers an unforgettable experience for visitors of all ages. Make lasting memories as you engage with wildlife and enjoy the many thrills the park has to offer.
overview.es: Viva un día perfecto lleno de emoción y alegría en el Parque de Animales Rancho Texas Lanzarote, un destino ideal tanto para familias como para parejas. Deléitese con cautivadores espectáculos de delfines, fascinantes actuaciones de leones marinos, emocionantes presentaciones de águilas y aves rapaces, y explore las maravillas de la naturaleza mientras pasea por el parque y se topa con animales exóticos. Para una dosis extra de diversión, disfrute de un emocionante paseo en los excitantes toboganes del parque acuático.

es.title: Nadar con leones marinos con entrada Parque Rancho Texas - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Discover a once-in-a-lifetime adventure at Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park with the exclusive "Swim with Sealions" experience. Perfect for families, couples, and animal lovers, this tour lets you interact closely with these playful marine mammals in a safe, supervised environment. Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the park’s specially designed pool and enjoy unforgettable moments as you swim, play, and bond with friendly sea lions.

The experience begins with a comprehensive briefing from expert trainers who will introduce you to the sea lions’ unique behaviors and personalities. You’ll learn fascinating facts about their natural habitats, diet, and playful communication style. Once you enter the water, the magic truly begins—feel the thrill as these intelligent creatures glide beside you, perform tricks, and show off their agility.

But the adventure doesn’t stop there! After your sea lion encounter, take time to explore the rest of Rancho Texas Park. Watch jaw-dropping live animal shows, including the famous dolphin and birds of prey performances. Wander through beautifully landscaped areas where you’ll find exotic animals like white tigers, Komodo dragons, and more. The park also features a thrilling splash zone where kids and adults alike can enjoy water slides and refreshing pools.

Rancho Texas Park is not just a zoo—it’s a full-day experience filled with excitement, education, and plenty of photo-worthy moments. Whether you're relaxing in the park’s lush surroundings or engaging in hands-on wildlife experiences, this tour guarantees a fun-filled day for all ages.

Book your "Swim with Sealions" experience now for a day of unforgettable memories in the heart of Lanzarote!

Highlights:

  • Exclusive sea lion swimming experience with professional trainers.
  • Learn about sea lion behavior and habitats in a fun, interactive way.
  • Explore Rancho Texas Park’s exotic wildlife, including dolphins, eagles, and more.
  • Access to the splash zone with exhilarating water slides and pools.
  • A perfect adventure for families, couples, and nature lovers.
overview.es: Viva un día perfecto lleno de emoción y alegría en el Parque de Animales Rancho Texas Lanzarote, un destino ideal tanto para familias como para parejas. Deléitese con cautivadores espectáculos de delfines, fascinantes actuaciones de leones marinos, emocionantes presentaciones de águilas y aves rapaces, y explore las maravillas de la naturaleza mientras pasea por el parque y se topa con animales exóticos. Para una dosis extra de diversión, disfrute de un emocionante paseo en los excitantes toboganes del parque acuático.

es.text: Cuando su emocionante día en nuestro parque de animales llegue a su fin, asegúrese de pasar por la oficina para ver las increíbles fotos tomadas durante su visita. en: Can I drive to the park?
Yes, certainly, book an open ticket to use any day you desire to go in.
Where and what time will I get picked up?

We have pickups that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. Pickup points are in hotels or the approximate bus stop. Pickup starts at 09:00 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indications if your hotel doesn’t have pickup.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we do pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you with GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
How long are we at Rancho Texas Park?
There’s plenty of time to enjoy at the park; we are there from 10 o’clock until approximately 16:0017:00 o’clock.
How long will I be on the bus?
The bus journey to Rancho Texas takes a maximum of 20 minutes.
In which language are the shows?
The presentations and shows are in English and Spanish.
Where / when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can get on the transfer bus with our eticket and pay the balance at the entrance to the park.
Can we organize a taxi service to Rancho Texas, and how much would it cost?

Yes, we certainly can help customers book a taxi service upon request. The taxi cost depends on where you are staying:
Customers staying in Puerto del Carmen taxi costs are approximately 5€.
Customers staying in Playa Blanca taxi costs are approximately 40-50€.
Customers staying in Costa Teguise taxi costs are 20-30€.
Can we get a taxi back to the hotel?
Yes, certainly, there is a taxi stop right outside the park, and if not, the reception at Rancho Texas can help you call a taxi.
What sort of clothes do I need?

You can go as you please, comfortable clothing and trainers are what we recommend. Hats and sunglasses for the Summer season and a jumper for Winter time as it can be windy in the morning, swimming costumes and towels for those who wish to go on the slides or have a swim.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as they have an assistant and can go on and off the transfer bus, they are welcome.
Is there anywhere to eat at Rancho Texas Park?
Yes, there’s an American diner where customers can order drinks and food.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course, take some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there are toilets at Rancho Texas Park.
Is it allowed to swim with Sealions or Dolphins?
Yes, it is allowed if you have a prebooked interaction. Head over to the activity page and book separately.
es: ¿Puedo ir al parque en coche?
Sí, desde luego, reserve un billete abierto para utilizarlo cualquier día que desee entrar.
¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?

Tenemos recogidas que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en la parada de autobús más cercana. La recogida comienza a las 09:00 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicaciones GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?

No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en Rancho Texas Park?
Hay tiempo de sobra para disfrutar en el parque; estamos allí desde las 10 hasta aproximadamente las 16:0017:00 horas.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaré en el autobús?
El viaje en autobús a Rancho Texas dura un máximo de 20 minutos.
¿En qué idioma están los espectáculos?
Las presentaciones y espectáculos son en inglés y español.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden subir al autobús de traslado con nuestro billete electrónico y pagar el resto a la entrada del parque.
¿Podemos organizar un servicio de taxi a Rancho Texas, y cuánto costaría?

Sí, podemos ayudar a los clientes que lo soliciten a reservar un servicio de taxi. El coste del taxi depende del lugar donde se aloje:
Los clientes que se alojen en Puerto del Carmen el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 5€.
Los clientes que se alojen en Playa Blanca el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 40-50€.
Los clientes que se alojan en Costa Teguise el coste del taxi es de 20-30€.
¿Podemos volver en taxi al hotel?
Sí, ciertamente, hay una parada de taxis justo fuera del parque, y si no, la recepción del Rancho Texas puede ayudarle a llamar a un taxi.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?

Puedes ir como quieras, lo que te recomendamos es ropa cómoda y zapatillas deportivas. Sombreros y gafas de sol para la temporada de verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana, bañadores y toallas para los que deseen tirarse por los toboganes o darse un chapuzón.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que tengan un asistente y puedan subir y bajar del autobús de traslado, son bienvenidos.
¿Hay algún sitio para comer en Rancho Texas Park?
Sí, hay un restaurante americano donde los clientes pueden pedir bebidas y comida.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto, llévate algo de picar y beber, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en Rancho Texas Park.
¿Está permitido nadar con leones marinos o delfines?
Sí, está permitido si tiene una interacción reservada con antelación. Diríjase a la página de la actividad y reserve por separado.

overview.en:
Aqualava Playa Blanca: The Ultimate Family-Friendly Waterpark in Lanzarote

Looking for a fun-filled day out with the family in Lanzarote? Aqualava Waterpark in Playa Blanca is the perfect destination. Set against the stunning backdrop of Lanzarote's volcanic landscape, Aqualava offers an unforgettable experience for all ages, with its unique volcanic theme and state-of-the-art attractions. Whether you’re seeking thrilling water rides, relaxing lazy rivers, or heated pools for younger kids, Aqualava has something for everyone.

A Volcanic-Themed Water Adventure

Aqualava Waterpark stands out for its one-of-a-kind volcanic theme, making it a unique experience in the Canary Islands. The park's design is inspired by Lanzarote's natural beauty, with features that mimic volcanic landscapes, creating an immersive environment for visitors. From the heated pools that allow year-round enjoyment to the impressive wave pool that brings the ocean's rhythm to the park, every detail reflects the island's rich geological history.

Perfect for Families

Aqualava is the ultimate family-friendly waterpark in Playa Blanca. It caters to families with children of all ages, from toddlers to teenagers, and even adults who are young at heart. The waterpark’s medium size means you can keep an eye on your little ones without feeling overwhelmed by crowds. The heated pools ensure that babies and toddlers can splash around comfortably, while the gentle current of the lazy river offers a relaxing way to spend the afternoon.

For the more adventurous, the wave pool, with its periodic waves, provides the thrill of the ocean without leaving the park. Kids and adults alike will love the slides and splash zones designed to offer just the right amount of excitement.

Sustainability Meets Fun

One of the unique aspects of Aqualava Waterpark is its commitment to sustainability. The park is eco-friendly, running on renewable energy to minimize its environmental impact. Aqualava prides itself on combining fun with environmental responsibility, ensuring that visitors can enjoy their day out while also being mindful of the beautiful surroundings of Lanzarote.

Convenience and Comfort for All Visitors

Aqualava Playa Blanca offers everything you need for a comfortable and enjoyable day. With on-site restaurants serving delicious meals, snacks, and drinks, you’ll have no trouble finding something to eat between rides. There are also sunbeds and shaded areas where families can relax and take a break. The park is fully equipped with modern facilities, including changing rooms, lockers, and accessibility features for disabled guests.

Whether you’re staying in Playa Blanca or traveling from other parts of Lanzarote, Aqualava Waterpark is easy to reach. The park provides ample parking and is close to major transport links, making it a convenient day trip from anywhere on the island.

Plan Your Visit to Aqualava Playa Blanca Today!

Ready to experience the best waterpark in Lanzarote? Book your tickets to Aqualava Playa Blanca today and make lasting memories with your family. Whether you’re splashing around in the heated pools, riding the waves in the wave pool, or simply relaxing by the lazy river, Aqualava offers the perfect blend of fun, excitement, and relaxation. Don’t miss out on this must-visit attraction in Lanzarote!
overview.es: Presentamos Aqualava, el único parque acuático de la isla, con una emocionante temática volcánica y atractivas piscinas climatizadas. Es el destino familiar por excelencia, ideal tanto para bebés como para niños. Con su tamaño medio, Aqualava ofrece una experiencia encantadora para todos los visitantes, con un largo río lento y una emocionante piscina de olas. Ven a explorar la mezcla perfecta de diversión y relajación en el parque acuático Aqualava.

overview.en:
Aquapark Costa Teguise – Lanzarote’s Premier Water Adventure

Looking for an unforgettable day of fun under the sun? Welcome to Aquapark Costa Teguise, Lanzarote’s largest and most thrilling waterpark, perfect for families, friends, and adventurers of all ages. Located in the heart of Costa Teguise, this waterpark offers an exciting escape with adrenaline-pumping slides, kid-friendly attractions, and spaces to relax and unwind.

Aquapark Costa Teguise is home to an impressive variety of water attractions that cater to thrill-seekers and leisure lovers alike. Whether you're in the mood to plunge down high-speed slides or float along the peaceful lazy river, the park has something for everyone. Brave the Kamikaze for a heart-racing drop, swirl through twisting tunnels, or challenge your friends in the Multilane races. Little ones can splash safely in designated children’s areas, featuring mini-slides, splash pads, and shallow pools for endless entertainment.

The fun doesn't stop at the water attractions! Aquapark Costa Teguise also features a wave pool, offering the perfect simulation of ocean swells, allowing guests to ride the waves without leaving the park. If relaxation is more your style, head to the cabanas or sun loungers to enjoy the serene atmosphere. Surrounded by lush greenery and shaded seating areas, it's the perfect spot to take a break and recharge.

For families, the park is an ideal destination. The children’s zone ensures young visitors have a safe and exciting experience with age-appropriate rides and splash areas. Parents can relax knowing their little ones are well taken care of, while still enjoying all the park has to offer.

Feeling hungry after all that excitement? Aquapark Costa Teguise boasts a selection of food options, from light snacks to full meals, so you can refuel without leaving the park. Enjoy delicious treats at the on-site restaurant or grab a quick bite at one of the snack bars.

Aquapark Costa Teguise is open from April to November, making it the perfect warm-weather destination for your Lanzarote holiday. With easy access from major resorts and hotels, it's a must-visit attraction during your stay on the island. Don't miss out on an action-packed day filled with laughter, adventure, and unforgettable memories.

Yes, but they are not allowed on slides for safety reasons.
Is the Waterpark water heated?
No, this Waterpark doesn’t have heated pools. You can head over to Aqualava Playa Blanca Waterpark for this option.
Is there anywhere to get food and drinks from?
Yes, there is a restaurant with a bar inside the Park.
Can I leave the Waterpark and come back in?
Yes, certainly you can leave and come back.
es: ¿Dónde están las camionetas?

Recogemos en Playa Blanca y Puerto del Carmen, seleccione su hotel y le enviaremos la hora y las indicaciones para su recogida más cercana en caso de que su hotel no tenga recogida fuera. Tenga en cuenta que nuestro servicio de traslado tiene un coste adicional de 7€ por persona.
¿El coste del traslado de 7 euros incluye la vuelta?
Sí, el coste corresponde a un servicio de devolución.
¿Recogemos en Costa Teguise?
No, el Parque Acuático está a menos de 10 minutos y a unos 4€ en taxi. Háganos saber en las observaciones en el momento de la reserva si necesita ayuda para organizar un servicio de taxi.
¿Puedo ir andando al Parque Acuático desde Costa Teguise Pueblo?
Sí, se puede, aunque hay que tener en cuenta que es una caminata de entre 40 minutos y 1 hora.
¿Hay taxis fuera del Parque Acuático?
Sí, hay una parada de taxis fuera del Parque Acuático. Si no, la recepción puede ayudarle a llamar a un taxi.
¿Cuánto cuesta el taxi hasta el parque?

Depende de dónde se aloje:
El servicio de taxi desde Costa Teguise cuesta 35€.
Desde Puerto del Carmen, cuesta unos 20-30€.
Desde Playa Blanca, aproximadamente 60-70€.
¿Cuándo y cómo pago el saldo?
Los clientes pagan el saldo a su llegada a la entrada del parque. Aceptamos pagos con tarjeta o en efectivo.
¿Hay alguna restricción de edad?
No, todo el mundo es bienvenido, y nuestro establecimiento ofrece algo para todas las edades.
¿Hay restricciones de altura?
Sí, los niños tienen que alcanzar 1,2 metros para poder subirse a los toboganes grandes.
¿El parque acuático es accesible para personas en silla de ruedas?
Sí, hemos adaptado nuestras instalaciones para acoger a todo el mundo.
¿Se permite la entrada a mujeres embarazadas?
Sí, pero no están permitidos en los toboganes por razones de seguridad.
¿Se calienta el agua del parque acuático?
No, este parque acuático no tiene piscinas climatizadas. Puedes dirigirte al Parque Acuático Aqualava Playa Blanca para esta opción.
¿Hay algún sitio donde conseguir comida y bebida?
Sí, hay un restaurante con bar dentro del Parque.
¿Puedo salir del parque acuático y volver a entrar?
Sí, claro que puedes irte y volver.

en.description: Enjoy BBQ, live country music, fire shows, pony rides & more at Lanzarote’s exciting Country & Western Night event!

es.title: Noche Country & Western - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Experience a night of excitement and authentic Western fun at the famous Country & Western Night on Lanzarote’s renowned ranch. Whether you’re visiting as a couple or with your family, this unforgettable evening is packed with thrilling entertainment, delicious food, and vibrant music, making it a perfect addition to your holiday itinerary.

As the sun sets over the island, get ready to indulge in a mouthwatering barbecue feast, where freshly grilled meats and vegetarian options are paired with a range of refreshing beverages. Enjoy free-flowing sangria, ice-cold beer, and soft drinks for the kids as you soak up the warm, welcoming atmosphere. It’s a culinary experience that promises to delight every member of the family.

The entertainment lineup for the night is equally spectacular. Marvel at expert whip and lasso performances that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and be captivated by mesmerizing fire shows that light up the evening sky. Throughout the event, live country music fills the air, creating the perfect backdrop for dancing the night away. Whether you're an experienced dancer or new to the scene, our lively line dancing sessions invite everyone to get involved.

For families, the Country & Western Night is an ideal opportunity for children to have their own adventures. Kids can enjoy pony rides and even take on the challenge of the bucking bronco, all in a safe and fun environment. It’s a night filled with laughter, energy, and Western spirit, ensuring that everyone leaves with lasting memories.

The event is perfect for those looking to add a unique cultural experience to their Lanzarote holiday. With an authentic Western theme, incredible shows, and activities for all ages, Country & Western Night is more than just an evening out—it's an experience that will become a highlight of your trip.

Make sure to bring your dancing boots, a camera to capture the unforgettable moments, and an appetite for fun! Whether you’re a fan of country music or simply looking for a night of adventure, this event has something for everyone.
overview.es: Acompáñenos en una velada inolvidable en el renombrado evento nocturno Country and Western en el Rancho Lanzarote. Deléitese saboreando platos de barbacoa recién hechos a la parrilla, acompañados de sangría, cerveza helada y refrescos adaptados a los más pequeños. Este evento está diseñado para familias y parejas por igual, ofreciendo un cautivador cartel que incluye emocionantes espectáculos de látigo y lazo, hipnotizantes espectáculos de fuego y vibrante música country en directo. No se pierda la oportunidad de ponerse las botas de baile y unirse a la diversión del baile en línea, mientras los niños se embarcan en emocionantes paseos en poni y bronco. Es una noche realmente excepcional que sin duda se convertirá en uno de los momentos culminantes de sus vacaciones.
