overview.en:
Music Hall Tavern Drag Dinner Show – An Unforgettable Night of Laughter, Glamour, and Entertainment!

Get ready for the most hilarious and dazzling night of your holiday at the Music Hall Tavern Drag Dinner Show! This renowned dinner show is one of the top-rated attractions for families, friends, and couples looking for an evening of side-splitting comedy, live entertainment, and great food. It’s an event you won’t want to miss, designed to entertain all ages.

What to Expect at Music Hall Tavern

From the moment you arrive, you’ll be welcomed into a vibrant atmosphere filled with excitement. Start the evening with a delicious, homemade three-course meal, freshly prepared and served at your table. With each dish crafted to perfection, the meal is the perfect prelude to the incredible entertainment ahead.

Once dinner is served, the real fun begins! The Music Hall Tavern is famous for its drag performances, and the show does not disappoint. With dazzling costumes, glitz, and glamour, the drag queens put on an extraordinary performance. Expect tributes to your favorite movies and musicals, comedy sketches that will have you in stitches, and even live singing and dancing.

And for the little ones, there’s a special treat – appearances by the adorable penguins from "Happy Feet"! The show is family-friendly, making it a perfect night out for guests of all ages. As seen on ITV’s Loose Women, this is a must-see attraction during your holiday.

Why Choose the Music Hall Tavern Drag Dinner Show?

  • Top-rated entertainment: Featuring drag queens with incredible comedic timing, stunning outfits, and performances that will leave you cheering for more.
  • Perfect for all ages: A family-friendly show with plenty of laughs for adults and magical moments for children.
  • Delicious food: Enjoy a three-course meal with various options to cater to every palate, all served fresh to your table.
  • Unforgettable atmosphere: From start to finish, this evening offers a fun, interactive experience with a lively crowd and non-stop energy.
  • Memorable moments: Take home memories of jaw-dropping performances, hilarious sketches, and interactions with the cast.

Make Your Night Special

Planning to celebrate something special? The Music Hall Tavern Drag Dinner Show is perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion. The vibrant performers love engaging with the audience, making sure each guest feels part of the action. Whether you’re in the front row or cheering from the back, you’ll be in for a night of fun and laughter.

Don't miss the opportunity to attend the funniest and most entertaining night of your vacation. Whether you are a fan of drag culture or just looking for a unique and enjoyable experience, the Music Hall Tavern promises to deliver a show like no other.

Book your seats now to secure your spot at this fantastic event and prepare for a night you’ll remember for years to come!

Perfecto para familias de todas las edades y como se vio en Loose Women de ITV, es una noche inolvidable de entretenimiento que no se puede perder.

overview.en:
Lobos Island Express Transfers + Ferry: Discover the Hidden Gem of the Canary Islands

Escape to the tranquil beauty of Lobos Island with our Lobos Island Express Transfers + Ferry. This enchanting, uninhabited isle, nestled between Lanzarote and Fuerteventura, offers visitors a rare opportunity to explore one of the Canary Islands' most pristine and serene locations. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, adventure seeker, or simply looking for a peaceful day away from the crowds, Lobos Island has something for everyone.

Why Choose Lobos Island for Your Day Trip?

Lobos Island is a protected nature reserve, meaning its landscapes remain unspoiled by human development. Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted by stunning, crystal-clear waters, untouched beaches, and a sense of isolation that makes it a true hidden gem. With our express ferry service, you can easily and comfortably travel to and from this unique destination, ensuring that your day trip is as smooth as it is memorable.

What to Expect on Lobos Island

  1. Snorkeling in Crystal Waters
    Dive into the serene lagoons around Lobos Island, where the clear waters offer perfect visibility for snorkeling. The marine life here is vibrant and varied, with colorful fish, rays, and other fascinating sea creatures calling these waters home. Bring your snorkeling gear or rent it on the island and immerse yourself in this underwater paradise.

  2. Explore Untouched Natural Beauty
    The island’s small size makes it ideal for trekking. A network of well-marked trails allows visitors to explore Lobos Island at their own pace. Wander through volcanic landscapes, pass by salt marshes, and make your way to the island’s highest point, La Caldera, for a panoramic view of the surrounding Atlantic Ocean and neighboring islands.

  3. Visit Playa de la Concha
    Relax on the stunning Playa de la Concha, a crescent-shaped beach with fine, golden sand. The calm waters and tranquil setting make this beach the perfect spot to unwind, swim, or simply take in the natural beauty of your surroundings.

  4. A Haven for Birdwatchers
    Lobos Island is home to a variety of bird species, including the protected Cory’s shearwater. Birdwatchers will love spotting these birds along the island’s trails and coastline. The island’s status as a nature reserve ensures that wildlife thrives in its untouched environment.

  5. A Stress-Free Day Trip
    With our express transfers and ferry service, your journey to and from Lobos Island is hassle-free. The ferry departs regularly from Lanzarote and Fuerteventura, making it easy to plan your day trip around your schedule. Once you arrive, you’ll have several hours to explore the island at your leisure before returning in the comfort of our modern ferry.

Tips for Your Lobos Island Adventure

  • Bring plenty of water and snacks, as there are limited facilities on the island.
  • Wear comfortable shoes for hiking and exploring the island’s natural terrain.
  • Don’t forget sunscreen and a hat, as the island offers little shade.
  • Snorkeling gear can be rented if you don’t have your own, allowing you to fully enjoy the island’s underwater attractions.

Book Your Lobos Island Ferry Today!

Our Lobos Island Express Transfers + Ferry service offers you the perfect opportunity to explore this unspoiled gem of the Canary Islands. Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or a chance to immerse yourself in nature, Lobos Island has it all. Book your ferry tickets today and get ready to embark on an unforgettable island getaway.

overview.en:
La Graciosa Express Transfer + Ferry: A Journey to Paradise

Escape the hustle and bustle of Lanzarote and embark on a peaceful adventure to La Graciosa, a hidden gem in the Canary Islands. Known for its untouched landscapes and tranquil atmosphere, La Graciosa offers a unique experience just a short ferry ride away. With our La Graciosa Express Transfer + Ferry, you’ll enjoy a seamless and comfortable journey to this island paradise, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in its natural beauty.

Discover the Untouched Beauty of La Graciosa

La Graciosa is an island like no other. Part of the Chinijo Archipelago and protected as a natural reserve, it remains largely unspoiled, offering visitors a rare chance to explore pristine landscapes, free from the typical tourist crowds. The island is half-inhabited, with the small fishing village of Caleta de Sebo serving as its main settlement, while the rest is wild, raw nature waiting to be discovered.

Upon arrival, you’ll find that the island’s sandy streets, lack of paved roads, and relaxed pace of life make it the perfect getaway from the hustle of everyday life. Whether you're a nature lover, an adventurer, or simply seeking peace, La Graciosa offers something for everyone.

Stunning Beaches and Crystal-Clear Waters

One of La Graciosa’s greatest attractions is its breathtaking beaches. Picture yourself stepping onto soft golden sands and diving into crystal-clear waters—perfect for swimming, snorkeling, or simply lounging under the warm sun. Beaches like Playa de las Conchas and Playa Francesa offer serene environments, ideal for relaxation or exploration.

For the more adventurous, the island’s pristine coastline and hidden coves are great for kayaking or paddleboarding. Don’t miss the chance to explore underwater treasures by snorkeling, where you might encounter colorful marine life that thrives in these protected waters.

Hassle-Free Express Transfer + Ferry

Our La Graciosa Express Transfer + Ferry ensures you enjoy a stress-free experience from start to finish. We offer convenient pick-up services from your accommodation in Lanzarote, followed by a smooth ferry ride across the beautiful waters of the Atlantic to La Graciosa. The ferry ride itself is a scenic journey, offering stunning views of Lanzarote’s volcanic landscapes as you approach the island.

Once on La Graciosa, you’ll have plenty of time to explore the island at your own pace. Whether you choose to hike the rugged trails, visit the local markets, or simply relax on the beach, this transfer service makes your visit to La Graciosa easy and enjoyable.

Perfect for a Day Trip

With its laid-back charm and close proximity to Lanzarote, La Graciosa is the ideal destination for a day trip. Whether you're traveling solo, as a couple, or with family and friends, the island’s natural beauty will leave you mesmerized. You’ll return to Lanzarote refreshed and recharged, with unforgettable memories of your time in this island paradise.

Book Your La Graciosa Adventure Today

Don’t miss the opportunity to discover one of the last untouched islands in the Canary archipelago. Book your La Graciosa Express Transfer + Ferry today and prepare for a day filled with natural wonders, serene beaches, and unforgettable experiences. Let the adventure begin!

Fuerteventura Express Tour - Experience the Best of the Neighboring Island

Discover the natural beauty and charm of Fuerteventura on this exciting day trip, perfect for those looking to escape to a tranquil paradise just a short ferry ride away. Fuerteventura, renowned for its golden beaches, crystal-clear waters, and picturesque sand dunes, offers a perfect getaway from Lanzarote. Whether you're looking for relaxation or adventure, the Fuerteventura Express Tour is your gateway to a day of exploration and unforgettable memories.

Quick and Easy Access to Fuerteventura

Your journey begins with a convenient 30-minute ferry ride from Lanzarote to Corralejo, located on the northern tip of Fuerteventura. As you glide across the sparkling waters of the Atlantic, enjoy stunning views of the coastline and the vast ocean horizon. The ferry ride itself is a treat, offering the perfect opportunity to relax and soak in the surroundings before arriving at your destination.

Discover Corralejo – A Coastal Gem

Once you arrive in Corralejo, the island's northern tourist hub, you'll have plenty of time to explore this charming town. Corralejo is known for its laid-back vibe, bustling markets, and delightful restaurants. Wander through the picturesque streets, indulge in local shopping, and perhaps pick up a few souvenirs or handcrafted goods to take home.

Feeling hungry? Corralejo is a food lover's paradise, offering a variety of cafes, tapas bars, and seafood restaurants. Take a moment to savor the local cuisine, whether it's fresh seafood, traditional Canarian dishes, or a refreshing cocktail by the beach.

Unwind at the Famous Corralejo Sand Dunes

One of the highlights of your trip will be a visit to the breathtaking Corralejo Sand Dunes. These pristine dunes, part of the Corralejo Natural Park, stretch for miles along the coastline, offering a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy the island’s natural beauty. The soft white sand and turquoise waters provide a stunning contrast, making this a perfect place to swim, sunbathe, or simply relax.

For those seeking adventure, the dunes are also an ideal place to explore. Take a leisurely walk through the dunes, enjoy the scenic views, and feel the warm sand beneath your feet. Whether you're looking to swim in the crystal-clear waters or relax on the beach with a refreshing cocktail, the Corralejo Sand Dunes are a must-see destination on your tour.

Perfect for Families, Couples, and Solo Travelers

The Fuerteventura Express Tour is designed for everyone. Whether you're traveling with family, on a romantic getaway, or solo, this tour provides the perfect balance of relaxation, exploration, and fun. With flexible itineraries and plenty of free time to explore the island at your own pace, you'll have the freedom to tailor your experience to your personal preferences.

Why Choose the Fuerteventura Express Tour?

  • Hassle-Free Travel: Enjoy a quick 30-minute ferry ride to Fuerteventura with no stress or complications.
  • Flexible Itinerary: Spend your day exploring the town of Corralejo, relaxing on the beach, or discovering the famous dunes—your day is yours to enjoy.
  • Breathtaking Scenery: Fuerteventura is known for its stunning landscapes, from pristine beaches to rolling sand dunes, offering an experience like no other.
  • Cultural Experience: Get a taste of the island's local culture, from traditional cuisine to unique shopping opportunities.
  • Ideal for All Travelers: Whether you're seeking a relaxing beach day or an adventurous island escape, the Fuerteventura Express Tour is perfect for everyone.

Book Your Fuerteventura Express Tour Today!

Escape the ordinary and treat yourself to an unforgettable day trip to Fuerteventura. Whether you're soaking up the sun on the Corralejo beaches or exploring the charming town center, this tour offers a perfect balance of relaxation and adventure. Book your Fuerteventura Express Tour today and make memories that will last a lifetime!

overview.en:
Set sail on an unforgettable adventure with the Fuerteventura Express Transfer + Ferry tour, a perfect way to experience the untouched beauty of Lanzarote's neighboring island. Known for its idyllic landscapes, white sand dunes, and turquoise waters, Fuerteventura is a haven for travelers seeking a blend of tranquility and excitement.

Quick & Convenient Transfer

Your journey begins with a comfortable 30-minute ferry ride from Lanzarote’s port to the vibrant town of Corralejo, located on the northern tip of Fuerteventura. As the ferry glides over the Atlantic, you’ll be treated to breathtaking views of the surrounding islands, with crystal-clear waters stretching as far as the eye can see. The transfer is designed to be both swift and scenic, making it ideal for day-trippers looking to maximize their time exploring Fuerteventura.

Explore Corralejo – The Heart of Fuerteventura

Once you arrive in Corralejo, you’ll be greeted by the town’s relaxed yet lively atmosphere. Corralejo is a popular tourist destination known for its eclectic mix of shops, cafés, and restaurants, offering something for every type of traveler. Stroll through the charming streets lined with boutique stores and market stalls, perfect for picking up local crafts or souvenirs.

For food lovers, Corralejo's vibrant food scene is sure to delight, with numerous seaside restaurants offering fresh seafood and traditional Canary Island dishes. Don’t miss out on trying some papas arrugadas (Canarian wrinkled potatoes) and the famous local mojo sauce.

Discover the Natural Beauty of Corralejo Dunes

One of the highlights of this tour is the opportunity to visit the Corralejo Natural Park, home to the island’s most famous white sand dunes. This expansive area offers an otherworldly landscape of rolling sand hills set against the backdrop of the Atlantic Ocean. Whether you’re looking for a place to relax and soak up the sun, or an adventure-filled day of exploring, the dunes are the perfect destination.

Feel free to kick off your shoes and enjoy a leisurely walk on the soft sand, take a dip in the crystal-clear waters, or simply unwind and enjoy the views. For the more adventurous, the dunes are also a popular spot for sandboarding, offering thrilling descents down the gentle slopes.

Relax and Recharge

After a day of exploring, there’s nothing better than relaxing on the beach with a cocktail in hand. Corralejo’s beaches are known for their calm waters, making them perfect for swimming, sunbathing, or just lounging with a good book. With plenty of beachside bars and restaurants, you can sip on your favorite drink while soaking up the island’s laid-back vibes.

Why Choose Fuerteventura Express?

This tour is ideal for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of Lanzarote for a day and immerse themselves in the natural beauty and charm of Fuerteventura. The ferry service is quick, comfortable, and affordable, making it a hassle-free option for travelers of all ages. Whether you’re looking for a peaceful day of relaxation or an exciting adventure exploring the dunes, Fuerteventura Express Transfer + Ferry offers the perfect blend of both.

Book your spot today and get ready to discover the magic of Fuerteventura, one of the Canary Islands' most captivating gems.

es.title: Excursión a La Graciosa desde Lanzarote
es.description: Descubre Lanzarote y la isla de La Graciosa en una excursión inolvidable. Ferry, paisajes volcánicos y playas paradisíacas.

overview.en:
Embark on an unforgettable island-hopping adventure with our Discover Lanzarote & La Graciosa tour, a unique package that brings together the natural wonders of Lanzarote with the serene beauty of La Graciosa. Perfect for nature lovers and explorers, this tour combines the best of both islands, offering an extraordinary glimpse into Lanzarote’s volcanic landscapes and La Graciosa’s untouched beaches.

Start your journey with the Highlights Tour of Lanzarote, where you’ll uncover the island's most iconic landmarks. Explore the awe-inspiring Fire Mountains of Timanfaya National Park, where volcanic landscapes stretch for miles, offering a lunar-like experience. Witness live volcanic demonstrations that showcase the raw power beneath the surface.

Next, venture into the mysterious Green Cave, a labyrinth of lava tunnels formed by ancient volcanic eruptions. This unique geological formation is a must-see, showcasing nature’s creativity through its twisting passages. Continue your exploration at Jameos del Agua, an underground paradise created by famed artist César Manrique. Here, you’ll encounter the rare white crabs, which live in a serene underground lake, creating an otherworldly atmosphere. Complete your Lanzarote experience with breathtaking views from the Village HARIA, ftom where you can gaze over the Atlantic Ocean and spot the island of La Graciosa from above.

On a separate day, escape to the unspoiled shores of La Graciosa with our 4-hour Chillout Catamaran Cruise. This luxurious cruise sets sail from Orzola, navigating through pristine waters toward this hidden gem of the Canary Islands. Once you reach La Graciosa, you’ll have the chance to relax on its tranquil beaches, where crystal-clear waters invite you to snorkel and discover vibrant marine life. Feel the sea breeze, swim in the refreshing waters, or simply soak up the sun in a peaceful atmosphere far removed from the hustle and bustle of daily life.

As you sail along the coast of La Graciosa, enjoy a delicious onboard lunch prepared by the crew, paired with drinks to keep you refreshed. This catamaran cruise not only offers relaxation but also unforgettable views of the island's dramatic cliffs and volcanic formations. Whether you want to snorkel, swim, or just relax, this tour caters to every kind of traveler.

Book today and elevate your vacation with this exclusive package, combining Lanzarote’s natural wonders and La Graciosa’s serene landscapes. For a limited time, enjoy a special discount on this unbeatable experience.
overview.es: Viva la aventura definitiva en la isla con nuestro exclusivo paquete, que combina la excursión más vendida Highlights Tour y un cautivador crucero en catamarán Chillout de 4 horas a La Graciosa. Descubra las sobrecogedoras Montañas del Fuego de Timanfaya, explore los encantadores túneles de lava de la Cueva Verde, sea testigo de la hipnotizante belleza de los Jameos del Agua, con sus singulares cangrejos blancos, y contemple las vistas panorámicas desde el emblemático Mirador del Río. Otro día, zarpe hacia la isla virgen de La Graciosa a bordo de un lujoso catamarán. Sumérjase en aguas cristalinas, practique snorkel entre la vibrante vida marina y relájese en un entorno tranquilo. Eleve sus vacaciones con esta inmejorable combinación, que ahora se ofrece con un descuento exclusivo.

en.title: Lanzarote Highlights
en.text:
Pick-up: We will pick you up either from your accommodation or at the nearest designated pick-up point.
Cueva de los Verdes (Green caves):
Our first stop will be at the remarkable Cueva de los Verdes. This 6km long lava tunnel offers an unforgettable experience.
Although we can explore only 1km of the tunnel, you will still have the opportunity to connect with Mother Earth. As you venture through the tunnel, you'll be treated to a captivating light and sound show that showcases the history and secrets of Lanzarote. Learn about the origins of the cave's name and discover the hidden wonders within.
Jameos del Agua cave:
Next, we will visit the enchanting Jameos del Agua cave. Here, you will witness an underground salt lake, which serves as the habitat for unique and fascinating subterranean white crabs. Created by the renowned artist Cesar Manrique, Jameos del Agua combines art and nature seamlessly. Explore the underground Concert Hall and take in the breathtaking sights of the restaurant surrounded by a beautiful garden and a stunning blue lagoon.
Lunch stop at a Local tapas restaurant: We will make a stop at a delightful local tapas restaurant, where you can enjoy a delicious lunch. For an additional fee of 10 € for adults and 5 € for children, indulge in a variety of delectable tapas dishes that showcase the flavours of the region.
Timanfaya National Park: Our next destination is the awe-inspiring Timanfaya National Park. Prepare to witness the power of nature as we explore the captivating Fire Mountains. Observe geothermal experiments that demonstrate the volcanic activity beneath the surface. You'll also have the opportunity to witness a geyser in action and catch a glimpse of the heart of an active volcano. Conclude your visit with a breathtaking Lunar Crater tour, immersing yourself in the unique and dramatic landscapes shaped by volcanic activity.
Drop-off: Finally, we will drop you off at the designated pick-up point, where you can reflect on the incredible experiences and natural wonders you encountered throughout the day.

en.title: La Graciosa Catamaran Cruise
en.text:
Get picked up on our comfortable air-conditioned coach at your accommodation or the nearest pick-up point to head to the north port (40 mins)
35 minutes ferry to La Graciosa Island & leisure time at village:
40 minutes of leisure time to explore Caleta del Sebo village, visit the old church and immerse yourself in the island's serene atmosphere.
Sail to the Playa Frances beach
Sit back, relax, and savour a refreshing Mojito complemented with a tortilla as you take in the breathtaking coast of La Graciosa on our sailing journey to Playa del Francés.
Time to unwind on the beach, relax on  board or join our Water Activities:
On arrival, you can choose to relax on the golden sand beach or board indulging in our all-inclusive bar. Alternatively, dive into thrilling kayaking tours and snorkel activities to explore the marine life on the crystal-clear water.
Lunch Break:
Indulge in a delicious lunch featuring freshly served paella or pasta with tomato sauce complemented by refreshing sangria, beer, or non-alcoholic beverages.
Sail back to the village and hop on the return Ferry to Lanzarote:
Enjoy our all-inclusive bar as we sail back to Caleta del Sebo village. Then, hop on  the return Ferry to Lanzarote.
Conclude the journey with a drop-off at your chosen collection point

es.title: Lo más destacado de Lanzarote
es.text:
Recogida: Le recogeremos en su alojamiento o en el punto de recogida designado más cercano.
Cueva de los Verdes:
Nuestra primera parada será en la extraordinaria Cueva de los Verdes. Este túnel de lava de 6 km de longitud ofrece una experiencia inolvidable.
Aunque sólo podamos explorar 1 km del túnel, tendrá la oportunidad de conectar con la Madre Tierra. Mientras se adentra en el túnel, asistirá a un cautivador espectáculo de luz y sonido que le mostrará la historia y los secretos de Lanzarote. Conozca el origen del nombre de la cueva y descubra las maravillas que esconde.
Cueva de los Jameos del Agua:
A continuación, visitaremos la encantadora cueva de los Jameos del Agua. Aquí será testigo de un lago salado subterráneo, que sirve de hábitat a singulares y fascinantes cangrejos blancos subterráneos. Creado por el renombrado artista César Manrique, Jameos del Agua combina a la perfección arte y naturaleza. Explore la Sala de Conciertos subterránea y disfrute de las impresionantes vistas del restaurante rodeado de un hermoso jardín y una impresionante laguna azul.
Parada para almorzar en un restaurante local de tapas: Haremos una parada en un encantador restaurante local de tapas, donde podrá disfrutar de un delicioso almuerzo. Por un suplemento de 10 € para los adultos y 5 € para los niños, deléitese con una variedad de deliciosos platos de tapas que muestran los sabores de la región.
Parque Nacional de Timanfaya: Nuestro próximo destino es el impresionante Parque Nacional de Timanfaya. Prepárese para ser testigo del poder de la naturaleza mientras exploramos las cautivadoras Montañas del Fuego. Observe experimentos geotérmicos que demuestran la actividad volcánica bajo la superficie. También tendrá la oportunidad de presenciar un géiser en acción y vislumbrar el corazón de un volcán activo. Concluya su visita con un impresionante recorrido por el cráter Lunar, sumergiéndose en los singulares y dramáticos paisajes modelados por la actividad volcánica.
Regreso: Por último, le dejaremos en el punto de recogida designado, donde podrá reflexionar sobre las increíbles experiencias y maravillas naturales que ha vivido a lo largo del día.

es.title: Crucero en catamarán por La Graciosa
es.text:
Recogida en nuestro cómodo autocar con aire acondicionado en su alojamiento o en el punto de recogida más cercano para dirigirse al puerto norte (40 min.)
35 minutos en ferry a la isla de La Graciosa y tiempo libre en el pueblo:
40 minutos de tiempo libre para explorar el pueblo de Caleta del Sebo, visitar la antigua iglesia y sumergirse en la serena atmósfera de la isla.
Navegue hasta la Playa Frances
Siéntese, relájese y saboree un refrescante mojito acompañado de una tortilla mientras disfruta de la impresionante costa de La Graciosa en nuestro viaje en velero a Playa del Francés.
Tiempo para desconectar en la playa, relajarse a a bordo o unirse a nuestras actividades acuáticas:
A su llegada, puede optar por relajarse en la playa de arena dorada o embarcarse para darse un capricho en nuestro bar con todo incluido. Otra opción es sumergirse en emocionantes excursiones en kayak y actividades de snorkel para explorar la vida marina en las aguas cristalinas.
Pausa para comer:
Disfrute de un delicioso almuerzo con paella recién servida o pasta con salsa de tomate, acompañado de una refrescante sangría, cerveza o bebidas sin alcohol.
Navegue de vuelta al pueblo y súbase al ferry de regreso a Lanzarote:
Disfrute de nuestro bar con todo incluido mientras navegamos de vuelta al pueblo de Caleta del Sebo. Después, súbete a el Ferry de vuelta a Lanzarote.
Concluya el viaje dejándole en el punto de recogida que elija

en: General FAQs

Where and what time will I get picked up?
We have Tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen and Costa Teguise, we can also pick up in Arrecife,  Playa Honda and Yaiza.
Pick-up points are in hotels or the next-door resort.
Pick-up starts at 08:30 in every resort, tell us where you're staying and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn't have pick-up.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we do pick at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English,  Spanish, German and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where / when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay the balance at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using a credit card or cash.
FAQ For Day 1: Lanzarote's Highlights Tour

How long is the Excursion?
The tour lasts around 8 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off, bringing you back around 18:00.
How long will I be on the bus?
Lanzarote is a tiny island the time you will be on the bus is only when going from North to the south which takes approximately 50 minutes.
Do I have free time?
Yes, at every stop we give you at least 15 minutes to enjoy and explore the attractions without any rush.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can go as you please, comfortable clothing and trainers are what we recommend. Hats and Sunglasses for the Summer season and a jumper for Wintertime as it can be windy in the morning.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
No, there's a 40-minute walk on this trip and stairs at the Mirador del Rio viewpoint, head over to our Grand Tour for this option.
Do we stop for food and is it included in the price?
Yes, we stop at a restaurant where you can enjoy a local tapas buffet with drinks, for an additional 13 € per adult and 7 € for children.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course, take some snacks and drinks especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How big and long are the caves?
Cueva de los Verdes are a wide connection of Lava Tunnels, it takes a 40-minute hike to complete and it's not claustrophobic,  head over to the photos section to get a better idea.
Can I swim at the lagoon in Jameos del Agua?
No, this is strictly forbidden,  the natural lake is home to rare albino crabs and the blue lagoon at the King's Garden is there for an artistic purpose and display.
Are the Volcanoes active and dangerous?
Yes, Timanfaya is an active volcano that has already erupted 200 to 300 years ago and now the insides are filled with potable water making it impossible to erupt again for the foreseeable future.
Are there too many steps to go up to the viewpoint?
No, no more than 10 steps to go up, our drivers drop off at the most approximate parking which is 2 minutes away.
FAQ For Day 2: La Graciosa Catamaran Cruise

How long are we on the coach?
The ride to the north is approximately 45 minutes but it goes very quickly as you enjoy Lanzarote's picturesque volcanic landscape.
How long is the ferry to La Graciosa?
The ferry to La Graciosa takes around 35 - 40 minutes to reach as we slow down to let you enjoy the views of the North side of Lanzarote.
Is the ferry Lanzarote to La Graciosa included?
Yes, return Ferry Tickets to Ña Graciosa are included in the price.
Are Water Activities included?
Yes, Water Activities are included in the price.
What Water Activities are offered?
There are slides on the catamaran, matts and inflatables on sea and Kayaking.
Bring your snorkels as we aren't allowed to offer you any due to COVID-19 restrictions.
How long are you on the boat?
We are in total 4 hours on board from start to finish.
Are there any shades on the boat?
This is a special Catamaran with an inside bar and Chillout area with comfortable seats.
Are there any toilets on board?
Yes, this Catamaran has two separate toilets.
Is there any music on board?
Yes, we have Chilout music on board, sometimes we even get people up dancing.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
Yes, when the boat has docked and water activities are activated, the slides will be opened and you may also jump into the sea, alternatively, there's a ramp from where you can walk into the sea.
What sort of clothes do I need?
We recommend comfortable clothing, hats, sunglasses,  beach towels, swimming costumes if you desire to swim and a change of clothes.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes as long as the person can go up and down the coach and has an assistant they can join us.
What food is included?
We serve a local traditional Paella made with rice and vegetables, and seafood and meat are cooked separately and added on top if customers desire, we also give the option of a simple pasta with tomato sauce.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment on notes at the time of booking.
Are drinks included?
Yes, drinks are included for all you can drink and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer and non-alcoholic beverages, there's also a welcome Mojito served after you board the boat.
How much free time do I have at La Graciosa?
We give you approximately 40 minutes of leisure in La Graciosa, this is enough time to explore the village Caleta del Sebo and even visit its old church.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring food but you also have snacks and fresh cooked lunch served on board.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How long is the Excursion?
The tour lasts around 7 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off, bringing you back around 16:00.
How long are you on the bus?
The Excursion is on and off the bus the most time spent on the bus is 40 minutes.
Is swimming allowed?
Yes, you have plenty of time to go to the beach and dive in and relax by the golden sand and catch a bit of sun.
How long is the ferry to La Graciosa?
The ferry takes around 30-35 minutes to and back from La Graciosa.
Are there any restaurants and bars at La Graciosa?
Yes, there's a few beach bars and restaurants.

¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 8 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 18:00.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaré en el autobús?
Lanzarote es una isla pequeña, el tiempo que pasará en el autobús es sólo cuando vaya del norte al sur, lo que tarda aproximadamente 50 minutos.
¿Tengo tiempo libre?
Sí, en cada parada le damos al menos 15 minutos para disfrutar y explorar las atracciones sin prisas.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, lo que te recomendamos es ropa cómoda y zapatillas deportivas. Sombreros y gafas de sol para el verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
No, hay una caminata de 40 minutos en este viaje y escaleras en el Mirador del Río, diríjase a nuestro Gran Tour para esta opción.

Sí, por supuesto, llévate algo para picar y bebidas, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en todas las paradas que hacemos.
¿Qué tamaño y longitud tienen las cuevas?
Cueva de los Verdes son una amplia conexión de Túneles de Lava, se tarda 40 minutos de caminata para completar y no es claustrofóbico, diríjase a la sección de fotos para tener una mejor idea.
¿Puedo bañarme en la laguna de Jameos del Agua?
No, esto está estrictamente prohibido, el lago natural alberga raros cangrejos albinos y la laguna azul del Jardín del Rey está ahí con fines artísticos y de exhibición.
¿Los volcanes están activos y son peligrosos?
Sí, Timanfaya es un volcán activo que ya entró en erupción hace 200 o 300 años y ahora sus entrañas están llenas de agua potable, lo que hace imposible que vuelva a entrar en erupción en un futuro previsible.
¿Hay demasiados escalones para subir al mirador?
No, no hay que subir más de 10 escalones, nuestros conductores le dejan en el aparcamiento más aproximado que está a 2 minutos.
Preguntas frecuentes para el día 2: Crucero en catamarán por La Graciosa

¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar?
El trayecto hacia el norte dura aproximadamente 45 minutos, pero se pasa muy rápido mientras se disfruta del pintoresco paisaje volcánico de Lanzarote.
¿Cuánto dura el trayecto en ferry hasta La Graciosa?
El ferry a La Graciosa tarda unos 35 - 40 minutos en llegar, ya que reducimos la velocidad para que pueda disfrutar de las vistas de la cara norte de Lanzarote.
¿Está incluido el ferry de Lanzarote a La Graciosa?
Sí, los billetes de ferry de ida y vuelta a Ña Graciosa están incluidos en el precio.
¿Están incluidas las actividades acuáticas?
Sí, las actividades acuáticas están incluidas en el precio.
¿Qué actividades acuáticas se ofrecen?
Hay toboganes en el catamarán, colchonetas e hinchables en el mar y kayak.
Traiga sus tubos de buceo, ya que no se nos permite ofrecerle ninguno debido a las restricciones de COVID-19.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estamos en total 4 horas a bordo de principio a fin.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Se trata de un catamarán especial con bar interior y zona Chillout con cómodos asientos.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
Sí, este catamarán tiene dos aseos separados.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música Chilout a bordo, a veces incluso ponemos a la gente a bailar.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?
Sí, cuando el barco haya atracado y se activen las actividades acuáticas, se abrirán los toboganes y también podrás tirarte al mar; alternativamente, hay una rampa desde la que podrás caminar hasta el mar.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Recomendamos ropa cómoda, sombreros, gafas de sol, toallas de playa, bañador si desea nadar y una muda.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
Sí, siempre que la persona pueda subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?
Servimos una paella tradicional local hecha con arroz y verduras, y el marisco y la carne se cocinan por separado y se añaden por encima si los clientes lo desean, también damos la opción de una simple pasta con salsa de tomate.
¿Necesita algún régimen alimenticio?
Póngase en contacto con nuestro servicio de atención al cliente o deje un comentario en notas en el momento de hacer la reserva.
¿Están incluidas las bebidas?
Sí, las bebidas están incluidas para todo lo que pueda beber y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas sin alcohol, también hay un mojito de bienvenida servido después de subir al barco.
¿Cuánto tiempo libre tengo en La Graciosa?
Le damos aproximadamente 40 minutos de ocio en La Graciosa, este tiempo es suficiente para explorar el pueblo Caleta del Sebo e incluso visitar su antigua iglesia.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puedes llevar comida, pero también tienes aperitivos y comida recién cocinada servida a bordo.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay aseos en todas las paradas que hacemos.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
La excursión dura unas 7 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevará de vuelta sobre las 16:00.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el autobús?
La excursión se realiza subiendo y bajando del autobús. El tiempo máximo de permanencia en el autobús es de 40 minutos.
¿Está permitido nadar?
Sí, tienes tiempo de sobra para ir a la playa, zambullirte y relajarte junto a la arena dorada y tomar un poco el sol.
¿Cuánto dura el trayecto en ferry hasta La Graciosa?
El ferry tarda unos 30-35 minutos de ida y vuelta desde La Graciosa.
¿Hay restaurantes y bares en La Graciosa?
Sí, hay algunos chiringuitos y restaurantes.

en.description: Explore Timanfaya’s volcanoes and Jameos del Agua’s caves in a half-day adventure perfect for families in Lanzarote.

es.title: Excursión Volcanes + Cuevas - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Discover the captivating landscapes of Lanzarote on a unique, family-friendly adventure with our Short Volcanoes + Short Caves Tour. This unforgettable excursion takes you on a half-day journey through both the volcanic wonders and the fascinating underground cave systems of this extraordinary island. Perfect for families and nature lovers alike, the tour offers an in-depth look at Lanzarote's most iconic natural attractions while immersing you in the island's rich geological and cultural history.

Timanfaya National Park – Fire Mountains Experience

The adventure begins in the heart of the southern region of Lanzarote with a visit to the legendary Timanfaya National Park, home to the awe-inspiring Fire Mountains. These volcanic peaks were formed during the dramatic eruptions of the 18th century, leaving behind a breathtaking lunar-like landscape. Marvel at the powerful geothermal forces still active beneath the surface as your guide demonstrates incredible volcanic experiments. Witness steam shooting from geysers and feel the intense heat emanating from the earth’s crust as you explore this otherworldly terrain.

The tour includes a scenic drive through the Route of the Volcanoes, where you’ll have a front-row seat to the island's most striking geological formations. As you pass by the lava fields, you'll feel as though you’ve been transported to another planet, surrounded by black, red, and golden hues that tell the story of Lanzarote’s fiery past.

Crater Tour – Walk on a Volcano

Continue your journey with a short trek on one of the dormant craters in the Timanfaya region. The Crater Tour allows you to experience the sensation of walking on an actual volcano, surrounded by incredible panoramic views of the island’s dramatic landscape. Your expert guide will share fascinating insights into the region’s volcanic history, the unique flora and fauna that thrive in this harsh environment, and the island’s ongoing conservation efforts to preserve this natural wonder.

Jameos del Agua – A Fusion of Art and Nature

On another day, the adventure shifts to the northern part of Lanzarote, where you will visit Jameos del Agua, one of César Manrique’s most iconic creations. This stunning cave, formed by ancient lava flows, has been transformed into a unique blend of art, architecture, and nature. Inside the cave, you’ll find an underground lagoon, home to the rare and delicate albino crabs, as well as beautifully designed spaces that blend seamlessly with the natural rock formations. Manrique’s vision of harmony between man and nature is on full display here, making Jameos del Agua a must-see for any visitor to Lanzarote.

Cueva de los Verdes – Explore the Green Cave

Finally, your tour continues with a visit to the Cueva de los Verdes, a mesmerizing underground cave system that was also formed by volcanic activity. This cave, which stretches for over 6 kilometers, offers a fascinating look at the power of nature and the hidden secrets beneath the island’s surface. As you explore the winding tunnels and caverns, your guide will reveal the stories and legends of the cave, including its historical use as a refuge for locals during pirate raids.

The highlight of the Cueva de los Verdes is undoubtedly the “secret of the cave,” a mind-blowing optical illusion that will leave you in awe. This geological wonder is a testament to the island's unique natural heritage and a fitting end to your Lanzarote adventure.

Why Choose This Tour?

The Short Volcanoes + Short Caves Tour is the perfect way to experience the best of Lanzarote in just a few hours. With expert guides, breathtaking landscapes, and a deep dive into the island’s volcanic and cultural history, this tour offers something for everyone. Whether you're traveling with family or exploring on your own, this tour guarantees unforgettable memories of Lanzarote’s most remarkable treasures.
overview.es: Embárquese en dos cautivadoras excursiones de medio día para explorar los encantadores tesoros de las maravillas del sur y del norte de Lanzarote con nuestro exclusivo paquete familiar. Deléitese con las sobrecogedoras Montañas del Fuego del Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, donde los experimentos geotérmicos cobran vida, y experimente el paisaje lunar en la Excursión al Cráter. En una jornada aparte, aventúrese hacia el norte y sumérjase en la cueva de los Jameos del Agua, hogar de delicados cangrejos blancos, donde arte y naturaleza se funden a la perfección. Sumérjase en los misterios de Lanzarote adentrándose en los túneles de lava de la Cueva Verde, desvelando los secretos bien guardados de la isla. Acompáñenos en una inolvidable exploración de la rica belleza e intriga de la isla.

en.title: Short Volcanoes Tour
en.text:
Pick-up from hotel or nearest pick-up point:
We will pick you up from your hotel or a nearby pick-up point to start the excursion.
Timanfaya National Park (Lunar Crater Tour & Experiments):
Timanfaya Park is home to the fire mountains and is located in the southern part of Lanzarote. Experience geothermal experiments and visit Restaurant El Diablo, where food is grilled using the heat of the volcano. Get a glimpse into the heart of the volcano and feel the strength of Mother Nature. Enjoy the breathtaking lunar crater tour as our drivers take you through the rugged landscape where lava used to flow.
Lava Field / Camel Park:
Make a stop at the Camel Park where you can enjoy a camel ride and take photos in the old lava fields for an additional €12. It's a truly unforgettable experience. If you don't want a camel ride, you can visit a local museum that explains the history of the park.
La Geria vineyards:
Located in the central part of Lanzarote, La Geria is known for its distinctive landscape where vineyards are cultivated using a unique method on the volcanic terrain. Take a 15-minute stop for wine tasting and enjoy the flavors of Lanzarote wines.
Drop-off at hotel or meeting point:
After the tour, we will drop you off at your hotel or the designated meeting point.

en.title: Short North Tour
en.text:
Pick-up at accommodation or approximate pick-up point:
We’ll pick you up from your accommodation or a convenient location to start the day’s adventure.
Visit Jameos del Agua cave:
Jameos del Agua is a cave that is part of a lava tunnel. It is home to a salt lake that holds rare species of Albino Crabs and an underground Concert Hall transformed by César Manrique. It also features a restaurant with a breathtaking garden and a blue lagoon.
Next visit is Cueva de los Verdes (Green Caves):
Cueva de los Verdes is a lava tube formation caused by an eruption of a volcano. It stretches for over 6 km, but only 1 km is open to the public. Here, you can discover the history behind this cave and experience a mind-blowing light and sound show. An unforgettable experience to uncover the secrets of Lanzarote.
Mirador la Ermita de las Nieves viewpoint and pass by the Valley of 1000 Palm Trees:
Mirador la Ermita de las Nieves is a breathtaking viewpoint strategically positioned at a hilltop in Haria. It offers panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and a peaceful, tranquil atmosphere. Visitors can take a moment to relax, enjoy the serenity of the surroundings, and soak in the unique energy of Lanzarote before we take you down through the famous Valley of Thousand Palms Trees.
Drop-off at accommodation or pick-up point:
After an exciting exploration of the caves and scenic spots, we’ll drop you off at your accommodation or the designated pick-up point.

es.title: Excursión corta a los volcanes
es.text:
Recogida en el hotel o en el punto de recogida más cercano:
Le recogeremos en su hotel o en un punto de recogida cercano para iniciar la excursión.
Parque Nacional de Timanfaya (Excursión y experimentos en el cráter lunar):
El Parque de Timanfaya alberga las montañas de fuego y está situado en el sur de Lanzarote. Experimente la geotermia y visite el Restaurante El Diablo, donde la comida se asa utilizando el calor del volcán. Adéntrese en el corazón del volcán y sienta la fuerza de la Madre Naturaleza. Disfrute de la impresionante excursión por el cráter lunar mientras nuestros conductores le llevan por el escarpado paisaje por el que antes fluía la lava.
Campo de lava / Parque del Camello:
Haga una parada en el Camel Park, donde podrá disfrutar de un paseo en camello y tomar fotos en los antiguos campos de lava por un suplemento de 12 euros. Es una experiencia realmente inolvidable. Si no quiere dar un paseo en camello, puede visitar un museo local que explica la historia del parque.
Viñedos de La Geria:
Situada en la parte central de Lanzarote, La Geria es conocida por su peculiar paisaje, donde los viñedos se cultivan siguiendo un método único en el terreno volcánico. Haga una parada de 15 minutos para catar vinos y disfrute de los sabores de los vinos de Lanzarote.
Entrega en el hotel o punto de encuentro:
Tras la excursión, le dejaremos en su hotel o en el punto de encuentro designado.

es.title: Gira Short North
es.text:
Recogida en el alojamiento o punto de recogida aproximado:
Le recogeremos en su alojamiento o en un lugar conveniente para comenzar la aventura del día.
Visita a la cueva de Jameos del Agua:
Jameos del Agua es una cueva que forma parte de un túnel de lava. Alberga un lago salado que alberga raras especies de cangrejos albinos y una Sala de Conciertos subterránea transformada por César Manrique. También cuenta con un restaurante con un impresionante jardín y una laguna azul.
La siguiente visita es la Cueva de los Verdes:
La Cueva de los Verdes es una formación de tubos de lava provocada por la erupción de un volcán. Se extiende a lo largo de más de 6 km, pero sólo 1 km está abierto al público. Aquí podrá descubrir la historia de esta cueva y disfrutar de un alucinante espectáculo de luz y sonido. Una experiencia inolvidable para descubrir los secretos de Lanzarote.
Mirador la Ermita de las Nieves y pasar por el Valle de las 1000 Palmeras:
El Mirador la Ermita de las Nieves es un impresionante mirador estratégicamente situado en lo alto de una colina de Haría. Ofrece vistas panorámicas del paisaje circundante y un ambiente tranquilo y apacible. Los visitantes pueden tomarse un momento para relajarse, disfrutar de la serenidad del entorno y empaparse de la energía única de Lanzarote antes de que les llevemos a través del famoso Valle de las Mil Palmeras.
Entrega en el alojamiento o punto de recogida:
Tras una emocionante exploración de las cuevas y lugares pintorescos, le dejaremos en su alojamiento o en el punto de recogida designado.

en: General FAQs

Where and what time will I get picked up?
We have tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, and Costa Teguise. We can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda, and Yaiza. Pick-up points are in hotels or the next-door resort.
Pick-up starts at 16:30 in every resort. Tell us where you’re staying, and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick-up.
How far are the pick-up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel. Send us your exact location, and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German, and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where/when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay the balance on the day after collection. We accept credit card and cash payments.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
No, this package is not suitable for anyone with walking difficulties as we take a 40 minutes hike on the Green Cave Lava Tunnels.
How long are the excursion?
The tours lasts around 5 hours, from the time of pick-up to the time of drop-off, bringing you back around 14:00.
Do I have free time?
Yes, at every stop, we provide at least 15 minutes of free time for you to enjoy and explore the attractions without feeling rushed.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can wear comfortable clothing and trainers. In the summer season, we recommend hats and sunglasses, and in the winter, it's advisable to bring a jumper as it can be windy in the morning.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
No, this tour goes to the Green cave of Cueva de los Verdes, which involves a 40-minute walk inside the lava tube. You can consider our Grand Tour or our César Manrique Tour for options suitable for reduced mobility.
Day 1: Short Volcanoes Tour FAQ

Is the camel ride included?
No, the camel rides are an additional €10 per person, which is paid in cash to the organizers of the rides.
Is there a stop for food?
No, on this short trip, we only stop for a 10-minute coffee break if there is extra time (not guaranteed). If you want a meal, consider the South Tour option, where you can enjoy a buffet of local tapas for as little as €13 with drinks included.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, you can bring snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Are the volcanoes active and dangerous?
Timanfaya is an active volcano, but it last erupted 200 to 300 years ago. The insides are now filled with potable water, making it unlikely to erupt again for the foreseeable future.
Day 2: Short Caves Tour

Do we stop for food, and is it included in the price?
No, this is a half-day tour, and we don’t have time to stop for food. You can consider our Lanzarote Highlights Tour for an option that includes food.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course! You can bring some snacks and drinks, especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How big and long are the caves?
Cueva de los Verdes is a wide connection of lava tunnels. It takes a 40-minute hike to complete, and it’s not claustrophobic. The ceiling is 10 meters wide. You can check the photos section to get a better idea.
Can I swim at the lagoon in Jameos del Agua?
No, swimming is strictly forbidden. The natural lake is home to rare albino crabs, and the blue lagoon at the King’s Garden is there for artistic purposes and display.
Does this tour go to the volcanoes?
No, this tour concentrates on the northern side of Lanzarote, and the fire mountains of Timanfaya National Park are located on the southern coast. You can consider our Grand Tour or the Lanzarote Highlights for an experience that includes the volcanoes.
Are there too many steps to go up to the viewpoint?
No, there are no more than 10 steps to go up. Our drivers drop off at the most approximate parking, which is 2 minutes away.
es: Preguntas más frecuentes

¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?
Tenemos excursiones que salen desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise. También podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza. Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 16:30 en todos los complejos. Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?
No exactamente, sin embargo, le recogemos en la parada de autobús o el hotel más cercanos. Envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta la parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma se realiza la excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde, cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden pagar el saldo al día siguiente de la recogida. Aceptamos pagos con tarjeta de crédito y en efectivo.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
No, este paquete no es apto para personas con dificultades para caminar, ya que realizaremos una caminata de 40 minutos por los túneles de lava de la Cueva Verde.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
Las excursiones duran unas 5 horas, desde la hora de recogida hasta la hora de regreso, y le llevarán de vuelta sobre las 14:00.
¿Tengo tiempo libre?
Sí, en cada parada le ofrecemos al menos 15 minutos de tiempo libre para que disfrute y explore las atracciones sin prisas.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes llevar ropa cómoda y zapatillas de deporte. En verano, recomendamos sombreros y gafas de sol, y en invierno, es aconsejable llevar un jersey, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana.
¿Puede hacer este recorrido una persona con movilidad reducida?
No, esta excursión va a la Cueva de los Verdes, que implica un paseo de 40 minutos por el interior del tubo de lava. Puede considerar nuestro Grand Tour o nuestro Tour César Manrique para opciones adecuadas para movilidad reducida.
Día 1: Excursión corta a los volcanes FAQ

¿Está incluido el paseo en camello?
No, los paseos en camello cuestan 10 euros más por persona, que se pagan en efectivo a los organizadores de los paseos.
¿Hay alguna parada para comer?
No, en este corto viaje, sólo paramos para tomar un café de 10 minutos si hay tiempo extra (no garantizado). Si le apetece comer, considere la opción Tour Sur, donde podrá disfrutar de un bufé de tapas locales por tan sólo 13 euros con bebidas incluidas.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, puedes llevar aperitivos y bebidas, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Están los volcanes activos y son peligrosos?
Timanfaya es un volcán activo, pero entró en erupción por última vez hace entre 200 y 300 años. Las entrañas están ahora llenas de agua potable, por lo que es improbable que vuelva a entrar en erupción en un futuro próximo.
Día 2: Excursión a las cuevas

¿Paramos para comer y está incluido en el precio?
No, es una excursión de medio día y no tenemos tiempo para parar a comer. Puede considerar nuestro Lanzarote Highlights Tour para una opción que incluye comida.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto. Puedes llevar algo de picar y beber, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en todas las paradas que hacemos.
¿Qué tamaño y longitud tienen las cuevas?
La Cueva de los Verdes es una amplia conexión de túneles de lava. La caminata dura 40 minutos y no es claustrofóbica. El techo mide 10 metros de ancho. Puede consultar la sección de fotos para hacerse una mejor idea.
¿Puedo bañarme en la laguna de Jameos del Agua?
No, está terminantemente prohibido nadar. El lago natural alberga raros cangrejos albinos, y la laguna azul del Jardín del Rey tiene fines artísticos y expositivos.
¿Este tour va a los volcanes?
No, esta excursión se concentra en la zona norte de Lanzarote, y las montañas de fuego del Parque Nacional de Timanfaya se encuentran en la costa sur. Puede considerar nuestro Gran Recorrido o los Destacados de Lanzarote para una experiencia que incluya los volcanes.
¿Hay demasiados escalones para subir al mirador?
No, no hay más de 10 escalones para subir. Nuestros conductores le dejan en el aparcamiento más aproximado, que está a 2 minutos.

es.title: Watersports Fun Pack Jetski, Banana & Donut for 2 - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Looking for an adrenaline-pumping adventure on the waters of Lanzarote? Our exclusive Watersports Fun Pack for 2 promises an action-packed day of excitement and thrill. This ultimate package offers three exhilarating water activities that will leave you buzzing with joy. Whether you’re an adventure junkie or looking to add some fun to your beach holiday, this tour is designed for everyone who loves the sea.

1. 25-Minute Jet Ski Ride
Start your adventure with a thrilling 25-minute ride on a high-speed jet ski. Feel the rush of wind and sea spray as you race across the crystal-clear waters of Lanzarote. This activity is perfect for those who crave excitement and enjoy exploring the coastline from a different perspective. Whether you’re a first-timer or an experienced rider, our professional guides will ensure you have the best experience, with safety always a top priority.

2. Banana Boat Ride
After your jet ski adventure, hop on the fun-filled banana boat ride! Hold tight as the inflatable banana twists and turns through the waves, creating a thrilling experience for you and your companion. The banana boat is not just about speed; it’s a perfect mix of laughter and fun as you bounce along the waves. Suitable for all ages, this is a great way to enjoy the water with friends or family.

3. Crazy Donut Ride
Finish off your watersports adventure with a wild ride on the crazy donut! This thrilling inflatable ride will spin and glide across the water, giving you an adrenaline rush like no other. Hold on tight as you navigate the waves at high speed, enjoying the twists and turns that make this ride one of the most exciting watersports experiences in Lanzarote.

Our Watersports Fun Pack is perfect for couples, friends, or family members looking to experience Lanzarote in a new and exciting way. The tour is designed to cater to all levels of experience, from beginners to seasoned water sports enthusiasts. Our professional team will guide you through each activity, ensuring your safety and enjoyment.

Located in one of the most stunning coastal areas of Lanzarote, this adventure is set against the backdrop of beautiful beaches, clear blue waters, and breathtaking landscapes. Don’t miss the chance to add some thrill to your vacation with our watersports package, designed to create unforgettable memories.

Why Choose Us?

  • All-Inclusive Package: One price covers all three exciting water sports.
  • For Everyone: Perfect for both beginners and experienced adventurers.
  • Professional Team: Our expert instructors ensure safety and fun.
  • Spectacular Setting: Enjoy the stunning coastal views of Lanzarote.

Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or just want to add some fun to your holiday, the Watersports Fun Pack is the perfect way to experience Lanzarote’s stunning waters. Book now and get ready for an adventure of a lifetime!

overview.en:
Discover the Ultimate Lanzarote Adventure with Excursions Tickets Direct

Looking for the most immersive way to explore Lanzarote's breathtaking landscapes and rich cultural heritage? The Full Lanzarote Experience is your gateway to uncovering the best of this magical island in just two unforgettable days. At Excursions Tickets Direct, we pride ourselves on curating exceptional, one-of-a-kind experiences that cater to every adventurer’s heart. This tour is no exception—combining natural wonders, volcanic marvels, and artistic brilliance, it’s a must for those who want to truly experience everything Lanzarote has to offer.

Day 1: The Natural Wonders of Lanzarote

Your first day takes you on a journey through the island’s volcanic heart. Begin with a visit to the world-famous Timanfaya National Park, where you’ll witness the otherworldly volcanic landscapes that define Lanzarote’s unique beauty. Marvel at the Fire Mountains and observe geothermal demonstrations showcasing the power lying beneath the surface.

Next, take in the stunning contrasts of the Emerald Lagoon (El Golfo), a vibrant green volcanic crater lake surrounded by black sand beaches—a sight that will leave you in awe. Continue your journey with a visit to the island’s winemaking tradition at La Geria, a unique vineyard region set within black volcanic soils. Sample some of the local wines while learning about how the island’s harsh conditions create these exceptional vintages.

End your first day by exploring the subterranean world at Jameos del Agua, a lava tunnel-turned-arts-and-culture center, created by Lanzarote’s famed artist César Manrique. As you wander through this breathtaking cave system, keep an eye out for the tiny, blind albino crabs that inhabit the underground lagoon—one of the island’s rarest creatures.

Day 2: César Manrique’s Artistic Legacy

On your second day, delve deeper into the vision of César Manrique, the artist who shaped Lanzarote’s harmonious blend of art and nature. Begin at the Green Caves (Cueva de los Verdes), where Manrique's touch transforms these volcanic formations into a magical underground journey. Here, you’ll learn about the island’s geological history and enjoy the acoustics and lighting that highlight the cave's unique structure.

Next, head to the Cactus Garden (Jardín de Cactus), another of Manrique’s masterpieces. This botanical paradise is home to over 1,000 species of cactus from around the world, beautifully arranged against a backdrop of volcanic ash and wind-sculpted stones. It’s the perfect spot for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts alike.

The day concludes with a visit to the island’s Miradors (viewpoints), including the Mirador del Río, perched high above the cliffs with panoramic views over the neighboring island of La Graciosa. These stunning vistas provide the perfect end to your Lanzarote adventure, as you take in the raw, untouched beauty of the island from above.

Why Choose the Full Lanzarote Experience?

This carefully crafted two-day itinerary gives you an in-depth look at Lanzarote’s most iconic sites while immersing you in its culture, history, and natural beauty. Whether you’re passionate about geology, art, or just love exploring new landscapes, this tour will leave you with unforgettable memories. Our knowledgeable local guides will ensure you enjoy every moment of this unique experience, answering your questions and sharing fascinating insights along the way.

Book your Full Lanzarote Experience today with Excursions Tickets Direct and embark on the adventure of a lifetime!

en.title: GRAND TOUR
en.text:
Pick-up from your accommodation or the nearest pick-up point.
Explore the Fire Mountains of Timanfaya National Park: Witness geothermal experiments and take a tour of the lunar-like craters. Marvel at the ancient lava fields and perhaps you can even do a Camel ride on the old lava field for a unique experience.
Visit the Green Lagoon at El Golfo: Discover the stunning Green Lagoon, a natural wonder with its vivid colours contrasting against the black volcanic sand. Take in the beauty of this unique landscape.
Indulge in Wine Tasting at La Geria
Vineyards: Immerse yourself in the rich wine culture of Lanzarote as you visit the renowned La Geria vineyards. Savour the flavours of the local wines and appreciate the unique vineyard cultivation techniques used on the volcanic soil.
Stop for Lunch at a Local Tapas Restaurant: Enjoy a delicious meal at a local tapas restaurant, savouring the flavours of authentic Canarian cuisine, for an additional 13€ and 6€ for a child. Take a break and recharge before continuing your adventure.
Explore Jameos del Agua Cave: Step into the magical Jameos del Agua cave, where you'll find a mesmerizing concert hall and a saltwater lake inhabited by albino crabs. Be enchanted by the artistic transformation of this underground space.
Pass by the Valley of 1000 Palm Trees in Haria: Take in the breathtaking panoramic views of Haria village as you pass through the Valley of 1000 Palm Trees, and admire the lush greenery and tranquil beauty that surrounds you.
Drop-off at the original pick-up point: After an incredible day of exploration, you'll be dropped off back at your initial pick-up point, bringing the tour to a close.

en.title: CESAR MANRIQUE TOUR
en.text:
Pick-up: We will pick you up either from your accommodation or the nearest pick-up point.
César Manrique Foundation: Visit the César Manrique Foundation in the old town of Teguise. Explore the artist's studio, gallery, and living quarters, where you can admire some of his most iconic works.
Cactus Garden: Journey to Guatiza and immerse yourself in the Cactus Garden. Designed by César Manrique, this enchanting garden showcases over 7,000 species of cacti from around the world, seamlessly blending art and nature.
Jameos del Agua or Cueva de los Verdes (Green Cave):
Choose between two captivating options. At Jameos del Agua, explore a lava tunnel that houses a salt lake and rare Albino Crabs. Experience the mesmerizing underground Concert Hall and enjoy the breathtaking garden and blue lagoon.
Alternatively, venture into Cueva de los Verdes, a 6 km long lava tube with an open section for the public. Discover its history and be amazed by a stunning light and sound show, unraveling the secrets of Lanzarote.
Lunch Break: Take a break and enjoy a delicious buffet lunch at a local tapas restaurant, offering regional specialties. Additional charges apply (€10 for adults, €5 for children).
Mirador del Rio viewpoint: Head to Mirador del Rio, located on the northernmost tip of Lanzarote. This viewpoint, seamlessly integrated into the natural surroundings, provides breathtaking views of La Graciosa island and the northwest coast of Lanzarote.
Monumento al Campesino (Farmers Monument): Visit the spectacular Museum of the Farmer, located near the village of San Bartolomé. This unique museum pays homage to Lanzarote's agricultural heritage, combining art, nature,

Visite la Laguna Verde de El Golfo: Descubra la impresionante Laguna Verde, una maravilla natural de vivos colores que contrastan con la negra arena volcánica. Disfrute de la belleza de este paisaje único.

Explore la cueva de Jameos del Agua: Adéntrate en la mágica cueva de Jameos del Agua, donde encontrarás una hipnotizante sala de conciertos y un lago de agua salada habitado por cangrejos albinos. Sea encantado por la transformación artística de este espacio subterráneo.
Pasar por el Valle de las 1000 Palmeras en Haria: Disfrute de las impresionantes vistas panorámicas del pueblo de Haria mientras atraviesa el Valle de las 1000 Palmeras, y admire la exuberante vegetación y la tranquila belleza que le rodea.

en: General FAQs

Where and what time will I get picked up?
We have Tours that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen and Costa Teguise, we can also pick up in Arrecife, Playa Honda and Yaiza.
Pick-up points are in hotels or the next-door resort.
Pick-up starts at 08:30 in every resort, tell us where you're staying and we will send you the exact collection time with GPS indication if your hotel doesn't have pick-up.
How far are the pickup points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnBs?
Not exactly, however, we do pick at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
FAQs

How long are the Excursions?
The tours last around 8 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off, bringing you back around 17:00.
How long will I be on the bus?
Lanzarote is a tiny island the most time you will be on the bus is only when going from North to south which takes approximately 50 minutes for the  customers staying in Playa Blanca.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English, Spanish, German and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where / when and how can I pay the balance?
Customers can pay at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using a credit card or cash.
Do I have free time?
Yes, at every stop we give you at least 15 minutes to enjoy and explore the  attractions without any rush.
What sort of clothes do I need?
You can go as you please, comfortable clothing and trainers are what we recommend. Hats and Sunglasses for the Summer season and a jumper for Wintertime as it can be windy in the morning.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour?
Yes, as long as the customers can go up and down the coach and have an assistant they can join the tour without any problems.
Do we stop for food and is it included in the price?
Yes, we stop at a restaurant where you can enjoy a local tapas buffet with drinks, for an additional 10 € per adult and 5 € for children.
Am I allowed to bring food?
Yes, of course, take some snacks and drinks especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there are toilets at every stop we make.
How big and long are the caves?
Cueva de los Verdes are a wide connection of Lava Tunnels, it takes a 40-minute hike to complete and it's not claustrophobic, the ceiling is 10 Meters  wide, head over to the photos section to get a better idea.
NOTE that we don't recommend customers with reduced mobility to visit the Green Caves but they are welcome to repeat Jameos del Agua cave and perhaps take a moment to enjoy the extraordinary place while having a drink.
Can I swim at the lagoon in Jameos del Agua, Hotsprings or Green Lake?
No, this is strictly forbidden, the lakes are natural reserves for artistic purposes and display, and the hot springs are too dangerous with high tide and strong currents causing strong waves to crash into volcanic rocks
Are there too many steps to go up to the viewpoint?
No, no more than 10 steps to go up, our drivers drop off at the most approximate parking which is 2 minutes away.
Are the Volcanoes active and dangerous?
Yes, Timanfaya is an active volcano that erupted 200 to 300 years ago and now the insides are filled with potable water making it impossible to erupt again for the foreseeable future
How long and how much are the Camel rides?
The Camel ride costs around 10 euros per person and about 20 minutes of a ride.

overview.en:
Embark on a breathtaking two-day adventure with our Discover Lanzarote & Lobos Island tour, where nature, culture, and adventure blend seamlessly. This unforgettable experience takes you through Lanzarote’s most iconic attractions and then whisks you away to the tranquil beauty of Lobos Island.

Day 1: Discover the Wonders of Lanzarote

Begin your journey at the world-renowned Timanfaya National Park, a volcanic landscape that feels like stepping onto another planet. This UNESCO-recognized park showcases Lanzarote’s unique volcanic heritage with its fiery terrain and geothermal demonstrations. You'll be awestruck by the power and beauty of nature as you traverse this rugged landscape.

Next, delve into the island’s underground marvels by visiting the stunning Cueva de los Verdes (Green Cave). This ancient lava tunnel, formed by volcanic eruptions, offers a surreal atmosphere where light and shadow play off the cave walls. The site has a rich history and was once used by locals as a refuge from pirate attacks. The secrets of the cave will amaze you at every turn.

Continue your exploration with a visit to the fascinating Jameos del Agua, a natural wonder transformed by the famed artist César Manrique. Here, you’ll experience a magical fusion of art and nature in a lava tube, featuring crystal-clear underground lakes, exotic flora, and stunning architecture. Don’t miss the chance to witness the rare albino crabs, which can only be found in these waters.

Your final stop for the day is the Mirador del Río, a viewpoint perched high above the cliffs of Lanzarote. From here, you’ll have panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean and the neighboring island of La Graciosa. The jaw-dropping vistas are perfect for capturing memorable photos and soaking in the tranquility of Lanzarote’s northern coast.

Day 2: Lobos Island Boat Cruise & Dolphin Spotting

On day two, switch gears and set sail on a thrilling dolphin-watching cruise as you head towards the serene Lobos Island. Keep your eyes peeled for playful dolphins dancing in the waves as you cruise across the turquoise waters. This experience offers a unique chance to see these majestic creatures in their natural habitat, making it a favorite for nature lovers.

Upon arriving at Lobos Island, you'll discover a hidden paradise that boasts pristine lagoons, white sandy beaches, and unspoiled natural beauty. Lobos Island is a protected nature reserve, offering a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Explore the island’s tranquil landscapes, go for a refreshing swim in its crystal-clear waters, or take a leisurely walk through its rugged terrain. The island’s rich biodiversity makes it a haven for birdwatchers and outdoor enthusiasts alike.

After a day of sun, sea, and relaxation, you’ll sail back to Lanzarote, feeling refreshed and enriched by the island’s natural wonders and diverse experiences.

Why Choose the Discover Lanzarote & Lobos Island Tour?

  • Nature and Adventure Combined: This tour is perfect for those who want to experience both Lanzarote’s stunning landscapes and the tranquility of Lobos Island.
  • Dolphin Spotting: A highlight of the trip is the chance to see dolphins up close, making it a thrilling adventure for all ages.
  • Small Group Experience: Enjoy a more personalized experience with small groups, ensuring you can explore at your own pace.
  • Unforgettable Memories: From volcanic landscapes to serene lagoons, this tour offers a wide range of photo-worthy moments that you’ll cherish forever.

Don’t miss out on this unique opportunity to discover the best of Lanzarote and Lobos Island. Book now and prepare for an adventure that will leave you in awe of the natural beauty that these islands have to offer.
overview.es: Explore las principales atracciones de Lanzarote en nuestro paquete de naturaleza y aventura: Parque Nacional de Timanfaya, Cueva Jameos del Agua, Túnel de lava de la Cueva Verde y Mirador del Río. El segundo día, disfrute de un emocionante crucero en barco para ver delfines y descubrir las prístinas lagunas de la isla de Lobos.
