¿Puede alguien con movilidad reducida ir a hacer este paquete?
Sí, ciertamente nuestro recinto y parque son accesibles a todo el mundo, pero siempre es bueno tener a alguien que pueda ayudar, ya que nuestros anfitriones están ocupados recibiendo clientes y realizando actuaciones.
Día 1 Rancho Texas Animal Park FAQ

¿A qué hora es la recogida?
La recogida comienza a las 09:00 en todos los complejos.
Díganos dónde se aloja y le enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicaciones GPS si su hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en Rancho Texas Park?
Hay tiempo de sobra para disfrutar en el parque; estamos allí desde las 10 de la mañana hasta aproximadamente las 16:00-17:00 horas.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaré en el autobús?
El viaje en autobús a Rancho Texas dura un máximo de 20 minutos.
¿En qué idioma están los espectáculos?
Las presentaciones y espectáculos son en inglés y español.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden subir al autobús de transbordo con nuestro billete electrónico y pagar el resto a la entrada del parque.
¿Podemos organizar un servicio de taxi a Rancho Texas, y cuánto costaría?
Sí, podemos ayudar a los clientes que lo soliciten a reservar un servicio de taxi. El coste del taxi depende del lugar donde se aloje:
Los clientes que se alojen en Puerto del Carmen el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 5€.
Los clientes que se alojen en Playa Blanca el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 40-50€.
Los clientes que se alojan en Costa Teguise el coste del taxi es de 20-30€.
¿Podemos volver en taxi al hotel?
Sí, ciertamente, hay una parada de taxis justo fuera del parque, y si no, la recepción del Rancho Texas puede ayudarle a llamar a un taxi.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, lo que te recomendamos es ropa cómoda y zapatillas deportivas. Sombreros y gafas de sol para la temporada de verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento por la mañana, bañadores y toallas para los que deseen tirarse por los toboganes o darse un chapuzón.
¿Hay algún sitio para comer en Rancho Texas Park?
Sí, hay un restaurante americano donde los clientes pueden pedir bebidas y comida.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto, llévate algo de picar y beber, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en Rancho Texas Park.
¿Está permitido nadar con leones marinos o delfines?
Sí, está permitido si tiene una interacción reservada con antelación. Diríjase a la página de la actividad y reserve por separado.
Día 2 Country & Western Night FAQ

¿A qué hora es la recogida?
La recogida comienza a las 18:30 en todos los complejos, dinos dinos dónde te alojas y te enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si tu hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿Cuánto dura la cena/espectáculo?
El espectáculo dura aproximadamente 4 horas con cena incluida.
¿El Espectáculo es apto para niños?
Sí, absolutamente el espectáculo se adopta a todas edades.
¿Hay restricciones de edad para los niños?
No, todo el mundo es bienvenido.
¿La cena está incluida en el precio?
Sí, hay un bufé de barbacoa con una selección de platos.
¿Hay menú vegano, vegetariano o sin gluten?
Sí, tenemos para todos los gustos.
¿Están incluidas las bebidas?
Sí, hay una barra libre de sangría, cerveza y refrescos, bebidas espirituosas también están disponibles bajo petición con un cargo adicional.
¿Puedo pagar para ver el programa?
Lamentablemente no, la cena está incluida con el espectáculo y no hay entradas sólo para el espectáculo en este momento.
¿Por qué no ofrecemos recogida en Puerto del Carmen?
Cobramos un suplemento de 10€ por persona para los traslados, es más barato para los clientes coger un taxi hasta el lugar de celebración que sólo tiene un coste máximo de 5€.
¿Puedo ir andando al recinto?
Sí, los clientes pueden ir andando al recinto si pero es recomendable utilizar un servicio de taxi.
¿Puede todo el mundo montar en poni?
No, lamentablemente esto es sólo para los más pequeños.
¿Cuánto dura el espectáculo?
El espectáculo dura aproximadamente 4 horas.

es.title: Crucero en barco + Buggy - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Unleash your adventurous spirit with the ultimate combo experience: a thrilling 2-hour buggy ride paired with an unforgettable small-group boat cruise. Whether you're seeking excitement on land or sea, this action-packed tour offers the perfect balance of adrenaline, relaxation, and fun for couples or friends.

Buggy Adventure: Off-Road Thrills

Your adventure begins with an exciting 2-hour buggy ride through Lanzarote’s dramatic landscapes. Feel the rush of adrenaline as you navigate rugged trails, twist through volcanic terrain, and soak in breathtaking views of the island’s natural beauty. Our modern, well-maintained buggies are designed for comfort and safety, ensuring a smooth and exhilarating ride for everyone. Whether you're an experienced rider or new to off-road adventures, the guided buggy tour is tailored to all skill levels, offering a unique perspective of Lanzarote's volcanic scenery and coastal panoramas.

Boat Cruise: Relaxation and Water Sports Fun

After your buggy tour, the excitement continues on the water with a luxurious boat cruise. This intimate cruise is designed for small groups, allowing you to relax and unwind while enjoying the stunning coastline views. Take advantage of the all-inclusive package, featuring a fully stocked bar with refreshing drinks and a delicious lunch to fuel your adventure.

For those looking to amp up the fun, the boat cruise offers thrilling water sports activities, including the exhilarating banana boat and crazy donut rides. These heart-pounding water activities are perfect for those looking to make a splash and add a bit of thrill to their day.

The Ultimate Adventure Combo

This Boat Cruise + Buggy Adventure is the perfect way to experience the best of Lanzarote, combining off-road excitement with the relaxation of a scenic cruise. Whether you're looking to celebrate a special occasion, enjoy a day out with friends, or simply explore the island from land and sea, this tour provides a memorable and action-packed experience.

Key Highlights:

  • 2-hour guided buggy tour: Explore Lanzarote's rugged terrain and volcanic landscapes.
  • Small-group boat cruise: Relax on a luxurious boat with stunning views of the coast.
  • Water sports fun: Enjoy thrilling rides on the banana boat and crazy donut.
  • All-inclusive package: Indulge in drinks from the fully stocked bar and savor a delicious lunch.
  • Perfect for couples or friends: Ideal for those seeking adventure and relaxation.

Book your Boat Cruise + Buggy Adventure today and discover the ultimate way to explore Lanzarote from land and sea!

en: General FAQ

Where and what time will i get picked up?
Pick up points are in  hotels or the next door resort.
Pick up starts at 09:00 in every resort, tell us where you’re staying and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick up.
How far are the pick up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnB’s?
Not exactly, however we do pick up at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
In which language is the Excursion?
We have tours in English,  Spanish,  German and French and guides for different nationalities. Please tick your language and check the available days.
Where / when and how can i pay the balance ?
Balance is paid at collection time, to our guides, payment can be done using credit card or cash.
FAQ

Do i have free time?
Yes , we have a couple of coffee breaks and stops in picturesque spots.
What sort of clothes do i need?
You can go as you please, confortable clothing, trainers  and a scarf to cover mouth and nose from dust while 9n the buggies tour, swimming outfits,  towels and a change of clothes for the boat trip is what we recommend. Hats and Sunglasses for the Summer season and a jumper for Winter time as it can be windy.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this activities ?
Yes as long as the person is able to go up and down the coach and has an assistant they can join us.
Am i allowed to bring food ?
Yes, ofcourse take some snacks and drinks although you have lunch included with pur Boat Cruise.
Do we go to the Volcanoes?
No, its illegal to visit the national park on buggies but we do pass by the outskirts and you can admire the views.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there is toilets stops at the Marina and at Lanzarote Karting.
How long is the transfer on the coach?
Depending where you are staying, the longest being 45 minutes drive for those customers that are staying in Playa Blanca.
Is the Buggy Excursion off-road?
Yes , 70% of the Excursion is off-road and.
Do we provide glasses?
No, but all the buggies have protection glass screen infront.
Are the buggies easy to drive?
These specific buggies are very essy to drive , they are automatic buggies so you don’t have to worry about changing gears while goin up hills its simply accelerate and break.
Is it allowed to swap drivers ?
Yes, it is allowed so long as the passenger has a full drivers licence and has registered and signed the insurance documents prior to the start of the activity.
How fast do we go ?
Speed of the Excursion varies by groups, there usually is a faster group and the slower group stays behind in which case our guide takes the first postion in order to lead the slower group while the faster group goes infront led by another guide and waits for the rest of the group to arrive at the stop points
How long are we on the coach to reach the port?
The journey to Puerto Calero is approximately 15-20 Minutes depending shere you’re staying.
Can i go straight to the harbour?
Yes, you can go straight to the harbour with after the buggy Tour.
How long are you on the boat?
We are on board for approximately 4 hours.
Are Water Activities included?
Yes, all Water Activities are included in the price.
What Water Activities are offered?
This boat trip offers Kayaks, Stand-up paddle, snorkeling equipment, Banana boat and Crazy donut.
Are there any age restrictions to go on any of the activities?
Yes, the minimum age to get on the banana boat and Crazy Donut rides is 8 years old.
Are there any shades on the boat?
Yes, there’s plenty of shades.
Are there any toilets on board?
Yes, there’s toilets on board this Catamaran.
Is there any music on board?
Yes , we have Chilout music on board.
Is it allowed to jump off the boat?
Yes , when the boat has docked and water activities are activated customers are allowed to jump in from the back of the boat.
What food is included ?
We serve a variety of local traditional tapas.
Any dietary requirements?
Please contact our customer service or leave a comment on notes at the time of booking.
Are drinks included ?
Yes, drinks are included for all you can drink and we offer a selection of Sangria, Beer and non alcoholic beverages.
How long is the Excursion?
The tour lasts around 8 hours from the time of pick up to the time of drop off.
Can I go to the beach?
No, it is not recommended, but you can consult with guides if its safe to kayak.
What is the capacity of this boat?
The maximum capacity for this boat is 12 people.
es: FAQ generales

¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?
Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el complejo turístico de al lado.
La recogida comienza a las 09:00 en todos los complejos, dinos dónde te alojas y te enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si tu hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?
No exactamente, sin embargo le recogemos en su parada de autobús u hotel más cercano, envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta su parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿En qué idioma está la Excursión?
Tenemos visitas guiadas en inglés, español, alemán y francés y guías de distintas nacionalidades. Marque su idioma y compruebe los días disponibles.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
El saldo se paga en el momento de la recogida, a nuestros guías, el pago puede hacerse con tarjeta de crédito o en efectivo.
PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES

¿Tengo tiempo libre?
Sí, hacemos un par de pausas para tomar café y paradas en lugares pintorescos.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, ropa cómoda, zapatillas de deporte y un pañuelo para taparte la boca y la nariz del polvo durante la excursión en buggies, ropa de baño, toallas y una muda para el paseo en barco es lo que te recomendamos. Sombreros y gafas de sol para el verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento.
¿Puede alguien con movilidad reducida realizar estas actividades?
Sí, siempre que la persona sea capaz de subir y bajar del autocar y tenga un ayudante puede unirse a nosotros.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto, llévese algo para picar y bebidas, aunque el almuerzo está incluido en el crucero en barco.
¿Vamos a los volcanes?
No, es ilegal visitar el parque nacional en buggies, pero pasamos por las afueras y se pueden admirar las vistas.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay paradas de aseos en el Puerto Deportivo y en Lanzarote Karting.
¿Cuánto dura el traslado en autocar?
Dependiendo de donde se aloje, siendo el más largo 45 minutos en coche para aquellos clientes que se alojen en Playa Blanca.
¿El Buggy Excursión es todoterreno?
Sí , el 70% de la Excursión es todoterreno y.
¿Proporcionamos gafas?
No, pero todos los buggies tienen pantalla de cristal de protección delante.
¿Son fáciles de conducir los buggies?
Estos buggies específicos son muy essy para conducir, son buggies automáticos por lo que no tiene que preocuparse de cambiar de marcha mientras goin colinas su simplemente acelerar y frenar.
¿Está permitido intercambiar controladores?
Sí, está permitido siempre que el pasajero tenga el permiso de conducir en regla y se haya inscrito y firmado los documentos del seguro antes del inicio de la actividad.
¿A qué velocidad vamos?
La velocidad de la excursión varía según los grupos, normalmente hay un grupo más rápido y el grupo más lento se queda atrás en cuyo caso nuestro guía toma la primera posición para dirigir al grupo más lento mientras que el grupo más rápido va delante dirigido por otro guía y espera a que el resto del grupo llegue a los puntos de parada.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en el autocar hasta llegar al puerto?
El viaje a Puerto Calero es de aproximadamente 15-20 minutos dependiendo de donde se aloje.
¿Puedo ir directamente al puerto?
Sí, puede ir directamente al puerto después de la excursión en calesa.
¿Cuánto tiempo estás en el barco?
Estaremos a bordo aproximadamente 4 horas.
¿Están incluidas las actividades acuáticas?
Sí, todas las actividades acuáticas están incluidas en el precio.
¿Qué actividades acuáticas se ofrecen?
Esta excursión en barco ofrece Kayaks, Stand-up paddle, equipo de snorkel, Banana boat y Crazy donut.
¿Hay restricciones de edad para participar en alguna de las actividades?
Sí, la edad mínima para subir a las atracciones banana boat y Crazy Donut es de 8 años.
¿Hay sombras en el barco?
Sí, hay muchos matices.
¿Hay aseos a bordo?
Sí, hay aseos a bordo de este catamarán.
¿Hay música a bordo?
Sí, tenemos música Chilout a bordo.
¿Está permitido saltar del barco?
Sí, cuando el barco ha atracado y las actividades acuáticas están activadas, los clientes pueden saltar desde la parte trasera del barco.
¿Qué alimentos están incluidos?
Servimos una gran variedad de tapas tradicionales locales.
¿Necesita algún régimen alimenticio?
Póngase en contacto con nuestro servicio de atención al cliente o deje un comentario en notas en el momento de hacer la reserva.
¿Están incluidas las bebidas?
Sí, las bebidas están incluidas para todo lo que puedas beber y ofrecemos una selección de sangría, cerveza y bebidas no alcohólicas.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión?
El recorrido dura unas 8 horas, desde la recogida hasta el regreso.
¿Puedo ir a la playa?
No, no es recomendable, pero puede consultar con los guías si es seguro navegar en kayak.

La capacidad máxima de este barco es de 12 personas.

es.title: Jetski + Parascending + Crazy Dount - Excursiones en Lanzarote | Excursions Tickets Direct

overview.en:
Prepare yourself for the ultimate adrenaline-pumping water sports experience with our Jetski + Parascending + Crazy Donut tour in Lanzarote! This exciting package is designed for thrill-seekers and adventure lovers who want to experience the best of water sports in one incredible tour.

Start your day by taking control of a powerful Jetski, zooming across the sparkling waters of Lanzarote’s coastline. Whether you're an experienced rider or a beginner, the Jetski circuit offers the perfect opportunity to feel the wind in your hair as you glide over the waves. The freedom and speed of riding a Jetski is unlike any other, and our professional instructors ensure you feel safe and confident as you conquer the waters.

But the excitement doesn't stop there! Next up is the Crazy Donut ride, an exhilarating twist on the classic banana boat. You'll hold on tight as you're towed behind a speedboat, bouncing and spinning across the ocean’s surface. It's the ultimate group activity—filled with laughter, adrenaline, and unpredictable turns. This experience will leave you breathless and eager for more!

After all that action on the water, it’s time to soar to new heights with a spectacular Parascending flight. As you're gently lifted into the sky, you’ll be treated to panoramic views of Lanzarote’s stunning coastline, volcanic landscapes, and the vast Atlantic Ocean. The feeling of flying as you glide through the air is both peaceful and exhilarating, offering a once-in-a-lifetime perspective of the island. This safe and enjoyable activity is suitable for both individuals and pairs, making it a fantastic way to share a unique moment with a loved one or friend.

This combo package is perfect for anyone seeking a high-energy, unforgettable day on the water. It's a fantastic way to experience Lanzarote’s natural beauty while indulging in some of the most thrilling water sports available. Whether you're an adrenaline junkie or just looking to try something new, the Jetski + Parascending + Crazy Donut tour promises a day of excitement, laughter, and breathtaking views.

Book your spot now and get ready for an adventure that combines speed, height, and fun, creating memories that will last a lifetime!

Highlights:

  • Jetski Circuit: Master the waves and feel the thrill of speed.
  • Crazy Donut Ride: Hold on tight for an unpredictable, fun-filled ride!
  • Parascending: Soar high above Lanzarote for stunning aerial views.
  • Perfect for groups and families: Enjoy an unforgettable day with friends and loved ones.
  • Experienced guides: Our expert instructors ensure your safety and enjoyment at every step.

Important Information:

  • Duration: Approx. 2 hours.
  • Location: Lanzarote, with spectacular views of the coastline.
  • What to bring: Swimwear, towel, and sunscreen.
  • Suitable for: All ages (children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult).
overview.es: Embárquese en una electrizante escapada acuática con nuestro exclusivo paquete Jetski, Crazy UFO y Parascending, una delicia hecha a medida para los entusiastas de los deportes acuáticos como usted. Sumérjase en la emoción de un circuito de motos acuáticas, donde dominará las olas con una energía palpitante. Prepárese para un viaje cargado de adrenalina en el Crazy UFO, que añade un toque único a su aventura acuática. A continuación, eleve el Experimente nuevas alturas mientras se eleva con gracia sobre la pintoresca costa de Lanzarote durante un sobrecogedor vuelo en parapente. Únase a nosotros para disfrutar de una fusión inolvidable de velocidad, adrenalina y vistas panorámicas, creando recuerdos que perdurarán mucho después de que las olas se calmen.

en.title: Tour itinerary
en.text:
Get brief instructions upon your arrival & get your Jetski Circuit experience:
Upon your arrival at our location, you’ll receive concise safety instructions, be outfitted with top-notch gear, and then escorted to our state-of-the-art Jetski.
Immerse yourself in a heart-pounding 20-minute circuit, followed by a ride on our Crazy UFO where the rush of adrenaline meets the thrill of navigating the waves.
After the Jetski & Crazy UFO ride we switch boats and prepare you for the Parascending flight:
Following your exhilarating Jetski ride, the adventure continues with Parascending. Experience the seamless transition as we switch boats, prioritizing your safety with thorough checks before your breathtaking flight.
Enjoy an exhilarating Parascending experience:
Once we depart, our skilled instructors will assist you on the lift off for an exhilarating flight. Embark on a captivating aerial journey, unveiling the mesmerizing coastlines of Lanzarote from a breathtaking vantage point..
Conclude the adventure with our return to the harbour:
After your exhilarating watersports, take a moment to unwind and savor the leisurely boat ride back to the harbor. This tranquil journey will mark the conclusion of your thrilling adventure. Before you depart, don’t forget to visit our shop and peruse the collection of memorable photos available, allowing you to take a piece of this incredible experience with you.

es.title: Itinerario
es.text:
Reciba unas breves instrucciones a su llegada y viva la experiencia del Circuito de Motos de Agua:
A su llegada a nuestras instalaciones, recibirá instrucciones de seguridad concisas, se le equipará con material de primera clase y se le acompañará a nuestra moto acuática de última generación.
Sumérjase en un trepidante circuito de 20 minutos, seguido de un paseo en nuestro Crazy UFO, donde la adrenalina se une a la emoción de surcar las olas.
Después del paseo en Jetski & Crazy UFO cambiamos de barco y te preparamos para el vuelo en Parascending:
Tras el emocionante paseo en moto acuática, la aventura continúa con el Parascending. Experimente la transición perfecta mientras cambiamos de embarcación, dando prioridad a su seguridad con comprobaciones exhaustivas antes de su impresionante vuelo.
Disfrute de una estimulante experiencia de Parascending:
Una vez que salgamos, nuestros instructores expertos le ayudarán en el despegue para un vuelo estimulante. Embárquese en un cautivador viaje aéreo, descubriendo las hipnotizantes costas de Lanzarote desde un impresionante punto de vista...
Concluya la aventura con nuestro regreso al puerto:
Después de sus emocionantes deportes acuáticos, tómese un momento para relajarse y saborear el tranquilo paseo en barco de vuelta al puerto. Este tranquilo viaje marcará el final de su emocionante aventura. Antes de partir, no olvide visitar nuestra tienda y echar un vistazo a la colección de fotos memorables disponibles, que le permitirán llevarse consigo un pedazo de esta increíble experiencia.

en: General FAQ

How and when do I pay the balance?
Balance can be paid in cash or using a credit card on the Excursion before the start of the activity.
In which language is the activity?
We have instructors that speak English, Spanish, German & French.
FAQ

How can I get to the starting point?
We can book you a taxi service that will drop you off at the starting point.
How much does a taxi cost?
This depends where you’re staying:
Customers staying in Playa Blanca can do the activity in Playa Blanca and the taxi service cost are approximately 5€.
Customers staying in Puerto del Carmen can do the activity in Puerto del Carmen and the taxi costs are approximately 5-8€.
Customers staying in Costa Tegiise have to go to Puerto del Carmen, taxi costs are approximately 20-30€.
NOTE that maximum amount of people a taxi can hold is 8 passengers.
Are there any public bus services ?
Yes there are public bus services:
From Costa Teguise there is a direct line, the bus number 03 takes you to Puerto del Carmen and it takes roughly 40minutes to 1 hour. The bus from Costa Teguise costs around 3€ per person, please consult us at the time of booking and we will forward you all the information needed with the ticket confirmation.
Is the starting point, walking distance from Playa Blanca Center?
Yes, it is only 10 minutes walk if you are staying in the centre of Playa Blanca, we recommend those of you that stay at the far ends to get a taxi.
Is the starting point, walking distance from the Old Town of Puerto del Carmen?
Yes, the activity speed boats leave from the port or from the harbour.
What sort of clothes do i need?
You can go as you please, we recommend swimming costumes and towels in case you get wet.
Do I land on the sea when Parascending?
No, our instructors will pull back down to the speed boat.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there is toilets on the harbour.
Do we provide wetsuits?
Wetsuits are not required for these acticity.
Is it hard to do this acticities?
Not at all, you just relax and let our instructors do all the job for you.
Are the Jetskis hard to ride ?
Not at all, its just twist and go.
Is parascending dangerous?
No,  this is a very safe activity although we don’t recommend it to people that suffer from vertigo or are scared of heights.
What is the minimum age to do these activities?
The minimum age to do these activities is 8 years old and an adult has to go with the kids.
Can passenger come on board to watch?
Yes, anyone is welcome on board, we charge an extra 20€ per person with a maximum of 2 passengers.
es: FAQ generales

¿Cómo y cuándo pago el saldo?
El saldo se puede pagar en efectivo o con tarjeta de crédito en la excursión antes del inicio de la actividad.
¿En qué lengua se desarrolla la actividad?
Tenemos instructores que hablan inglés, español, alemán y francés.
PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES

¿Cómo puedo llegar al punto de partida?
Podemos reservarle un servicio de taxi que le dejará en el punto de partida.
¿Cuánto cuesta un taxi?
Depende de dónde te alojes:
Los clientes alojados en Playa Blanca pueden realizar la actividad en Playa Blanca y el coste del servicio de taxi es de aproximadamente 5€.
Los clientes alojados en Puerto del Carmen pueden realizar la actividad en Puerto del Carmen y el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 5-8€.
Los clientes alojados en Costa Tegiise tienen que ir a Puerto del Carmen, el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 20-30€.
Tenga en cuenta que el número máximo de personas que puede transportar un taxi es de 8 pasajeros.
¿Existen servicios públicos de autobús?
Sí, hay servicios públicos de autobús:
Desde Costa Teguise hay una línea directa, el autobús número 03 te lleva a Puerto del Carmen y tarda aproximadamente entre 40 minutos y 1 hora. El autobús desde Costa Teguise cuesta alrededor de 3€ por persona, por favor consúltenos en el momento de la reserva y le enviaremos toda la información necesaria con la confirmación del billete.
¿El punto de partida está a poca distancia del centro de Playa Blanca?
Sí, está a sólo 10 minutos andando si se aloja en el centro de Playa Blanca, recomendamos a los que se alojen en los extremos que cojan un taxi.
¿El punto de partida está a poca distancia del casco antiguo de Puerto del Carmen?
Sí, las lanchas rápidas de la actividad salen del puerto o de la dársena.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, te recomendamos bañador y toalla por si te mojas.
¿Aterrizo en el mar cuando hago Parascending?
No, nuestros instructores volverán a la lancha motora.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay aseos en el puerto.
¿Proporcionamos trajes de neopreno?
No se requieren trajes de neopreno para estas actividades.
¿Es difícil realizar estas actividades?
En absoluto, relájate y deja que nuestros instructores hagan todo el trabajo por ti.
¿Son las motos acuáticas difíciles de conducir?
En absoluto, es sólo girar y listo.
¿Es peligroso el parascending?
No, se trata de una actividad muy segura aunque no la recomendamos a personas que sufran de vértigo o tengan miedo a las alturas.
¿Cuál es la edad mínima para realizar estas actividades?
La edad mínima para realizar estas actividades es de 8 años y tiene que ir un adulto con los niños.
¿Pueden subir pasajeros a bordo para observar?
Sí, cualquier persona es bienvenida a bordo, cobramos un suplemento de 20 € por persona con un máximo de 2 pasajeros.

overview.en:
Experience the ultimate adventure in Lanzarote with our exclusive Tri Dive + Buggy Tour + Jetski combo! This exciting 2-day package is perfect for thrill-seekers looking to explore both the land and sea of this stunning island.

Day 1: Dive into the Deep Blue Kick off your adventure with an unforgettable try dive. Plunge into the crystal-clear waters of Lanzarote, where you'll explore vibrant marine life and fascinating underwater landscapes at depths of up to 8 meters. Our experienced diving instructors will guide you through every step, ensuring you're comfortable and confident with the equipment. Whether you're a first-time diver or have some experience, this is a perfect opportunity to discover the beauty of Lanzarote’s underwater world.

Day 2: Buggy Tour and Jetski Action On the second day, get ready for adrenaline-pumping action! Your journey begins with a 2-hour off-road buggy tour, taking you through rugged terrain, rolling hills, and up to stunning watchtowers offering panoramic views of Lanzarote’s volcanic landscapes. Feel the rush as you navigate dirt trails and conquer the island’s natural obstacles in our powerful buggies. No prior experience is needed, as our expert guides will ensure you have a safe and thrilling ride.

But the adventure doesn't stop there! After your buggy tour, we’ll take you to the port for an exhilarating jetski ride. Speed across the sparkling waters of the Atlantic Ocean, feeling the wind in your hair and the sun on your skin. Whether you're seeking excitement or just want to take in the breathtaking coastal views, this jetski experience is the perfect way to cap off your adventure.

Why Choose the Tri Dive + Buggy Tour + Jetski Combo?

  • Unmatched Adventure: Dive, drive, and ride – all in one epic combo.
  • Expert Guidance: Our certified instructors and guides are with you every step of the way to ensure a safe, enjoyable experience.
  • Special Discounts: Book as a couple and enjoy exclusive discounts.
  • Perfect for Couples or Solo Adventurers: Whether you're on a romantic getaway or seeking solo thrills, this package offers something for everyone.

Don't miss out on this ultimate exploration of Lanzarote, combining land, sea, and air into a heart-pounding adventure. Book your Tri Dive + Buggy Tour + Jetski combo now and make memories that will last a lifetime!
overview.es: Embárquese en una emocionante aventura de 2 días con nuestra exclusiva oferta combinada en Lanzarote. Sumérjase en el vibrante mundo submarino, explorando profundidades de 8 metros el primer día. Nuestros expertos instructores le guiarán en el dominio del equipo de buceo. Otro día, aumente la emoción con una excursión de 2 horas en buggy todoterreno, atravesando torres de vigilancia y conquistando colinas para disfrutar de unas vistas impresionantes. El viaje continúa cuando le conducimos al puerto para dar un emocionante paseo en moto acuática, culminando su experiencia con una explosión de adrenalina. No se pierda esta exploración definitiva, con descuentos especiales para parejas.

Pickup from Accommodation:
Begin your adventure with a convenient pickup from your accommodation.
Introduction to Diving:
Engage in a small theory lesson to familiarize yourself with diving essentials. And receive your high-quality diving equipment to prepare for the upcoming underwater experience, head to the sea for an immersive lesson and descend to a depth of 8 meters to witness the vibrant underwater life along the coasts of Lanzarote.
Drop-off at your accommodation: After you finish with the Dive we will proceed to drop you off back at your accommodation bringing your 2 days adventure to a conclusion.

es.title: Día 1: Excursión en Buggy + Jetski

Recogida en el alojamiento:

Participe en una pequeña clase teórica para familiarizarse con lo esencial del buceo. Y reciba su equipo de buceo de alta calidad para prepararse para la próxima experiencia submarina, diríjase al mar para una lección de inmersión y descienda a una profundidad de 8 metros para presenciar la vibrante vida submarina de las costas de Lanzarote.
Regreso a su alojamiento: Después de terminar con la inmersión procederemos a dejarte de nuevo en tu alojamiento llevando tu aventura de 2 días a su conclusión.

en: General FAQ

Where and what time will i get picked up?
We have pick-ups from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen and Costa Teguise, we can also pick up in Arrecife,  Playa Honda and Yaiza.
Pick up points are in hotels or the next door hotel if your hotel doesn’t allow pick-up from outside reception.
Pick up starts an hour before the scheduled start time of the activity, tell us where you’re staying and pick morning or afternoon and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick up.
How far are the pick up points?
We normally pick-up outside reception door unless your hotel doesn’t allow it.
Do we pick up at private BnB’s?
Yes, send us your address at the time of booking and we shall pick you up outside the holiday home.
How and when do I pay the balance?
Balance can be paid in cash or using a credit card on the day before the start of the activity.
FAQ

Can I go straight to the starting point?
Yes, you certainly can, we will send you the GPS location of our starting points,  customers have to be at starting point at least 30 minutes prior to the scheduled time.
Do I drive the buggy?
Yes, customers drive their buggy and follow our guides that will lead the way.
Is it allowed to swap drivers during the buggy tour ?
Yes, drivers need to have full drivers license.
How long is the buggy tour?
The buggy tour lasts 2 hours from the starting point.
Do we go off-road?
Yes, 70% of the tour is on off-road trails.
Are there any stops and breaks?
Yes, we have a few stops at viewpoints so that you can take some photos and enjoy the spectacular views of the island.
Is Diving hard?
Not at al, we have all the equipment that is easily managed to make the experience very easy.
Can I dive even if I get panick attacks?
We have had people with panic attacks that have done diving with us, and as we teach you step by step you will be confident enough to complete the try dive.
How long is the dive?
All dives take a maximum of 45 minutes.
Do the instructors dive with you ?
Yes each group has 2 instructors that dive with them.
What sort of clothes do i need?
You can go as you please, we recommend swimming costumes and towels, and trainers to drive the buggies.
Are there any toilet stops?
Yes, there are toilets on the harbour and at dive center.
Are there any sharks on the sea?
No, absolutely not , sharks don't swim at shallow coasts therefore we dont have sharks in Lanzarote.
How long is the transfer on the van?
Depending where you are staying,  the longest being 20 to 30 minutes drive.
Do I drive the Jet ski and am I free to go where I want?
Yes, you drive the Jetski, and you have to stick within the circuit thats marked, for more freedom head over to the Jetski Safaris section.
Do we provide wetsuits for the Jetski ride?
Wetsuits are offered to customers in the winter season.
Are the Jet skis easy to drive?
Yes, its very simple to ride a Jet ski, there’s a turn On and Off button and rev and go. You just have to let go to break or press the reverse.
Is it allowed to swap drivers to ride the Jetski?
Yes, it is allowed to swap drivers.
Can kids drive a Jet ski?
Kids that are with the parent on the Jet ski may have a turn to ride under the parent’s supervision.
How fast can I go on the Jet skis?
Our Jet skis can go pretty fast, usually 40 mph to 70 mph, depending on how calm the water is, the amount of wind resistance, and the weight of the passengers.
es: FAQ generales

¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?
Tenemos recogidas en Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise, también podemos recoger en Arrecife, Playa Honda y Yaiza.
Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en el hotel de al lado si su hotel no permite la recogida fuera de la recepción.
La recogida comienza una hora antes de la hora prevista de inicio de la actividad, dinos dónde te alojas y elige mañana o tarde y te enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si tu hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Normalmente recogemos en la puerta de recepción, a menos que su hotel no lo permita.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?
Sí, envíenos su dirección en el momento de la reserva y le recogeremos fuera de la casa de vacaciones.
¿Cómo y cuándo pago el saldo?
El saldo puede pagarse en efectivo o con tarjeta de crédito el día anterior al inicio de la actividad.
PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES

¿Puedo ir directamente al punto de partida?
Sí, por supuesto que puede, le enviaremos la ubicación GPS de nuestros puntos de partida, los clientes tienen que estar en el punto de partida por lo menos 30 minutos antes de la hora programada.
¿Conduzco yo el buggy?
Sí, los clientes conducen su buggy y siguen a nuestros guías que les marcarán el camino.
¿Está permitido cambiar de conductor durante el recorrido en buggy?
Sí, los conductores deben tener el permiso de conducir completo.
¿Cuánto dura la excursión en calesa?
La excursión en buggy dura 2 horas desde el punto de partida.
¿Vamos fuera de la carretera?
Sí, el 70% del recorrido transcurre por senderos todoterreno.
¿Hay paradas y descansos?
Sí, hacemos algunas paradas en miradores para que puedas hacer fotos y disfrutar de las espectaculares vistas de la isla.
¿Es difícil bucear?
En absoluto, disponemos de todo el equipo que se maneja fácilmente para que la experiencia sea muy sencilla.
¿Puedo bucear aunque tenga ataques de pánico?
Hemos tenido personas con ataques de pánico que han hecho inmersiones con nosotros, y como te enseñamos paso a paso tendrás la confianza suficiente para completar la inmersión de prueba.
¿Cuánto dura la inmersión?
Todas las inmersiones duran un máximo de 45 minutos.
¿Los instructores bucean con usted?
Sí, cada grupo tiene 2 instructores que bucean con ellos.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, te recomendamos bañador y toalla, y zapatillas para conducir los buggies.
¿Hay paradas para ir al baño?
Sí, hay aseos en el puerto y en el centro de buceo.
¿Hay tiburones en el mar?
No, absolutamente no, los tiburones no nadan en costas poco profundas por lo tanto no tenemos tiburones en Lanzarote.
¿Cuánto dura el traslado en furgoneta?
Dependiendo de dónde se aloje, el más largo es de 20 a 30 minutos en coche.
¿Conduzco yo la moto acuática y soy libre de ir donde quiera?
Sí, tú conduces la moto de agua, y tienes que ceñirte al circuito marcado, para más libertad dirígete a la sección de Safaris en moto de agua.
¿Proporcionamos trajes de neopreno para el paseo en moto acuática?
En invierno se ofrecen trajes de neopreno a los clientes.
¿Son fáciles de conducir las motos acuáticas?
Sí, es muy sencillo conducir una moto acuática, hay un botón de encendido y apagado y revoluciones y listo. Sólo tienes que soltar para romper o pulsar la marcha atrás.
¿Está permitido cambiar de conductor para montar en la moto acuática?
Sí, está permitido intercambiar controladores.
¿Pueden conducir los niños una moto acuática?
Los niños que acompañen a los padres en la moto acuática podrán tener un turno para montar bajo la supervisión de los padres.
¿A qué velocidad puedo ir con las motos acuáticas?
Nuestras motos acuáticas pueden ir bastante rápido, por lo general de 40 mph a 70 mph, dependiendo de lo tranquila que esté el agua, la cantidad de resistencia al viento, y el peso de los pasajeros.

overview.en:
Rancho Texas + Aqualava: The Ultimate Family Adventure

Looking for a family-friendly experience in Lanzarote that combines wildlife fun and aquatic thrills? The Rancho Texas + Aqualava package offers two unforgettable days filled with excitement, perfect for families and adventure seekers alike. This exclusive 2-day combo provides a unique opportunity to explore the best of Lanzarote's attractions, ensuring fun for all ages.

Day 1: Discover Rancho Texas Park

Your adventure begins with a full day at Rancho Texas, Lanzarote’s premier animal and splash park. From exotic wildlife encounters to thrilling live shows, Rancho Texas guarantees an experience that will captivate both young and old. Explore the expansive animal exhibits where you can get up close with a wide range of creatures, including majestic eagles, playful sea lions, and dolphins.

Don’t miss the Dolphin Show, where these intelligent creatures perform acrobatic feats that will leave you mesmerized. The Sea Lion Show is another highlight, showcasing the skills and charm of these marine mammals. Want to take the adventure further? The park also offers interactive experiences where you can swim with sea lions or interact with dolphins for an extra unforgettable moment.

For little explorers, there’s the park’s dedicated splash zone, a water wonderland with slides, fountains, and mini pools where kids can cool off and enjoy hours of aquatic fun. The family safari ride will transport you through the heart of Rancho Texas, where you can encounter even more wildlife up close.

Day 2: Fun in the Sun at Aqualava Waterpark

After an exhilarating day at Rancho Texas, head to Aqualava Waterpark on day two for a day of pure water fun! Known for its heated pools and sustainable design, Aqualava is one of Lanzarote's best family-friendly waterparks. Relax in the warm waters of the lazy river, float through its gentle currents, or catch the waves in the park’s spectacular wave pool, designed to mimic the rolling ocean tides.

Aqualava caters to both thrill-seekers and those looking for relaxation. Daredevils can try out the park’s Timu Water Slide, which guarantees an adrenaline rush, while families with younger children can enjoy the Corsair Bay – a shallow, safe splash zone with mini slides, perfect for toddlers and small kids. For a more laid-back vibe, relax on the sunbeds while your kids enjoy hours of fun in the pools.

Why Choose Rancho Texas + Aqualava?

This two-day combo package offers the best of both worlds – a day of wild animal adventures at Rancho Texas, followed by a relaxing yet exciting time at Aqualava Waterpark. It's the ultimate Lanzarote family adventure, giving you the opportunity to bond with nature, experience thrilling shows, and cool off with some aquatic fun. With both attractions being just a short distance apart, you can make the most of your vacation without spending hours traveling between locations.

Book Your Rancho Texas + Aqualava Experience Now

Don’t miss out on this unique two-day experience that combines adventure, wildlife, and waterpark fun in one amazing package. Book now to secure your spot and create unforgettable memories with your family in Lanzarote! Whether you're an animal lover, thrill-seeker, or just looking for some relaxation, the Rancho Texas + Aqualava package has something for everyone.
overview.es:
Rancho Texas + Aqualava: La Aventura Familiar Definitiva

¿Buscas una experiencia familiar en Lanzarote que combine diversión en la naturaleza y emociones acuáticas? El paquete Rancho Texas + Aqualava ofrece dos días inolvidables llenos de emoción, perfectos tanto para familias como para aventureros. Este exclusivo combo de 2 días ofrece una oportunidad única de explorar lo mejor de las atracciones de Lanzarote, garantizando diversión para todas las edades.

Día 1: Descubre Rancho Texas Park

Tu aventura comienza con un día completo en el Rancho Texas, el principal parque de animales y atracciones de Lanzarote. Desde exóticos encuentros con la fauna salvaje hasta emocionantes espectáculos en directo, el Rancho Texas garantiza una experiencia que cautivará a pequeños y mayores. Explora las amplias exposiciones de animales donde podrás acercarte a una gran variedad de criaturas, como majestuosas águilas, juguetones leones marinos y delfines.

No te pierdas el Espectáculo de los Delfines, donde estas inteligentes criaturas realizan acrobacias que te dejarán hipnotizado. El Espectáculo de los Leones Marinos es otro momento estelar, en el que se muestran las habilidades y el encanto de estos mamíferos marinos. ¿Quieres llevar la aventura más lejos? El parque también ofrece experiencias interactivas en las que puedes nadar con leones marinos o interactuar con delfines para vivir un momento inolvidable.

Para los pequeños exploradores, está la zona de chapoteo del parque, un paraíso acuático con toboganes, fuentes y minipiscinas donde los niños pueden refrescarse y disfrutar de horas de diversión acuática. La atracción safari familiar te transportará por el corazón del Rancho Texas, donde podrás encontrarte de cerca con aún más animales salvajes.

Día 2: Diversión bajo el sol en el parque acuático Aqualava

Tras un estimulante día en el Rancho Texas, el segundo día dirígete al parque acuático Aqu alava para disfrutar de un día de pura diversión acuática. Conocido por sus piscinas climatizadas y su diseño sostenible, Aqualava es uno de los mejores parques acuáticos familiares de Lanzarote. Relájate en las cálidas aguas del río perezoso, flota en sus suaves corrientes o coge las olas en la espectacular piscina de olas del parque, diseñada para imitar las ondulantes mareas del océano.

Aqualava satisface tanto a los que buscan emociones fuertes como a los que buscan relajación. Los temerarios pueden probar el tobogán acuático Timu del parque, que garantiza un subidón de adrenalina, mientras que las familias con niños pequeños pueden disfrutar de la Bahía Corsaria, una zona de chapoteo poco profunda y segura con mini toboganes, perfecta para niños pequeños. Para un ambiente más relajado, relájate en las tumbonas mientras tus hijos disfrutan de horas de diversión en las piscinas.

¿Por qué elegir Rancho Texas + Aqualava?

Este paquete combinado de dos días ofrece lo mejor de ambos mundos: un día de aventuras con animales salvajes en el Rancho Texas, seguido de un rato relajante pero emocionante en el parque acuático Aqualava. Es la aventura familiar definitiva en Lanzarote, que te brinda la oportunidad de estrechar lazos con la naturaleza, vivir emocionantes espectáculos y refrescarte con un poco de diversión acuática. Como ambas atracciones están a poca distancia unas de otras, puedes aprovechar al máximo tus vacaciones sin pasar horas viajando de un lugar a otro.

Reserva ya tu experiencia Rancho Texas + Aqualava

No te pierdas esta experiencia única de dos días que combina aventura, vida salvaje y diversión en un parque acuático en un paquete increíble. ¡Reserva ahora para asegurar tu plaza y crear recuerdos inolvidables con tu familia en Lanzarote! Tanto si eres un amante de los animales como si buscas emociones fuertes o simplemente quieres relajarte, el paquete Rancho Texas + Aqualava tiene algo para todos.

en: General FAQ

Where and what time will i get picked up?
We have pick-ups that start from Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen and Costa Teguise.
Pick up points are in  hotels or the approximate bus stop.
Pick up starts at 09:00 in every resort, tell us where you’re staying and we will send you the exact collection time  with GPS indication if your hotel doesn’t have pick up.
How far are the pick up points?
Meeting Points tend to be within 5 to 10 minutes of walking distance if not across the road.
Do we pick up at private BnB’s?
Not exactly, however we do pick-up at your nearest bus stop or hotel, send us your exact location and we will provide you GPS indications to your nearest walking distance bus stop.
Where / when and how can i pay the balance ?
Customers can get on the transfer bus with our e-ticket and pay the balance at the entrance to the park.
Day 1 FAQ: Rancho Texas Animal Park

Can I drive to the park?
Yes certainly, book an open ticket to use any day you desire to go in.
How long are we at Rancho Texas Park?
There’s plenty of time to enjoy at the park , we are there from 10 o’clock untill approximately 16:00- 17:00 o’clock.
How long will i be in the bus.
The bus journey to Rancho Texas takes a maximum of 20 minutes.
In which language are the shows?
The presentations and shows are in English and Spanish.
Can we organise taxi service to Rancho Texas and how much would it cost?
Yes, we certainly can help customers book a taxi service upon request, the taxi costs depends on where you are staying:
Customers staying in Puerto del Carmen taxi costs are approximately 5€.
Customers staying in Playa Blanca taxi costs are approximately 40-50€.
Customers staying in Costa Teguise taxi costs are 20-30€.
Can we get a taxi back to the hotel?
Yes, certainly,  there is a taxi stop right outside the park , if not the reception at Rancho Texas can help you call a taxi.
What sort of clothes do i need?
You can go as you please, confortable clothing and trainers is what we recommend. Hats and Sunglasses for the
Summer season and a jumper for Winter time as it can be windy in the morning, swimming costumes and towels for thosw who wish to go on the slides or have a swim.
Can someone with reduced mobility do this tour ?
Yes, as long as they have an assistant and can go on and off the transfer bus they are welcome.
Is there anywhere to eat at Rancho Texas Park?
Yes, theres an American diner where customers can order drinks and food.
Am i allowed to bring food ?
Yes, ofcourse take some snacks and drinks especially if you have children.
Are there any toilets?
Yes, there is toilets at Rancho Texas Park.
Is it allowed to swim with Sealions or Dolphins?
Yes, it is allowed if you have a prebooked interation, head over to the activity page and book separately.
Day 2 FAQ Aqualava Waterpark

Do we pick-up in Playa Blanca?
No, the Waterpark is less than 10 minutes and around 4€ in a taxi, let us know in observations at time of booking if you require any assistance to organise a taxi service.
Can I walk to the Waterpark from Playa Blanca Town?
Yes, you can, the walk is around 10 to 15 minutes.
Are there any taxis outside the Waterpark?
No, but the Waterpark reception can assist you with calling a taxi.
How much are the taxi costs to the park?
This depends where you stay:
• Taxi service from Costa Teguise costs 60-70€.
• From Puerto del Carmen it costs roughly 30-40€
• From Playa Blanca approximately 3-5€.
Where & when do I pay the balance?
Customers can pay balance at arrival to the park, we accept cash or card payments.
Is there an age restriction?
No, everyone is welcome and our establishment offers something for all ages.
Are there any height restrictions?
Yes , children have to reach up to 1.2 meters to be able to go on big slides.
Is the Waterpark accesible to people on wheelchairs?
Yes, we have adopted our facilities to also accommodate everyone.
Are pregnant women allowed in ?
Yes, but they are not allowed on the slides for safety reasons.
Is the Waterpark water heated?
Yes, the Waterpark has solar heated pools.
Is there any places where to get food and drinks from ?
Yes, there a restaurant with a bar inside thw Park.
Can I leave the Waterpark and come back in ?
Yes, certainly you can leave and come back .
es: FAQ generales

¿Dónde y a qué hora me recogerán?
Tenemos recogidas desde Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen y Costa Teguise.
Los puntos de recogida están en los hoteles o en la parada de autobús más cercana.
La recogida comienza a las 09:00 en todos los complejos, dinos dónde te alojas y te enviaremos la hora exacta de recogida con indicación GPS si tu hotel no dispone de recogida.
¿A qué distancia están los puntos de recogida?
Los puntos de encuentro suelen estar a entre 5 y 10 minutos a pie, si no al otro lado de la calle.
¿Recogemos en BnB privados?
No exactamente, sin embargo le recogemos en su parada de autobús más cercana o en su hotel, envíenos su ubicación exacta y le proporcionaremos indicaciones GPS hasta su parada de autobús más cercana a pie.
¿Dónde / cuándo y cómo puedo pagar el saldo?
Los clientes pueden subir al autobús de transbordo con nuestro billete electrónico y pagar el resto a la entrada del parque.
Día 1 FAQ: Rancho Texas Animal Park

¿Puedo ir al parque en coche?
Sí, desde luego, reserve un billete abierto para utilizarlo cualquier día que desee entrar.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaremos en Rancho Texas Park?
Hay mucho tiempo para disfrutar en el parque, estamos allí desde las 10 de la mañana hasta aproximadamente las 16:00- 17:00 horas.
¿Cuánto tiempo estaré en el autobús?
El viaje en autobús a Rancho Texas dura un máximo de 20 minutos.
¿En qué idioma están los espectáculos?
Las presentaciones y espectáculos son en inglés y español.
¿Podemos organizar un servicio de taxi a Rancho Texas y cuánto costaría?
Sí, por supuesto que podemos ayudar a los clientes a reservar un servicio de taxi si lo solicitan, el coste del taxi depende de dónde se alojen:
Los clientes que se alojen en Puerto del Carmen el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 5€.
Los clientes que se alojen en Playa Blanca el coste del taxi es de aproximadamente 40-50€.
Los clientes que se alojan en Costa Teguise el coste del taxi es de 20-30€.
¿Podemos volver en taxi al hotel?
Sí, por supuesto, hay una parada de taxis justo fuera del parque , si no la recepción en el Rancho Texas puede ayudarle a llamar a un taxi.
¿Qué tipo de ropa necesito?
Puedes ir como quieras, ropa cómoda y zapatillas es lo que te recomendamos. Sombreros y gafas de sol para los
Temporada de verano y un jersey para el invierno, ya que puede hacer viento por las mañanas, bañadores y toallas para los niños que quieran tirarse por los toboganes o darse un chapuzón.
¿Puede alguien con movilidad reducida hacer este recorrido?
Sí, siempre que tengan un ayudante y puedan subir y bajar del autobús de traslado son bienvenidos.
¿Hay algún sitio para comer en Rancho Texas Park?
Sí, hay un restaurante americano donde los clientes pueden pedir bebidas y comida.
¿Puedo llevar comida?
Sí, por supuesto, llévate algo para picar y bebidas, sobre todo si tienes niños.
¿Hay aseos?
Sí, hay aseos en Rancho Texas Park.
¿Está permitido nadar con leones marinos o delfines?
Sí, está permitido si tienes una interación reservada con antelación, dirígete a la página de la actividad y reserva por separado.
Día 2 FAQ Parque Acuático Aqualava

¿Recogemos en Playa Blanca?
No, el Parque Acuático está a menos de 10 minutos y alrededor de 4€ en taxi, háganoslo saber en observaciones en el momento de la reserva si necesita ayuda para organizar un servicio de taxi.
¿Puedo ir andando al Parque Acuático desde Playa Blanca Pueblo?
Sí, se puede, el paseo es de unos 10 a 15 minutos.
¿Hay taxis fuera del Parque Acuático?
No, pero la recepción del parque acuático puede ayudarle a llamar a un taxi.
¿Cuánto cuesta el taxi hasta el parque?
Depende de dónde se aloje:
- El servicio de taxi desde Costa Teguise cuesta 60-70€.
- Desde Puerto del Carmen cuesta unos 30-40€.
- Desde Playa Blanca aproximadamente 3-5€.
¿Dónde y cuándo pago el saldo?
Los clientes pueden pagar el saldo a su llegada al parque, aceptamos pagos en efectivo o con tarjeta.
¿Hay alguna restricción de edad?
No, todo el mundo es bienvenido y nuestro establecimiento ofrece algo para todas las edades.
¿Hay restricciones de altura?
Sí , los niños tienen que alcanzar 1,2 metros para poder subirse a los toboganes grandes.
¿El parque acuático es accesible para personas en silla de ruedas?
Sí, hemos adaptado nuestras instalaciones para acoger también a todo el mundo.
¿Pueden entrar mujeres embarazadas?
Sí, pero no se les permite subir a los toboganes por motivos de seguridad.
¿Se calienta el agua del parque acuático?
Sí, el parque acuático tiene piscinas climatizadas con energía solar.
¿Hay algún sitio donde comprar comida y bebida?
Sí, hay un restaurante con bar dentro del parque.
¿Puedo salir del parque acuático y volver a entrar?
Sí, claro que puedes irte y volver.

Buggies Lanzarote: Aventura LanzaBuggy

Explore Lanzarote with the Best Buggy Tours.

Lanzarote boasts some of the finest buggy tours and Quad Tours in the Canary Islands, offering a unique and exciting way to uncover the island's hidden gems.

Aventura Lanzabuggy

At Adventure Lanzabuggy, we provide a .variety of routes tailored to different preferences, each featuring a selection of top-quality Buggies Lanzarote designed to enhance your adventure. Discover Lanzarote's breathtaking landscapes and cultural highlights in an unforgettable way with Buggies Lanzarote and Aventura Lanzabuggy.

Discover Diverse Lanzabuggy Tours with Buggies Lanzarote:

Adventure Lanzabuggy offers a variety of buggy options, each designed to traverse different Buggy Tour and Quad Tours in Lanzarote offering routes 2 hours or 3 Hours and provides a unique Lanzarote buggy experience. Aventura Lanzabuggy: Maverick Can-Am Turbo X3 173hp: 3 hours Lanzarote Buggy adventure Tour A standout choice of the best Buggies in Lanzarote is the renowned Maverick Can-Am Turbo X3 , equipped with a turbo charged high-performance Rotax ACE engine with a whopping173 horsepower, celebrated for its robust American engineering. This top-tier Lanzarote Turbo Buggy not only boasts advanced suspension for exceptional off-road handling but also features a smooth automatic transmission that simplifies navigation across challenging terrains. With selectable four-wheel drive for optimal traction and a sporty design that maintains a low center of gravity, it enhances stability and performance. Perfect for couples or friends, the buggy comfortably accommodates two people. Embark on a thrilling three-hour Lanzarote Buggy tour that takes you from the outskirts of the Volcanoes Natural Park to the surf beaches of the picturesque village La Santa. The adventure continues as you cross through the heart of Lanzarote, descending from the volcanic mountains towards the eastern coastline, visiting landmarks like La Geria vineyards, Puerto Calero and the striking burnt beaches of Playa Quemada. This journey is ideal for those eager to explore Lanzarote's rugged beauty and breathtaking views on powerful buggies.

Lanzarote Vineyard Buggy Adventure: Explore La Geria

Experience the enchanting landscape of La Geria on our exclusive buggy tour through Lanzarote's iconic vineyards. This adventure takes you off the beaten path, allowing you to navigate through the heart of the island's wine country in a fun and exhilarating way.

Buggy Experience Lanzarote: Our Thrilling LanzaBuggy Adventures

Discover our exciting Lanzarote buggy tours with the powerful 1100 cc Maverick Can-Am Trail buggies , equipped for both 2-hour and 3-hour tours. These Lanzarote buggies boast a powerful Rotax V-twin engine for impressive performance, a high-performance suspension system designed to handle rough terrains, and a Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) for seamless shifting. The sporty and rugged design includes protective features like integrated roll cages and seatbelts, ensuring a safe and comfortable ride for two passengers. Durable off-road wheels and tires provide excellent traction, making these buggies perfect for adventure seekers.

2-Hour Lanzarote buggy Tours from Costa Teguise:

Our 2-hour route takes you through the off-road trails around the outskirts of Costa Teguise. Ascend the hills of north Lanzarote, where you can enjoy spectacular views of the Atlantic Ocean, visit Mirador Las Nieves viewpoint on Buggies. This tour is ideal for those looking for a quick and exhilarating ride through some of the island’s most scenic areas.

Aventura Lanzabuggy: 3-Hour Buggies Lanzarote Tours

The 3-hour Lanzarote Buggies Tour offers a comprehensive off-road experience, allowing you to discover the gems of Lanzarote. It starts by passing the iconic burnt beaches of Playa Quemada and includes a short stop at Puerto Calero Marina, known as the Millionaires' Marina. The trail then climbs to the hills, passing by volcanic terrains, and reaches up to San Bartolomé Lanzarote Karting , the heart of the island. This is the perfect spot for taking breathtaking videos and photos, making it our most popular and highly recommended off-road Lanzarote Buggy tour for friends, couples, and families. Both buggy experiences are available to anyone over 18 with a full driver's license. Customers can choose between the 2-hour and 3-hour routes, each offering a unique adventure across Lanzarote’s diverse landscapes.

Explore North Lanzarote with Buggy Tours from Costa Teguise

Embark on an exhilarating adventure with our buggy tours from Costa Teguise, Lanzarote . These tours offer a unique opportunity to drive on off-road trails to the north of the island. Whether you opt for a 2-hour journey or choose the flexibility of our vehicles, each experience is designed to thrill. Our tours stop at the scenic Mirador de las Nieves Viewpoint, where the breathtaking vistas are sure to impress. We provide options for everyone: choose from our nimble 2-seater buggies perfect for couples or solo adventurers, or select our spacious 4-seater buggies, which are ideal for families. Each buggy is equipped to ensure a safe and memorable journey through Lanzarote’s stunning landscapes.

Lanzarote 4 Seater Buggies Adventures

Explore Lanzarote with Our 4-Seater Family Buggy Volcano Tours

At ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com , we understand the diverse needs of travelers and are excited to offer the latest addition to our fleet: the 4 -seater buggies , perfect for families and groups. These buggies boast a robust American-engineered design and can comfortably seat four passengers. Each buggy is equipped with secure seatbelts, and we can even provide baby seats, ensuring that everyone, regardless of age, can join in on the adventure. Our family-friendly buggy volcano tours offer a mix of off-road and on-road experiences, balancing safety with fun to create memorable family adventures. Choose from several tour options to explore Lanzarote's stunning landscapes and cultural landmarks.

Lanzarote Buggies Mix Tour: Buggy Tours Costa Teguise

Designed especially for families, our 4 seater Buggy Mix Tour is a perfect blend of 50% off-road and 50% on-road adventures. This 3-hour Buggy tour departs from Costa Teguise , taking you through the north of Lanzarote. You'll travel on back roads, passing charming villages and volcanic terrains, leading to the historic capital, Teguise . Visit Santa Barbara Castle on a buggie tour it offers breathtaking views and a rich glimpse into Lanzarote’s past, creating lasting memories for your family.

Lanzarote Buggy Volcano: Family Road Buggy Tour from Puerto del Carmen

Our Family Road Buggy Tour is a top choice for families, starting from Puerto del Carmen. This adventure takes you along narrow back roads through picturesque villages and includes a 2 to 3-hour drive to Volcan El Cuervo . There, you can hike to the crater of this erupted volcano, followed by a visit to " Las Grietas Lanzarote ," the stunning canyons in the heart of the island. Including a 20-minute trek, this tour is accessible and enjoyable for all ages, offering a fantastic day out with the kids.

3-Hour Off-Road Quad Tour from Playa Blanca

Join us for an exhilarating 3-hour Lanzarote quad tours from Playa Blanca . This adventure will take you off the beaten path to explore some of Lanzarote's most stunning landscapes. Feel the thrill of the ride as you maneuver your quad through rugged terrains and discover the natural beauty of the island in a unique and exciting way. Get ready to kick up some dust and make lasting memories on our Playa Blanca quad tour!

Lanzarote Buggy and Quad Rentals: Guided Tours Only

In Lanzarote, the beauty of our natural environment is protected under strict regulations by the Canary Islands government. Due to Lanzarote's status as a natural reserve, renting a buggy or quad for independent use is strictly forbidden. This ensures the preservation of our delicate ecosystems and landscapes. However, you can still experience the thrill of these vehicles through our guided buggy and quad tours. The government has carefully designated routes to ensure that these tours provide an exciting adventure without compromising the natural beauty of the island. Join us on a guided tour to explore these approved paths in a safe and environmentally responsible manner.

Lanzarote Road Adventures

Lanzarote Trike Toure: LanzaTrike Adventures

For motorbike enthusiasts and trike fans, our Lanzarote Trike Tours are a must-do experience. Even families with up to three passengers can enjoy the thrill of riding a powerful motorbike with the comfort of a car. Our Lanzarote trikes are equipped with robust American engines and offer a comfortable seating arrangement for three, ensuring a thrilling yet secure adventure on the road.

Lanzarote Polaris Slingshot Excursions: LanzaXtreme Tours

For adrenaline junkies, the Polaris Slingshot offers an extreme experience. This two-seater, three-wheeled American vehicle features a whopping 2300 cc engine and 180 horsepower, providing a thrilling ride especially when navigating turns and curves. Enjoy the cool, adrenaline-pumping experience of a lifetime as you discover Lanzarote’s landmarks without the dizziness often associated with traditional buggies.

Lanzarote Can-Am Spyders Tour

Experience the power of the Can-Am Spyders Tour , an American three-wheeled motorbike that combines the comfort of a car with the thrill of a high-performance motorbike. With a big engine designed for high-capacity performance and rapid acceleration, these vehicles offer seating for two and an exhilarating ride. Choose Your Adventure, Opt for either a 2-hour Volcano Tour or a 3-hour Grand Tour on your chosen vehicle:

2 -Hour Tours (Trike, Polaris Slingshot, or Spyders)

Explore the southern part of Lanzarote, driving through the Volcanoes Natural Park . Visit the Salinas de Janubio salt flats, witness the dramatic coastal geysers at Los Hervideros, and marvel at the famous Green Lagoon at El Golfo .

3-Hour Tours (Trike or LanzaXtreme Polaris Slingshot)

Embark on a comprehensive journey through Lanzarote’s south coast. Traverse the natural park of the Volcanoes, make photo stops at the Salinas de Janubio and the green lake at El Golfo. The tour also passes through charming villages, surf beaches, and the expansive vineyards of La Geria, offering a full experience of the island’s stunning landscapes and cultural sites.

Lanzarote Tours: Explore the island with our top trips

If its the first time you are on holidays in Lanzarote , there are many tourist attraction that you must visit such as the Lanzarote Volcano and Green Cave Tours.

Lanzarote Volcano Trips

The Volcano Natural Park is home to atleast 200 Volcanoes that have erupted many years ago and within, there is the Timanfaya National Park the most visited active volcano of Lanzarote . Timanfaya holds the biggest volcabl chain on Earth and is situated in the Southern part of the island, its the most visited and biggest National Park in Lanzarote, here you will be able to witness the Geysers and geothermal experiments not to mention the visit to the famous El Diablo Restaurant where food is grilled from the heat of the volcano beneath a spectacular creation of the famous Lanzarote Artist: Cesar Manrique. We have catered tours to visit Timanfaya suitable for everyone, starting from our Half-day Volcano tour suitable for families with kids a tour of around 5 hours consisting on a short visit to the famous Lanzarote Volcano and a quick stop for a Camel Ride. You can also choose our Beautiful South Tour one of our Top Tours that visits the fire mountains and makes a stop at the renowned Green Lagoon of Lanzarote and passes by La Geria vineyards to do Wine Tasting.

Lanzarote Cave Tours

The island is home to the most precious and unique caves in the world such as: - The Green Caves Lanzarote one of the longest lava tunnels that are known to the world, it extends to around 7 kilometers and it is said that it stretches to even more length that hasn't yet been discovered as it goes deep into the ocean, our tour covers around 1 kilometer that's approximately 40 minutes and unveils the history behind, the cave gets its name from the "Verdes" a family that used to flee into the cave to hide from pirates. - Jameos del Agua Lanzarote Cave a captivating natural attraction in Lanzarote features interconnected lava caves f ormed by volcanic eruptions , an underground lake that's home to Blind Albino Crabs , a built in underground Concert Hall and lush gardens that surround a breathtaking Blue lagoon designed by César Manrique . This unique site offers visitors a mesmerizing experience of geological wonders and artistic beauty. We have catered an exclusive short Caves Tour suitable for families with kids and those seeking for quick Half-day trips .

5 Best Lanzarote Tours

Make the most with your Time in Lanzarote by exploring the best of the island with our Top Trips;

- Lanzarote Grand Tour :

It combines the best of the South and North and unveils the history of the island, by visiting the popular Lanzarote Attractions in one day: 1.Timanfaya National Park Volcano Tour 2. Stop for a Camel Ride 3. El Golfo Lanzarote Green Lagoon 4. La Geria Wine Tour & Wine Tasting 5. Jameos del Agua

- Lanzarote Highlights Tour :

As the name suggests this tour is orientated to those tourists that are for a short Time In Lanzarote and those that that seek for a quick Day Trip to see the top three most visited attractions (The Volcanoes and the Caves): 1. The Volcano Tour: Timanfaya National Park. 2 . The Cave Tour: Green Caves (Cueva de los Verde). 3. Jameos del Agua (Lake inhabited by Blind White Crabs).

- Cesar Manrique: Lanzarote Artist Tour Follow the footsteps of the renowned Lanzarote born Artist with our carefully catered César Manrique Tour made for all of our tourists that are nature and art lovers, knowledge and history seekers and the photography enthusiasts.

This guided trip concentrates on the northern part of Lanzarote and it unveils the history behind every creation of the artist, the Tourist attractions that it includes are: 1. Farmers Monument (Monumento al Campesino). 2. César Manrique Foundation (Artist House) 3. Cactus Garden 4. A choice between ( Jameos del Agua or Lanzarote Green Caves. 5. Mirador del Río Viewpoint. Find a brief description of the itinerary below. - Monumento al Campesino: Located in the village of San Bartolomé the central part of Lanzarote, the Farmers Monumet is a museum built by the artist to pay tribute to the island's agricultural heritage and unveils Lanzarote history and life after the Eruption of the Volcanoes. - César Manrique Foundation The Artist House b uilt within volcanic bubbles to create galleries exhibiting his artworks, it's a unique blend of art and nature that preserves Manrique's legacy and promotes appreciation for his contributions to the island's art and architecture. - Cactus Garden Lanzarote A botanical garden and the last art work of Cesar Manrique, the garden is home to over 1400 types of cacti from all the different continents planted over 20 years ago and it promotes a beautiful scene with the contrast of volcanic landscape. - Jameos del Agua a unique blend of art and nature featuring an underground Concert Hall a Natural lake that's home to Blind White Albino Crabs and a heavenly garden that surrounds a blue lagoon. - Green Caves (Cueva de los Verdes) a 7 kilometers lava tunnel from which 1 kilometer is open to the public and its known as the spot that holds the Secret of Lanzarote. - Mirador del Rio (Viewpoint) found in the northern part of Lanzarote its a watchtower built on a cliff edge and featuring brethtaking panoramic views to La Graciosa with a small cafetería where visitors can sit and enjoy the views while having a drink.

Tours that visit Lagomar Museum

LagOmar Museum Lanzarote a volcanic house originally designed by the Lanzarote Artist Cesar Manrique and once owned by the famous Egyptian actor Omar Sharif is a architectural gem built on a hillside of a Volcano beautifully blending with it's surroundings. This Volcanic House is now one of the most visited Tourist attractions that welcomes guests on the Lanzarote Guided Tours offering a unique historic , cultural experience and art exhibitions. Many of our visitors inquire about Lanzarote trips that include a visit to Lagomar Museum. To meet our customers demand at ExcursionsTicketsDirect.com , we've crafted a tailored excursion that includes a visit to the LagOmar Lanzarote museum . Immerse yourself in the captivating art and history of this unique house, nestled amidst volcanic landscapes. Learn about its intriguing past as the former residence of the legendary Egyptian actor, Omar Sharif . Our excursion begins with a leisurely exploration of the Lagomar Museum, where you'll discover the charm and mystique of this historic landmark. Afterward, we'll journey to the renowned Cactus Garden, renowned for its stunning array of cacti from around the world. But the adventure doesn't end there. We'll then embark on a scenic ferry ride from Orzola to La Graciosa Island. Upon arrival, indulge in a delightful lunch and savor some free time to bask in the sun and unwind on the pristine beaches while sipping on refreshing cocktails.

Nightlife Events & Activities Tours in Lanzarote

Discover the Vibrant Nightlife of Lanzarote

Lanzarote comes alive after sunset with its eclectic mix of nightlife events and activities. From thrilling beach parties to serene stargazing experiences, this Canary Island caters to every taste. Dive into a world of excitement, music, and culture with our exclusive tours designed to make your evenings unforgettable.

Explore the Best Nightlife Spots

Our tours take you to Lanzarote’s hottest nightlife destinations. Experience the vibrant atmosphere of Puerto del Carmen, known for its lively bars and nightclubs. Enjoy live music performances and DJ sets that keep the energy high. In Costa Teguise, discover chic lounges and beachfront venues where you can sip cocktails under the stars.

Lanzarote offers more than just traditional nightlife. Join our guided stargazing tours and witness the dazzling beauty of the island’s clear night skies. Explore the volcanic landscapes illuminated by moonlight on our nocturnal hiking adventures. For a romantic evening, enjoy a sunset cruise with drinks and tapas, perfect for couples or groups.

Family-Friendly Night Activities

Nightlife in Lanzarote isn’t just for adults. Families can join exciting night safaris or explore interactive evening shows at Rancho Texas Park. Kids will love the magical ambiance of these nighttime adventures, making memories to cherish forever.

Why Choose Our Nightlife Tours?

We curate each tour to provide a seamless blend of fun, comfort, and safety. With local guides and exclusive access to top venues, you’ll enjoy an authentic and unforgettable experience. Whether you want to dance the night away or enjoy a peaceful evening, we have the perfect option for you.

Yes, Rancho Texas features two splash parks where visitors of all ages can enjoy rides and refreshing swims.

Your entry ticket includes: - Free transfers from all Lanzarote resorts - Dolphin shows, sea lion shows, and birds of prey shows - Access to the splash parks - Entry to an Environmental Cave featuring 3D dinosaur simulations

Absolutely! Rancho Texas Park is suitable for visitors of all ages, including toddlers. Will the Rancho Texas Bus Pick Me Up from My Hotel? Yes, the Rancho Texas bus will pick you up from most hotels. If your hotel does not have a reception pick-up, the nearest pick-up point is no more than a 5-minute walk from your accommodation.

The minimum age to swim with dolphins is 7 years old.

Yes, absolutely! Upon the instructor's consent, you may touch the dolphins.

What Does the Interaction with Dolphins Include?

The dolphin interaction includes a 40-minute session at the dolphinarium where you can swim and play with these loving creatures.

Is the Entrance Fee to Rancho Texas Included with the Dolphin Interaction?

No, the entrance fee to Rancho Texas is paid separately.

An activity we recommend for every animal lover! Experience 40 minutes of fun, happiness, and joy with the most adorable sea lions you'll ever meet. Make sure to book your slot on our website to secure your spot before your visit to Rancho Texas Park to swim with sea lions.

Swimming with sea lions at Rancho Texas is one of the best experiences we offer to interact with adorable animals on Lanzarote. This activity is so delightful that everyone who participates comes back very happy and excited to share their experience.

During the activity, you can hug, kiss, and play games with the friendly and adorable sea lions. It's a truly unique and enjoyable experience for all participants.

Can Anyone with Disabilities Swim with Sea Lions?

Absolutely! Individuals with disabilities can participate in this activity as long as they have someone to accompany them.
